en: Public notes at the recap cutoff: 128

zh: 接受标准很严格：只能保留一个从 NSE 可控预算推出的 vanishing 或可求和缺陷估计，而且必须严格弱于已知 Serrin、BMO/Besov 或耗散波数充分条件。如果估计只是重述这些条件，或者再次假定想证明的临界小量，路线就停止。这个精确符号筛选不需要 DGX。
en: The acceptance standard is strict: only a vanishing or summable defect estimate derived from controllable NSE budgets can survive, and it must be strictly weaker than known Serrin, BMO/Besov, or dissipation-wavenumber sufficient conditions. If an estimate merely restates those conditions or again assumes the critical small quantity it is meant to prove, the route stops. This exact symbolic screening does not require DGX.

zh: 截至 R0.71D，没有新的无条件继续性判据，没有缩小所有潜在奇性解的集合，也没有证明爆破。不能把 68 个节点的数量解释成对千禧年问题完成了某个百分比。
en: Through R0.71D, there is no new unconditional continuation criterion, no reduction of the set of all potential singular solutions, and no proof of blow-up. The count of 68 nodes cannot be interpreted as a percentage of the Millennium problem completed.

zh: 九个阶段、68 个节点：实际得到的结果、已经排除的设想，以及 R0.71E 要检查的问题。
en: Nine stages and 68 nodes: the results actually obtained, the ideas already ruled out, and the question R0.71E will examine.
Cumulative recap · R0.61–R0.71D · 2026-08-25

zh: 目前最清楚的价值是路线排除。静态 signed 层级不能传播抵消；改成完整物质热 tent 后，黏性边界通量仍在一个光滑精确解上制造尺度临界缺陷。因此，后续若有增益，必须来自真正三维的拉伸、传输–滤波或压力相关性，而不能再归因于局部化几何本身。
en: The clearest value at present is route exclusion. A static signed hierarchy cannot propagate cancellation; after passing to a complete material heat tent, viscous boundary flux still creates a scale-critical defect on a smooth exact solution. Any later gain must therefore come from genuinely three-dimensional stretching, transport–filter, or pressure correlations, not from localization geometry itself.

zh: 若干把假设和量词写清楚的光滑 Navier–Stokes 解族和有限 Fourier 符号对。它们排除了特定的正控制量、谱隙符号律、时间指数提升、齐次有符号传播和仅依赖 tent 几何的增益。
en: Several smooth Navier–Stokes solution families and finite Fourier-symbol pairs with explicit assumptions and quantifiers. They rule out specific positive control quantities, an eigengap sign law, time-exponent improvement, homogeneous signed propagation, and a gain based only on tent geometry.

zh: 收录节点：68
en: Included nodes: 68

zh: 完整物质热 tent 恒等式，以及“零父 signed heat work、正子节点临界缺陷”的光滑精确 NSE 反例。
en: The complete material heat-tent identity and a smooth exact NSE counterexample with zero parent signed heat work and a positive critical child-node defect.

zh: 下一对象是在 mollified-flow skewed cylinders 上隔离 \([u\cdot\nabla,A_{j,s}]\omega\)、\(A_{j,s}(S\omega)\) 和局部压力边界项。几何合法性要接到 Yang 型覆盖理论，压力要保留 harmonic tail。
en: The next objects are \([u\cdot\nabla,A_{j,s}]\omega\), \(A_{j,s}(S\omega)\), and the local pressure-boundary term, isolated on mollified-flow skewed cylinders. Geometric admissibility must be tied to Yang-type covering theory, and the pressure ledger must retain the harmonic tail.

en: Following the stage recap for R0.00–R0.60, this page organizes the 68 research nodes from R0.61 through R0.71D. In chronological order, I record what each stage actually proved, which ideas were ruled out by counterexamples, and which conditions have not yet been derived from the equations.

en: Research recap after R0.60: a chronological account of the 68 research nodes from R0.61 through R0.71D, explaining the results obtained, the ideas ruled out by counterexamples, and the questions that remain unresolved.

zh: R0.61–R0.71D｜R0.60 之后的研究回顾
en: R0.61–R0.71D | Research recap after R0.60

zh: R0.71B 的精确 Fourier 族排除了共同响应自动衰减、无权尺度打包和一个直接三场极化估计。R0.71C 证明有符号分区会产生非负细化缺陷，黏性和真实 NSE 初始迹能从零创造正输出功。R0.71D 把传输、LP 交换子和竖直热通量写进完整物质热 tent 恒等式；随后一个光滑精确 NSE 剪切解表明，父节点 signed heat work 可以严格为零，子节点正平方却保持 \(k^2\) 临界代价，并在抛物时间盒上恰好取等。
en: The exact Fourier families in R0.71B ruled out automatic common-response decay, unweighted scale packing, and a direct three-field polarization estimate. R0.71C proved that a signed partition creates a nonnegative refinement defect and that viscosity and a genuine NSE initial trace can create positive output work from zero. R0.71D placed transport, the LP commutator, and vertical heat flux into a complete material heat-tent identity; a smooth exact NSE shear solution then showed that the parent signed heat work can be exactly zero while the positive-square child contribution retains a critical \(k^2\) cost and attains equality on the parabolic time box.

zh: R0.71B–R0.71D · 正输出系数、有符号传播和物质热 tent
en: R0.71B–R0.71D · Positive-output coefficient, signed propagation, and material heat tent

zh: R0.71E 只检查 NSE 特有的非线性相关性
en: R0.71E examines only NSE-specific nonlinear correlations

zh: “完成”表示相应推导、精确计算程序、独立检查和公开材料在声明范围内已经核对，不表示通过外部同行评审。计算反例和光滑解族只排除它们明确覆盖的估计。
en: “Complete” means that the corresponding derivations, exact computational programs, independent checks, and public materials have been verified within their stated scope; it does not mean that they have passed external peer review. Computational counterexamples and smooth solution families rule out only the estimates they explicitly cover.

zh: 固定 Parseval 框架上的精确 \(2K^2\) 底边迹代价，以及若干量词明确的光滑 NSE 解族和有限 Fourier 符号对。
en: The exact \(2K^2\) bottom-trace cost for a fixed Parseval frame, together with several quantified smooth NSE solution families and finite Fourier sign pairs.

zh: 归一化热体积 \(\mathcal V\in L_t^1\) 的无条件 Leray 能量估计。
en: An unconditional Leray-energy estimate for the normalized heat bulk \(\mathcal V\in L_t^1\).

zh: 横向线性化、旁带扰动、非线性解耦与临界预解算子的最优尺度回到经典临界尺度，没有比已知继续性条件多出新的控制。这条分支停在 R0.69F。
en: The optimal scales from transverse linearization, sideband perturbations, nonlinear decoupling, and the critical resolvent return to the classical critical scale and provide no control beyond known continuation conditions. This branch stops at R0.69F.

zh: 回顾截止节点：R0.71E
en: Final node covered: R0.71E

zh: 回顾截止时公开笔记：129
en: Public notes at the recap endpoint: 129

zh: 即使主投影恒定、谱隙很强、标量框架交换子为零，协方差功仍可在相同 \(Q\) 下反号。现有能量恒等式只能给时间 \(L^1\) 控制；同范数集中序列排除了从这些输入统一推出任何 \(L_t^s\)、\(s>1\) 控制。
en: Even with a constant principal projector, a strong spectral gap, and a vanishing scalar-frame commutator, covariance work can reverse sign at the same \(Q\). The available energy identities give only temporal \(L^1\) control; concentrating sequences with the same norm rule out any uniform deduction of \(L_t^s\), \(s>1\), control from these inputs.

zh: 节点数量不能换算成“问题完成了多少”。这些记录的作用是把条件结果、精确恒等式、计算证书、反例和停止条件分开。
en: The number of nodes cannot be converted into a percentage of the problem completed. These records separate conditional results, exact identities, computational certificates, counterexamples, and stopping conditions.

zh: 截至 R0.71E，没有新的无条件继续性判据，没有缩小所有潜在奇性解的集合，也没有证明有限时破裂。不能把 69 个节点解释成对千禧年问题完成了某个比例。
en: As of R0.71E, there is no new unconditional continuation criterion, no reduction of the full class of potential singular solutions, and no proof of finite-time breakdown. The 69 nodes cannot be interpreted as completing any percentage of the Millennium problem.

zh: 精确 Fourier 族排除了共同通道自动衰减、无权尺度打包和一个直接三场极化估计。有符号分区会产生非负细化缺陷，黏性与真实 NSE 初始迹都能从零创造正输出功。完整物质热 tent 保留全部通量后，光滑精确剪切解仍产生 \(k^2\) 临界细化代价。
en: Exact Fourier families rule out automatic decay of the common channel, unweighted scale packing, and a direct three-field polarization estimate. Signed partitions create a nonnegative refinement defect, while viscosity and an actual NSE initial trace can both create positive output work from zero. After every flux is retained in the full material heat tent, an exact smooth shear solution still produces a critical \(k^2\) refinement cost.
Cumulative recap · R0.61–R0.71E · 2026-08-25

zh: 路线已经排除了不少直觉，但仍没有跨过正则性门槛
en: The route has ruled out many intuitions but has not crossed the regularity threshold

zh: 目前可以保留的数学结果
en: Mathematical results that currently survive

zh: 目前最有内容的正结果是：上一阶段正输出系数的完整竖直热体积可以由标准能量无条件控制。最清楚的障碍是：条件继续性消费的是底边值，而全局光滑精确解已显示从热体积恢复底边需要两个频率幂。压力也不能作为独立涡量扇区补上这一缺口。
en: The strongest positive result at present is that the standard energy budget unconditionally controls the full vertical heat bulk of the previous stage's positive-output coefficient. The clearest obstruction is that the conditional continuation criterion consumes the bottom value, while a globally smooth exact solution shows that recovering the bottom from the heat bulk requires two powers of frequency. Pressure cannot fill this gap as an independent vorticity sector.

zh: 偏差对角项没有普适的代数消失结构，归一化各向异性也不自动单调。局部补偿和形变回路需要额外控制。有限个高频盲标量观测不能统一重建未过滤的临界横向涡量。
en: The deviatoric diagonal term has no universal algebraic cancellation, and normalized anisotropy is not automatically monotone. Local compensation and deformation loops require additional control. Finitely many high-frequency-blind scalar observations cannot uniformly reconstruct unfiltered critical transverse vorticity.

zh: 全局正则性证明或破裂构造
en: A global regularity proof or a breakdown construction

zh: 十个阶段、69 个节点：从约化递推到 projected-Lamb 热体积，以及仍未关闭的临界底边迹。
en: Ten stages and 69 nodes: from reduced recursion to the projected-Lamb heat bulk and the still-open critical bottom trace.

zh: 收录节点：69
en: Nodes included: 69

zh: 四次及更高阶 Picard 目标可以精确计算，约化递推也有共同解析域和机器证书。不过，所用不变剪切族始终光滑。时间分层、物理环带与完整核的检查最后都回到一般三维涡量拉伸，没有产生奇点候选。
en: Fourth- and higher-order Picard targets can be computed exactly, and the reduced recursion has a common analytic domain and machine certificates. The invariant shear families used, however, remain smooth. Tests of temporal stratification, physical annuli, and the full kernel ultimately return to general three-dimensional vortex stretching and produce no singularity candidate.

zh: 完整 Parseval 框架给出严格的条件投影公式，协方差演化和近秩一扩散也能精确写出。但能量级输入仍不能控制所需的 \(\lVert\nabla\omega\rVert_2^2\)。响应差通道有临界 Besov 增益；协方差面积、正主特征值和强谱隙都不足以决定有符号功的正负。
en: A complete Parseval frame gives an exact conditional projection formula, and covariance evolution and near-rank-one diffusion can also be written exactly. Energy-level inputs still do not control the required \(\lVert\nabla\omega\rVert_2^2\). The response-difference channel has a critical Besov gain; covariance area, a positive principal eigenvalue, and a strong spectral gap are all insufficient to determine the sign of signed work.

zh: 涡量拉伸可以写成有符号物理环带和。随后用解析缩放、外向舍入区间和端点证书替代多尺度扫描。尺度比四的一参数两尺度静态族被严格排除；结论只覆盖声明的构造族。
en: Vortex stretching can be written as a sum of signed physical annuli. Analytic scaling, outward-rounded intervals, and endpoint certificates then replace multiscale scanning. A one-parameter static two-scale family with scale ratio four is rigorously excluded; the conclusion covers only the stated construction family.

zh: 下一对象是在 mollified-flow skewed cylinders 上建立局部 projected-Lamb trace criterion。cutoff–curl 边界、移动窗口代价和 stabilized palinstrophy 必须全部保留；若加入应变账本，pressure 与 SGS 必须保持同一过滤表示。
en: The next object is a local projected-Lamb trace criterion on mollified-flow skewed cylinders. The cutoff–curl boundary, moving-window cost, and stabilized palinstrophy must all be retained; if the strain ledger is added, pressure and SGS must remain in the same filtered representation.

zh: 协方差演化、秩一扩散吸收、近秩一平方根亏损与响应距离核的精确分解。
en: Exact decompositions of covariance evolution, rank-one diffusion absorption, the near-rank-one square-root loss, and the response-distance kernel.

zh: 压力 Hessian、调和四极矩、三带估计和局部交换子给出了远场衰减与结构恒等式；近场主项仍然是三维涡量拉伸。只靠压力分解，临界能量估计不能闭合。
en: The pressure Hessian, harmonic quadrupole moment, three-band estimates, and local commutators give far-field decay and structural identities; the leading near-field term remains three-dimensional vortex stretching. Pressure decomposition alone does not close the critical energy estimate.

zh: 移动环带标签本身不会给出边界控制。匹配尺度、动态符号、固定尺度覆盖、单壳奇偶结构、仿射一阶展开、相邻源差分与核心矩变化依次被检查。冻结低频部分可由能量控制；移动低频与偏差对角项仍受临界时间 Hardy 核限制。
en: A moving annulus label does not by itself provide boundary control. Matched scales, dynamic signs, fixed-scale coverings, single-shell parity structure, affine first-order expansion, adjacent-source differences, and core-moment variation were tested in sequence. The frozen low-frequency part is controlled by energy; the moving low frequencies and the deviatoric diagonal term remain limited by the critical temporal Hardy kernel.

zh: 因此，问题被压缩成一个更小的对象：NSE 动力学是否约束有效 Lamb 迹波数，或者在局部斜柱上强制一种可求和的 signed trace 集中。
en: The problem is therefore compressed to a smaller object: whether NSE dynamics constrain the effective Lamb trace wavenumber or force a summable signed-trace concentration on local skewed cylinders.

zh: 有符号分区的非负细化缺陷、正输出归一化不连续、黏性正功创造和完整物质热 tent 恒等式。
en: The nonnegative refinement defect of signed partitions, discontinuity of positive-output normalization, viscous creation of positive work, and the full material-heat-tent identity.

zh: 有符号物理环带恒等式、完整框架交换子关系和周期投影条件继续性机制。
en: The signed physical-annulus identity, full-frame commutator relation, and periodic projected conditional-continuation mechanism.

zh: 这里的“完成”只指声明范围内可复核
en: Here, “complete” means auditable only within the stated scope

zh: 这些结果可以分别整理成条件定理、精确恒等式、反例或计算辅助分析。是否具有独立发表价值，还需要更系统的文献比较和外部同行判断。
en: These results can be organized separately as conditional theorems, exact identities, counterexamples, or computationally assisted analyses. Whether they have independent publication value still requires a more systematic literature comparison and external peer judgment.

zh: 这页接在 R0.00–R0.60 的阶段回顾之后，整理 R0.61 到 R0.71E 的 69 个研究节点。我按时间记录每一段实际证明了什么、哪条设想被具体反例或尺度分析排除，以及哪些条件还没有从 Navier–Stokes 方程中推出。
en: This page follows the R0.00–R0.60 stage recap and organizes the 69 research nodes from R0.61 through R0.71E. I record chronologically what each stage actually proves, which proposals are excluded by specific counterexamples or scaling analyses, and which conditions have not been derived from the Navier–Stokes equations.

zh: 这一页从 R0.60 的阶段终点继续
en: This page continues from the R0.60 stage endpoint

zh: 正式附图
en: Formal figure

zh: 只接受从标准方程预算证明的 Carleson 或壳层可求和估计，并与 Serrin、\(BMO^{-1}\)、Besov、BKM 和耗散波数条件逐项比较。若推导只是换一种写法假设 \(A_{\rm sb,+}\in L_t^1\)，这条分支停止。
en: Accept only Carleson or shell-summability estimates proved from the standard equation budget and compare them term by term with the Serrin, \(BMO^{-1}\), Besov, BKM, and dissipation-wavenumber conditions. If a derivation merely assumes \(A_{\rm sb,+}\in L_t^1\) in different notation, this branch stops.

zh: 逐节笔记、证书和历史回顾
en: Section-by-section notes, certificates, and historical recaps

zh: Hodge 投影把 stretching 与 transport–filter commutator 精确压成 projected-Lamb 注入；pressure 是 Bernoulli 梯度补项，不是独立涡量扇区。完整正壳注入的竖直热体积满足 \(H^{-1}\) 上界，归一化后由 Leray 能量无条件时间可积。固定光滑框架和六模态初值生成的全局光滑 2D3C NSE 解同时证明：从体积恢复初始底边仍损失 \(2K^2\)，有限抛物热盒质量保持临界。
en: The Hodge projection exactly compresses stretching and the transport–filter commutator into a projected-Lamb injection; pressure is the Bernoulli gradient correction, not an independent vorticity sector. The vertical heat bulk of the full positive-shell injection satisfies an \(H^{-1}\) bound and, after normalization, is unconditionally time-integrable by Leray energy. A fixed smooth frame together with a globally smooth 2D3C NSE solution generated by six-mode initial data also proves that recovering the initial bottom trace from the bulk still loses \(2K^2\), while the finite parabolic heat-box mass remains critical.

zh: 目前最有内容的正结果是：完整竖直热体积不仅可由标准能量无条件控制，而且在 matched bounded-overlap localization 后仍保留。最清楚的障碍是：条件继续性消费的是底边值，而全局光滑精确解对任意非零非负 cutoff 都显示完整 \(K^2\) 迹代价；flow-adapted geometry 也不能把纯乘法尺度改善成 \(o(r^{-2})\)。
en: The most substantive positive result at present is that standard energy controls the complete vertical heat bulk unconditionally and this control survives matched bounded-overlap localization. The clearest obstruction is that conditional continuation consumes a bottom value, while an exact globally smooth solution displays the full \(K^2\) trace cost for every nonzero nonnegative cutoff; flow-adapted geometry also cannot improve the purely multiplicative scale to \(o(r^{-2})\).

en: The next object is the occupation time of a large positive trace at frequency \(K\). The ledger must retain \(\partial_tL\), inter-shell transfer, moving partitions, and temporal boundaries; an instantaneously large smooth initial trace cannot be mistaken for long-time growth.

zh: 移动 cutoff 的 projected-Lamb 账本完整保留时间面、热高度面、cutoff–curl、形状残差与黏性 collar；projected 与 material 两种表示精确等价。匹配分片给出更强的局部条件继续性判据，并把无条件热体积估计保留到有界重叠局部块。六模态 2D3C 光滑解对每个非零非负 cutoff 都实现精确 \(K^2\) 底边代价；固定能量的低块分片序列和严格内部 one-block 缩放又表明，几何本身不能把临界因子改成 \(o(r^{-2})\)。\(Cr^{-2}\) 只被饱和，没有被否定。
en: The moving-cutoff projected-Lamb ledger fully retains temporal faces, heat-height faces, cutoff–curl, shape residuals, and the viscous collar; the projected and material representations are exactly equivalent. A matched partition gives a stronger local conditional continuation criterion and preserves the unconditional heat-bulk estimate on bounded-overlap local blocks. A smooth six-mode 2D3C solution realizes the exact \(K^2\) bottom cost for every nonzero nonnegative cutoff; a fixed-energy low-block partition sequence and a strictly interior one-block scaling further show that geometry itself cannot improve the critical factor to \(o(r^{-2})\). The \(Cr^{-2}\) factor is saturated, not refuted.

zh: 移动 cutoff 的完整 projected-Lamb 恒等式、projected/material 等价，以及 matched local continuation consumer。

zh: 因此，空间覆盖这条解释已被压到边界。下一对象不是再换一种几何，而是问：高频 signed Lamb 底边迹在真实物理时间里能维持多久，黏性 \(K^{-2}\) 时间是否能与 inter-shell transfer 一起形成可求和的占用估计。
en: The spatial-covering explanation has therefore been pushed to its boundary. The next object is not another geometry, but the question of how long a high-frequency signed Lamb bottom trace can persist in actual physical time, and whether the viscous \(K^{-2}\) time can combine with inter-shell transfer to yield a summable occupation estimate.

zh: 有界重叠局部 heat packing 与任意 \(\alpha>0\) 的精确谱矩常数；标准能量无条件关闭的是 \(\alpha=1\)。

zh: projected-Lamb 的精确时间演化保留全部壳间作用；归一化 signed quotient 中，局部方向 \(C\) 的径向增长精确消去，只剩 Lamb 加速度和角向转动。固定初始动能的全局光滑 2D3C NSE 解族证明，正号可以维持任意多个黏性时间，因此 sign-only 驻留常数不存在。固定正相对阈值仍在见证族上保持 \(O((\nu K^2)^{-1})\)；不过一组互不相交的临界 episode 证明，驻留本身不足以求和底边迹。临界驻留加统一加权 BV/crossing 可和性给出条件控制，而标准 Leray 能量尚未提供这项预算。

However, a collection of disjoint critical episodes proves that residence alone cannot sum the bottom trace. Critical residence plus uniform weighted-BV and crossing summability gives conditional control, while standard Leray energy has not supplied that budget.

R0.71H proves the projective heat identity for the unit direction on every positive-denominator branch and lists the soft-denominator defects exactly. A fixed-energy exact solution rules out only a pointwise angular-velocity energy bound; a nonconstant cutoff also shows that a positive source and viscous curvature can cancel at leading order. The direct variation estimate requires two more frequency powers than the available heat bulk, so the next step turns to the joint amplitude-weighted parabolic mismatch.

zh: R0.71G 排除统一 sign-only 驻留常数；R0.71H 证明正分母分支上的 projective heat identity，并列出软分母缺陷。R0.71I 进一步把振幅 BV 精确归约为各分支入口与单边联合生成。抽象共同热流的两个外部振幅面都可为零，尺度差仍按 \(K^2\) 增长；更强的对称八模 2D3C 全局光滑序列在严格分母和零入口下生成内部正脉冲。它只覆盖固定光滑径向双环分量，却已经否定用同一份 R0.71F physical-time heat volume 支付该分量的单边生成。完整 face-paid BV 和预设宽单环 frame 仍开放。
en: R0.71G rules out a uniform sign-only residence constant; R0.71H proves the projective heat identity on positive-denominator branches and records the soft-denominator defects. R0.71I further reduces the amplitude BV exactly to branch entrances and joint one-sided generation. Both outer amplitude faces of an abstract shared heat flow can vanish while the scale gap still grows like \(K^2\); more strongly, a globally smooth symmetric eight-mode 2D3C sequence generates an interior positive pulse with a strictly positive denominator and zero entrance. This covers only a fixed smooth radial two-annulus component, but it already rules out paying for that component's one-sided generation with the same R0.71F physical-time heat volume. The full face-paid BV and prescribed broad single-annulus frames remain open.

zh: R0.71I 的 2D3C 序列比此前点态反例更强：入口振幅恰为零，内部仍产生 \(O(1)\) 极限脉冲。因此同一份 heat volume 不能支付声明双环分量的正生成。不过这不是预设宽单环 frame 或完整 frame 求和的反例，更不是 integrated face-paid BV 的全面否定。
en: The R0.71I 2D3C sequence is stronger than the earlier pointwise counterexample: the entrance amplitude is exactly zero, yet an interior \(O(1)\) limiting pulse still forms. Thus the same heat volume cannot pay for positive generation in the stated two-annulus component. This is not, however, a counterexample for a prescribed broad single-annulus frame or for summation over the full frame, much less a wholesale disproof of the integrated face-paid BV.

zh: R0.71G 排除统一 sign-only 驻留常数；R0.71H 证明正分母分支上的 projective heat identity。R0.71I 把振幅 BV 精确归约为各分支入口、单边联合生成、时间面和刷新原子，并用零入口 2D3C 脉冲排除一个固定双环 component 的 heat-volume-only 支付。R0.71J 进一步证明，逐壳取正部以后，完整 frame 求和只留下 weighted endpoint telescope、黏性振幅质量和 negative-source defect。对 R0.71E §10.1 的完整 broad parent frame、每个固定 \(\nu>0\) 和所有充分大 dyadic \(K\)，全局光滑固定能量 2D3C 家族使正生成与同一 heat endpoint 的比值至少按 \(K^2\) 增长。frequency-only escape 已关闭；matched spatial cells、faces 和另一 NSE budget 仍开放。
en: R0.71G rules out a uniform sign-only residence constant, and R0.71H proves the projective heat identity on positive-denominator branches. R0.71I reduces amplitude BV exactly to branch entries, joint one-sided creation, time faces, and refresh atoms, and uses a zero-entry 2D3C pulse to rule out heat-volume-only payment for one fixed two-ring component. R0.71J further proves that after shellwise positive parts, the complete-frame sum leaves only the weighted endpoint telescope, viscous amplitude mass, and negative-source defect. For the complete R0.71E §10.1 broad parent frame, every fixed \(\nu>0\), and all sufficiently large dyadic \(K\), a globally smooth fixed-energy 2D3C family makes the ratio of positive creation to the same heat endpoint grow at least as \(K^2\). The frequency-only escape is closed; matched spatial cells, faces, and another NSE budget remain open.

zh: R0.71J 把 R0.71I 的单 component 量词推进到 R0.71E 已声明的完整 broad parent frequency frame：对每个固定 \(\nu>0\) 和所有充分大 dyadic \(K\)，正生成至少是 \(K^{-2}\)，同一 full-frame heat endpoint 至多是 \(K^{-4}\)。这关闭的是 frequency-only payment，不是 child refinement、matched spatial localization、integrated face-paid BV 或另一 NSE-specific budget 的全面否定。
en: R0.71J extends the R0.71I single-component quantifier to the complete broad parent frequency frame declared in R0.71E: for every fixed \(\nu>0\) and all sufficiently large dyadic \(K\), positive creation is at least \(K^{-2}\), while the same full-frame heat endpoint is at most \(K^{-4}\). This closes frequency-only payment; it is not a blanket rejection of child refinement, matched spatial localization, integrated face-paid BV, or another NSE-specific budget.

en: R0.71G–N sequentially check residence, the matched-cell heat gap, viscous fusion, the increment bridge, and the signed second jet. R0.71O proves that the soft quotient recovers the one-sided hard trace, while the Jordan face cost does not disappear automatically. R0.71P then identifies the positive-entry sum as a componentwise relaxed positive-entry measure: it is obtained by first taking the limit of the soft positive part shell–cell by shell–cell and then summing, and in general is not the positive Jordan part of the signed aggregate; there is no direct signed shell–cell cancellation within this positive measure. zh: R0.71O–P 依次恢复 soft quotient 的一侧 traces，并用 bounded overlap 与 \(\dot H^{-1}\) Lamb square sum 组成的一次 time-slice square-function estimate 吸收同刻 batch；R0.71Q 给出 finite conditional Jensen theorem，同时隔离 anchor、truncation、cover 与 H-envelope 四税。R0.71R 从 NSE 导出 localized observable 的 exact forced heat equation，并证明 finite conditional event-to-window theorem；统一 window lower height 与 essential same-observable overlap 明确保留为 hypotheses。\(\Gamma_\rho\) 是 upper comparison constant，\(1/\Gamma_\rho\) 编码 lower-charge strength。rho-dependent source ledger 显示：在 normalized zero-mean torus 上，rho=2 是最小 Leray-paid 指数；对 finite covariant event/window family，\(\Gamma_\rho^{\rm opt}\) 定义为 least admissible upper comparison constant，并在协变 integer/dyadic dilation 下按 lambda^rho 缩放。整数 Fourier 初始例只定义 first-jet surrogate Gamma_{2,jet}，不是 positive-time upper comparison constant 的下界。精确两阶判决只排除一参数 endpoint-square、termwise source-square certificate (3.3) 的无条件闭合，其他 Duhamel designs 与 signed / bilinear alternatives 保持开放。
en: R0.71O–P successively recover one-sided traces of the soft quotient, and a single time-slice square-function estimate formed from bounded overlap and the \(\dot H^{-1}\) Lamb square sum absorbs the same-time batch. R0.71Q gives the finite conditional Jensen theorem while isolating the four anchor, truncation, cover, and H-envelope taxes. R0.71R derives the exact forced heat equation for the localized observable from NSE and proves a finite conditional event-to-window theorem; uniform window lower height and essential same-observable overlap are explicitly retained as hypotheses. \(\Gamma_\rho\) is an upper comparison constant, and \(1/\Gamma_\rho\) encodes lower-charge strength. The rho-dependent source ledger shows that rho=2 is the minimal Leray-paid exponent on the normalized zero-mean torus; for a finite covariant event/window family, \(\Gamma_\rho^{\rm opt}\) is defined as the least admissible upper comparison constant and scales as lambda^rho under covariant integer/dyadic dilation. The integer Fourier initial example defines only the first-jet surrogate Gamma_{2,jet}, not a lower bound for the positive-time upper comparison constant. The exact two-order verdict rules out only unconditional closure of the one-parameter endpoint-square, termwise source-square certificate (3.3); other Duhamel designs and signed / bilinear alternatives remain open.

en: R0.71R reduces the gap in the one-parameter endpoint-square, termwise source-square certificate (3.3) to an exact two-order mismatch: under covariant integer/dyadic dilation, the optimal constant scales as lambda^rho and is invariant at rho=0, but the source ledger requires normalized \(L^2\)-Lamb plus palinstrophy; the minimal exponent for Leray payment is rho=2. The initial jet gives only the Gamma_{2,jet} surrogate, not a positive-time lower bound for Gamma_2. This method verdict does not exclude other Duhamel designs or signed, bilinear, or other scale-critical packet functionals.

zh: R0.71O–P 恢复 soft quotient 的一侧 traces，并用同刻 spatial batching 吸收有限 frame multiplicity；R0.71Q–R 给出带四税的 finite conditional Jensen theorem、localized forced heat equation、conditional incidence packing 和 rho=0/rho=2 source ledger。R0.71S 保留 entry direction，证明 finite conditional directional-packet payment：nonzero-mean packet 只有在 directional sampling coherence 与 complete indexed Bessel inequality 同时成立时才支付有限 entry family。critical packet 的对角范数平方是 \(\kappa_j^2\)，所以 \(B_{\rm crit}\ge\max\kappa_j^2\)，重复同一 packet \(N\) 次还要求 \(B_{\rm crit}\ge N\kappa_j^2\)；frozen-denominator backward-heat model 改变核形状但不移除该因子；variable \(Y\) 的归一化项未纳入这个线性模型。bounded bilinear kernel 若消去 constant mode，就看不见 constant leading trace 与 even positive touch；若保留 constant mode，就支付同一 \(\kappa_j^2\) 税。genuine NSE covariant family 进一步证明：只要目标包含 initial observation-boundary entry，scale-invariant entry atom 保持不变，而 bare \(\int\|L\|_{\dot H^{-1}}^2/Y\,dt\) 按 \(\lambda^{-2}\) 缩放，因而不存在 scale-uniform payment。该结论不覆盖 internal entries，不是所有 nonlinear signed identities 的 impossibility theorem，也不证明继续性或正则性。
en: R0.71O–P recovers one-sided traces of the soft quotient and uses same-time spatial batching to absorb finite frame multiplicity. R0.71Q–R gives a finite conditional Jensen theorem with four taxes, the localized forced heat equation, conditional incidence packing, and the rho=0/rho=2 source ledger. R0.71S retains the entry direction and proves finite conditional directional-packet payment: a nonzero-mean packet pays a finite entry family only when directional sampling coherence and the complete indexed Bessel inequality both hold. The squared diagonal norm of the critical packet is \(\kappa_j^2\), so \(B_{\rm crit}\ge\max\kappa_j^2\); repeating the same packet \(N\) times further requires \(B_{\rm crit}\ge N\kappa_j^2\). The frozen-denominator backward-heat model changes the kernel shape but does not remove this factor; the normalization terms from variable \(Y\) are not included in this linear model. If a bounded bilinear kernel cancels the constant mode, it cannot see a constant leading trace or an even positive touch; if it retains the constant mode, it pays the same \(\kappa_j^2\) tax. The genuine covariant NSE family further proves that when the target includes an initial observation-boundary entry, the scale-invariant entry atom remains fixed while the bare \(\int\|L\|_{\dot H^{-1}}^2/Y\,dt\) scales as \(\lambda^{-2}\), so no scale-uniform payment exists. This conclusion does not cover internal entries, is not an impossibility theorem for all nonlinear signed identities, and proves no continuation or regularity result.

en: R0.71O–P recovers one-sided traces of the soft quotient and uses same-time spatial batching to absorb finite frame multiplicity; R0.71Q–R gives finite conditional Jensen and incidence theorems. R0.71T then uses the forward local NSE flow map and a finite-dimensional IFT to construct a full-shell zero at a prescribed positive time: the event forcing is nonzero, so this is a genuine smooth internal simple positive entry. The finite trace-variation theorem retains the strong Lamb term, \(F_t\), \(Y_t\), and the repeated-direction Bessel ledgers.

en: R0.71U's zero-count-independent Hilbert sampling, classical all-shell second-time-jet theorem, Leray-level first row, and stronger recurrence row; exact unforced 2.5D prescribed finite recurrence; the absence of a uniform raw-count bound on the unit energy-enstrophy ball; and the shrinking-atom and R0.71T target-support boundaries.

zh: R0.71U 的正面结果是 zero-count-independent second-time-jet estimate。它对满足 \(\inf_KY>0\) 的 compact classical trajectory 成立，常数不依赖零点数、minimum separation 或 finite shell truncation。第一行有 normalized Leray–Lamb payment；第二行要求 \(\omega_t\) 与 \(L_t\)，ordinary Leray inequality 尚未关闭。
en: The positive result in R0.71U is the zero-count-independent second-time-jet estimate. It holds for a compact classical trajectory satisfying \(\inf_KY>0\), with a constant independent of the number of zeros, minimum separation, or finite shell truncation. The first row has a normalized Leray-Lamb payment; the second requires \(\omega_t\) and \(L_t\) and remains beyond the ordinary Leray inequality.

en: 01 · Seventeen research stages

en: 02 · Complete 86-section index

zh: 充分深的剪切数据包周围存在半径不缩小的临界横向正则球，完整线性化传播子也趋向自由热流。条件非线性解耦与每个固定光滑区间上的预解算子都可建立；但端点优化最多恢复经典 type-I 时间壳尺度，这条分支停在 R0.69F。
en: Around sufficiently deep shear data packets, there is a critical transverse regularity ball whose radius does not shrink, and the full linearized propagator converges to the free heat flow. Conditional nonlinear decoupling and a pre-resolvent on every fixed smooth interval can also be established; endpoint optimization, however, recovers at most the classical type-I time-shell scale. This branch stops at R0.69F.

zh: 打开最新节点 R0.71V
en: Open the latest node R0.71V

zh: 点态拉伸尖锐常数可由光滑无散场实现；方向扩散不是额外耗散，涡量差分优化仍回到经典六次代价，单个 Fourier 壳也可承载全部有符号拉伸。双增量物理环带恒等式随后成立。纯膨胀不能改善全空间比值；尺度比四的一参数两尺度静态族作为统一有利符号或严格抵消候选，最终被外向舍入区间证书完整排除。
en: Smooth divergence-free fields attain the sharp pointwise stretching constant; directional diffusion is not an additional dissipation, vorticity-increment optimization returns to the classical sixth-power cost, and a single Fourier shell can carry all signed stretching. The two-increment physical-annulus identity follows. Pure dilation cannot improve the whole-space ratio; an outward-rounded interval certificate ultimately excludes the scale-ratio-four one-parameter two-scale static family as a candidate for a uniform favorable sign or exact cancellation.

zh: 方向型有符号核相消、局部压力符号与裸截断的反例；真实压力源的 \(R^{-5}\) 远场衰减、局部应力交换子，以及 R0.69O 把领先压力时间余项降回二次 enstrophy 的闭合。
en: Counterexamples to directional signed-kernel cancellation, a local pressure sign, and bare truncation; \(R^{-5}\) far-field decay for the genuine pressure source; the local stress commutator; and the R0.69O closure that reduces the leading pressure-time remainder to the quadratic-enstrophy level.

zh: 负面边界是 fixed zero-level trace。weighted coarea 对二次 slope 产生三次时间 occupation；sine path 显示 level integral 与零层迹可以分离。真实无外力 2.5D NSE 序列又在固定 target/window 下使第二个 atom 相对所选 singleton target shell 的 first-time-jet row 按 \(q^2\) 增长；第一个 prescribed root 已另行支付。它没有证明 second-time coefficient sharp，也没有排除完整 global \(\nu^2\) baseline 或另一 dynamical charge。
en: The negative boundary is the fixed zero-level trace. Weighted coarea turns a quadratic slope into cubic time occupation; the sine path shows that the level integral and zero-level trace can separate. At fixed target and window, a genuine unforced 2.5D NSE sequence also makes the second atom grow by \(q^2\) relative to the first-time-jet row of the selected singleton target shell; the first prescribed root has been charged separately. This neither proves that the second-time coefficient is sharp nor excludes the complete global \(\nu^2\) baseline or another dynamical charge.

zh: 负面结论必须让 atom 相对带 \(\mathcal R_Y(K)\) 因子的完整账本保持非坍缩；正面结论需要新的 dynamical inequality，不能从 \(L^1\) level occupation 直接读取 distinguished zero-level boundary trace。R0.71W 仍不宣称继续性、奇性排除或全局正则性。
en: A negative conclusion must keep the atom noncollapsing relative to the complete ledger carrying the \(\mathcal R_Y(K)\) factor; a positive conclusion needs a new dynamical inequality and cannot read the distinguished zero-level boundary trace directly from \(L^1\) level occupation. R0.71W still claims no continuation, singularity exclusion, or global regularity.

zh: 复时间解析性在有限经典窗口上给出带四项代价的 Jensen 计数；局部 forced-heat 方程又给出 finite conditional incidence theorem。两者都是条件定理。anchor、截断、覆盖、包络、event height 和 overlap 尚未由 Leray 预算统一支付，endpoint-square certificate 留下精确两阶错配。
en: Complex-time analyticity gives a Jensen count with four charges on a finite classical window; the local forced-heat equation also gives a finite conditional incidence theorem. Both theorems are conditional. The anchor, truncation, cover, envelope, event height, and overlap have not yet been paid uniformly by the Leray budget, and the endpoint-square certificate leaves an exact two-power mismatch.

zh: 固定有界重叠族中的局部 heat packing 与任意 \(\alpha>0\) 的精确谱矩常数；标准能量无条件关闭的是 \(\alpha=1\)，不包含无限个独立空间尺度覆盖的无权求和。
en: Local heat packing in a fixed bounded-overlap family and exact spectral-moment constants for every \(\alpha>0\); standard energy closes \(\alpha=1\) unconditionally, but not an unweighted sum over infinitely many independent spatial-scale covers.

zh: 回顾截止节点：R0.71V
en: Recap endpoint: R0.71V

zh: 回顾截止时公开笔记：146
en: Public notes at recap endpoint: 146

zh: 即使主投影恒定、谱隙很强、标量框架交换子为零，协方差功仍可在相同 \(Q\) 下反号；现有能量机制只给时间 \(L^1\)。共同响应也不会自动产生壳层补偿。有符号细化留下非负缺陷，黏性和真实 NSE 初始迹能从零创造正功；完整物质热 tent 仍保留 \(k^2\) 临界代价。
en: Even with a constant leading projection, a strong spectral gap, and a zero scalar-frame commutator, covariance work can reverse sign at the same \(Q\); the available energy mechanism gives only time \(L^1\). A common response does not automatically create shell compensation. Signed refinement leaves a nonnegative defect, viscosity and a genuine NSE initial trace can create positive work from zero, and the complete material-heat tent still retains the critical \(k^2\) cost.

zh: 截至 R0.71V，没有新的无条件继续性判据，没有缩小所有潜在奇性解的集合，也没有证明有限时破裂。不能把 86 个节点解释成对千禧年问题完成了某个比例。
en: As of R0.71V, there is no new unconditional continuation criterion, no reduction of the set of all potential singular solutions, and no proof of finite-time breakdown. The 86 nodes cannot be interpreted as a percentage completion of the Millennium problem.
Cumulative recap · R0.61–R0.71V · 2026-08-26

zh: 六阶零时间谱、仿射提升和完整热核主投影依次被封闭。十阶及以上目标尾在声明的剪切包内可求和；八阶剩余关口最后给出一个源锁定、完整缺陷修正后的严格负系数。它仍是有限系数定理，不是全空间正则性结论。
en: The sixth-order zero-time spectrum, affine lift, and leading full-heat-kernel projection are closed in sequence. The target tail from order ten onward is summable within the stated shear packet; the remaining eighth-order gate ultimately yields a strictly negative source-locked coefficient after the full defect correction. This is still a finite-coefficient theorem, not a whole-space regularity result.

zh: 偏差高—高相关无隐藏 helicity 零结构、归一化协方差的精确演化与非单调黏性项、局部源—形状补偿的压力符号障碍、应变传播子拉回的条件数代价，以及有限高频盲标量观测的临界重建 no-go。
en: The absence of a hidden helicity-zero structure in deviatoric high-high correlations; exact normalized-covariance evolution with a nonmonotone viscous term; the pressure-sign obstruction to local source-shape compensation; the condition-number cost of pulling back by the strain propagator; and a critical-reconstruction no-go for finitely many high-frequency-blind scalar observations.

zh: 十七个阶段、86 个节点：从约化递推到 conditional incidence，再到 genuine internal entry、classical second-time-jet packing、Leray-paid excursion 与固定 target/window 的真实 NSE selected-singleton first-time-row obstruction；完整 ν² ledger 未排除。
en: Seventeen stages and 86 nodes: from reduced recurrences to conditional incidence, then to genuine internal entry, classical second-time-jet packing, Leray-paid excursions, and a genuine NSE selected-singleton first-time-row obstruction at a fixed target and window; the complete nu-squared ledger remains unexcluded.

zh: 收录节点：86
en: Included nodes: 86

zh: 双涡量增量的有符号物理环带恒等式、固定核心边界载荷的饱和、纯自相似膨胀下全空间比值不变、两尺度解耦极限，以及把尺度比四闭振幅静态族作为统一有利符号或严格抵消候选排除的证书。
en: The signed physical-annulus identity for two vorticity increments; saturation of the fixed-core boundary load; invariance of the whole-space ratio under pure self-similar dilation; the two-scale decoupling limit; and the certificate excluding the closed-amplitude scale-ratio-four static family as a candidate for a uniform favorable sign or exact cancellation.

zh: 四阶目标先被写成显式路径和，再经过全指标相关分解、有限状态提升和热加权周期审计。指定周期包的主谱投影严格非零，但结论仍属于始终光滑的不变剪切类，不是一般三维奇性机制。
en: The fourth-order target is first written as an explicit path sum, then treated by an all-index correlation decomposition, a finite-state lift, and a heat-weighted cycle audit. The leading spectral projection of the specified cycle packet is strictly nonzero, but the result remains inside an invariant shear class that is smooth for all time; it is not a mechanism for a general three-dimensional singularity.

zh: 完整 frame 拉伸账本中的裸幅值梯度消去、平方根残差边界、response-distance 核与临界 Besov \(q=3\) 界；rank-one area、正主特征值、强谱隙、相同协方差和恒定主投影都不足以决定 signed work。
en: Elimination of the bare amplitude gradient in the full-frame stretching ledger, the square-root residual boundary, the response-distance kernel, and the critical Besov \(q=3\) bound; rank-one area, a positive leading eigenvalue, a strong spectral gap, identical covariance, and a constant leading projection are all insufficient to determine signed work.

zh: 完整 Littlewood–Paley 框架的能量级交换子与周期投影条件继续性桥、过滤协方差演化、秩一扩散平衡、近秩一平方根亏损，以及低阶输入趋零而 palinstrophy majorant 发散的精确光滑剪切序列。
en: The energy-level commutator and periodic-projection conditional-continuation bridge for the full Littlewood–Paley frame; filtered-covariance evolution; rank-one diffusion balance; the near-rank-one square-root loss; and an exact smooth shear sequence whose lower-order inputs vanish while its palinstrophy majorant diverges.

zh: 完整物理时间账本和全局光滑 2D3C 解排除 sign-only 驻留定理。在 \(C\ne0\) 的 denominator component 上，单位 projective heat curvature 有精确恒等式；纯热流 \(G=0\) 才直接单调耗散，localized NSE 仍保留 source ratio，软分母还会产生径向缺陷。联合抛物账本把加权 BV 缺口压到入口迹和单边生成；零入口脉冲仍显示 heat volume 单独支付时少两阶频率。
en: The complete physical-time ledger and a globally smooth 2D3C solution rule out a sign-only residence theorem. On denominator components where \(C\ne0\), unit projective-heat curvature has an exact identity; only the pure heat flow \(G=0\) is directly monotone-dissipative, while the localized NSE retains a source ratio and the soft denominator adds a radial defect. The joint parabolic ledger reduces the weighted-BV gap to an entry trace and one-sided creation; a zero-entry pulse still shows a two-frequency-power deficit when heat volume alone is asked to pay.

zh: 下一有限任务移除或平衡 decoupled background，并把 fixed-target high-frequency events 与下列完整第一行账本比较：
en: The next finite task removes or balances the decoupled background and compares fixed-target high-frequency events with the following complete first-row ledger:

zh: 在 \(C\ne0\) denominator component 上的单位 projective heat curvature identity、软分母缺陷和 \(3\pi/(8\sqrt\varepsilon)\) 线性交叉；纯热流 \(G=0\) 才直接单调耗散，localized NSE 仍带 source ratio。
en: The unit projective-heat-curvature identity on denominator components where \(C\ne0\), the soft-denominator defect, and the \(3\pi/(8\sqrt\varepsilon)\) linear crossing; only the pure heat flow \(G=0\) is directly monotone-dissipative, while the localized NSE still carries a source ratio.

zh: 在 compact classical window 且 \(0<\inf_KY\le\sup_KY<\infty\) 的假设下，Hilbert 零点采样给出 zero-count-independent all-shell second-time-jet theorem。对每个 \(N\) 和每个给定 finite time set，都可另选一条真实无外力 2.5D NSE 解实现 recurrence；这不是单条解的无限回返轨道，且 bounded energy–enstrophy class 上没有统一 raw count。Leray–Hopf 层级能够支付 right-rooted compact-shell excursion height；左端已为正的 component 另付 initial trace。固定 target/window 的另一列真实解使第二个 root atom 相对所选 singleton target shell 的 first-time-jet row 按 \(q^2\) 增长，而 second-time row 仍可支付；第一个 prescribed root 已另行支付。这没有排除完整 global \(\nu^2\) baseline 或另一 dynamical charge。
en: On a compact classical window under \(0<\inf_KY\le\sup_KY<\infty\), Hilbert-space zero sampling gives a zero-count-independent all-shell second-time-jet theorem. For every \(N\) and every prescribed finite time set, one may choose a different genuine unforced 2.5D NSE solution realizing the recurrence; this is not a single trajectory with infinitely many returns, and the bounded energy–enstrophy class has no uniform raw-count bound. The Leray–Hopf level pays right-rooted compact-shell excursion height; a component already positive at the left endpoint requires a separate initial trace. At fixed target and window, another sequence of genuine solutions makes the second root atom grow by \(q^2\) relative to the first-time-jet row of the selected singleton target shell, while the second-time row still pays; the first prescribed root has been charged separately. This does not exclude the complete global \(\nu^2\) baseline or another dynamical charge.

zh: 在 directional sampling coherence、noncollapsing sampling window 与 critical Bessel hypotheses 下，finite directional-packet implication 成立；看见常值 entry 与频率一致的 Bessel payment 不能同时免费得到。R0.71T 用有限维隐函数定理构造真实正时间内部 entry，排除 bare normalized Leray–Lamb time payment，并给出有限 outgoing-coarea 表示和条件 trace-variation 账本。
en: Under directional sampling coherence, a noncollapsing sampling window, and the critical-Bessel hypotheses, the finite directional-packet implication holds; a frequency-coherent Bessel payment and the ability to see a constant entry still cannot both be obtained for free. R0.71T uses a finite-dimensional implicit-function theorem to construct a genuine positive-time internal entry, rules out the bare normalized Leray–Lamb time payment, and gives a finite outgoing-coarea representation together with a conditional trace-variation ledger.

zh: 在声明的四阶临界振幅下，一个周期目标的完整 Picard 级数被严格组装：四阶修正保留非零极限，六阶、八阶与十阶以上项在该比较尺度消失。由于整个构造仍在全局光滑剪切类中，它关闭的是系数问题，不是奇点问题。
en: At the stated quartic-critical amplitude, the complete Picard series of one periodic target is assembled rigorously: the fourth-order correction retains a nonzero limit, while the sixth-, eighth-, and all terms of order at least ten vanish on that comparison scale. Because the whole construction remains in a globally smooth shear class, it closes a coefficient problem, not a singularity problem.

zh: 这页接在 R0.00–R0.60 的阶段回顾之后，整理 R0.61 到 R0.71V 的 86 个研究节点。我按时间记录每一段实际证明了什么、哪条设想被具体反例或尺度分析排除，以及哪些条件还没有从 Navier–Stokes 方程中推出。
en: This page follows the R0.00–R0.60 phase recap and organizes the research nodes from R0.61 through R0.71V, 86 in total. I record chronologically what each phase actually proved, which proposals were excluded by concrete counterexamples or scale analysis, and which conditions still have not been derived from the Navier–Stokes equations.

zh: 正面结果是 Leray–Hopf compact-shell excursion theorem：right-rooted components 的归一化高度 \(H_E^2=\kappa_j^{-6}h_E^2/(\ell Y_E)\) 可统一求和，并给出 amplitude-thresholded excursion count；左端已为正的 component 需要另付 initial trace。若另有统一 \(D_E\ge d_0>0\)，它会把 R0.71U 的 root atoms 压回 first-time row；该 noncollapse 不是无条件输入。
en: The positive result is the Leray–Hopf compact-shell excursion theorem: normalized heights \(H_E^2=\kappa_j^{-6}h_E^2/(\ell Y_E)\) are uniformly summable over right-rooted components and give an amplitude-thresholded excursion count; a component already positive at the left endpoint requires a separate initial trace. An additional uniform \(D_E\ge d_0>0\) would charge the R0.71U root atoms back to the first-time row; that noncollapse is not an unconditional input.

zh: 只依赖方向的核相消、局部压力符号和裸空间截断都没有普适收益。真实速度生成结构把远场压力 Hessian 改善到 \(R^{-5}\)；空间交换子和耗散插值又把领先压力余项降回二次 enstrophy 层级。到 R0.69O，压力时间指数已经闭合，剩余主障碍转向三维涡量拉伸。
en: Direction-only kernel cancellation, a local pressure sign, and bare spatial truncation give no universal gain. The genuine velocity-generated structure improves the far-field pressure Hessian to \(R^{-5}\); a spatial commutator and dissipative interpolation then reduce the leading pressure remainder to the quadratic-enstrophy level. By R0.69O, the pressure-time exponent is closed and the main remaining obstruction has shifted to three-dimensional vorticity stretching.

zh: 逐壳正生成在完整 frame 中留下非负缺陷，匹配空间小区也不消除 \(K^2\) 热支付。黏性 collar 必须与局部 Laplacian 交换子精确融合；环带 Lamb 交换子虽有速度增量公式，直接绝对值估计仍产生四行临界账本。完整标量中的正平方最后被局部 enstrophy 精确抵消。
en: Shellwise positive creation leaves a nonnegative defect in the full frame, and matched spatial cells do not remove the \(K^2\) heat payment. The viscous collar must be fused exactly with the local Laplacian commutator; although the annular Lamb commutator has a velocity-increment formula, direct absolute-value estimates still produce a four-row critical ledger. The positive square in the complete scalar is ultimately canceled exactly by local enstrophy.

zh: directional sampling coherence、noncollapsing sampling window 与 critical Bessel hypotheses 下的 finite directional-packet implication、critical Bessel diagonal 与 repeated-packet lower bounds、necessary directional Carleson condition、backward-heat kernel 和 bounded bilinear constant-mode dichotomy；R0.71S 的 genuine NSE scaling no-go 只覆盖 initial observation-boundary entry。
en: The finite directional-packet implication under directional sampling coherence, a noncollapsing sampling window, and the critical-Bessel hypotheses; the critical Bessel diagonal and repeated-packet lower bounds; the necessary directional Carleson condition; the backward-heat kernel; and the bounded bilinear constant-mode dichotomy. The genuine NSE scaling no-go in R0.71S covers only an initial observation-boundary entry.

zh: excursion height 已由 Leray 支付，fixed zero-level slope 仍是边界迹
en: Excursion height is paid by Leray; the fixed zero-level slope remains a boundary trace

zh: Hodge 投影把 stretching 与 transport–filter commutator 压成同一个 projected-Lamb 注入。全局和固定有界重叠族中的局部热体积可由 Leray 能量支付；标准能量无条件关闭的是 \(\alpha=1\)，不包含无限个独立空间尺度覆盖的无权求和。但精确光滑 2D3C 解保留 \(K^2\) 底边代价，内部 one-block 缩放也排除仅靠几何得到 \(o(r^{-2})\)。临界 \(Cr^{-2}\) 被饱和，没有被否定。
en: Hodge projection compresses stretching and the transport–filter commutator into the same projected-Lamb injection. Global heat volume and local heat volume in a fixed bounded-overlap family can be paid by Leray energy; standard energy closes \(\alpha=1\) unconditionally, but not an unweighted sum over infinitely many independent spatial-scale covers. Exact smooth 2D3C solutions nevertheless retain the \(K^2\) bottom-trace cost, and internal one-block scaling rules out obtaining \(o(r^{-2})\) from geometry alone. The critical \(Cr^{-2}\) is saturated, not disproved.

zh: R0.00–R0.60 的内容保留在上一份阶段回顾中。R0.60 的结论是：完整 Fourier–Leray 结构与高阶计算可以继续做，但还没有控制一般三维解的临界量。后面的 86 个节点沿着这个缺口推进。
en: The R0.00–R0.60 material remains in the preceding phase recap. The R0.60 conclusion was that the full Fourier–Leray structure and higher-order computations could continue, but still did not control a critical quantity for general three-dimensional solutions. The following 86 nodes advance along that gap.

en: Post-R0.60 research recap: a chronological organization of the research nodes from R0.61 through R0.71V, 86 in total, recording the route from reduced recurrence to projected-Lamb heat volume, positive-entry batching, the conditional incidence theorem, the second-time jet, Leray-paid excursions, and the fixed zero-level boundary.

u^2\) baseline and complete projected rotational charge, while leaving the \(D^{1/3}\) endpoint open. R0.71X fixes sufficiently small \(\delta\) and takes \(A=\delta q^2\) inside the uniform IFT neighborhood: ECT zero counting, compact \(C^1\) separation, and a half-line integrating factor together prove that the only real-time target roots are the two declared simple roots. The family satisfies \(D\asymp\delta^2q^6\), complete \(\mathcal J\asymp\delta^2q^2\), and \(
u^2\le\Lambda_1\le C(
u^2+\delta^2)\), so \(\mathcal J/(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1)\asymp\delta^{4/3}\). For fixed \(\delta\), the ratio diverges for \( eta<1/3\), saturates for \( eta=1/3\), and decays for \( eta>1/3\).

zh: R0.71U 给出 zero-count-independent all-shell second-time-jet theorem 与 finite prescribed recurrence。R0.71V 把第一行账本转成 Leray–Hopf right-rooted excursion-height packing，并分离 level integral 与 fixed zero-level atom。R0.71W 排除 data-uniform complete first-row bound，R0.71X 在 fixed-dimensional small-coupling family 内补齐 complete roots 并达到 \(D^{1/3}\) endpoint。R0.71Y 证明 bounded observation coupling 下 selected growing-root ratio 至多为 \(C\nu^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}/N\)。R0.71Z 不再计数根：复值 \(W^{2,1}\) 函数的 BV 零点斜率引理、实剪切三角系统的 exact contraction 与 dissipative target row 直接控制全部 exact roots 的 squared-slope mass；把付款区间扩到 launch 后，\(\mathcal R_Y\) 又消去逐根 enstrophy floor，给出 \(C\nu^{-2}M^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})\) 的 complete ratio。bounded coupling 下该量按 \(M^{-2}\) 消失；结论只覆盖声明的 triangular class。
en: R0.71U gives a zero-count-independent all-shell second-time-jet theorem and finite prescribed recurrence. R0.71V turns the first-row ledger into Leray–Hopf right-rooted excursion-height packing and separates the level integral from the fixed zero-level atom. R0.71W rules out the data-uniform complete first-row bound, and R0.71X completes the roots and reaches the \(D^{1/3}\) endpoint inside a fixed-dimensional small-coupling family. R0.71Y proves that the selected growing-root ratio is at most \(C\nu^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}/N\) under bounded observation coupling. R0.71Z stops counting roots: a BV zero-slope lemma for complex \(W^{2,1}\) functions, exact contraction of the real-shear triangular system, and a dissipative target row directly control the squared-slope mass of all exact roots. Extending the payment interval to launch lets \(\mathcal R_Y\) remove the rootwise enstrophy floor and gives the complete ratio \(C\nu^{-2}M^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})\). It vanishes as \(M^{-2}\) under bounded coupling; the conclusion covers only the declared triangular class.

zh: R0.71X 在固定维 small-coupling family 内达到 \(D^{1/3}\) endpoint，R0.71Y 排除了仅靠 selected growing roots 获得增益。R0.71Z 进一步表明，在同一类实剪切三角系统中，即使计入全部 exact roots，complete squared-slope mass 仍可不经 root count 直接支付；launch-inclusive mixed window 也移除了 matched root-time floors。bounded coupling 下 normalized complete ratio 至多为 \(C\nu^{-2}M^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})\)。
en: R0.71X reaches the \(D^{1/3}\) endpoint inside a fixed-dimensional small-coupling family, and R0.71Y rules out a gain from selected growing roots alone. R0.71Z further shows that, in the same real-shear triangular system, the complete squared-slope mass can be paid directly without counting roots; a launch-inclusive mixed window also removes the matched root-time floors. Under bounded coupling, the normalized complete ratio is at most \(C\nu^{-2}M^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})\).

zh: R0.71Z 的 complete all-root closure：复值 \(W^{2,1}\) 零点斜率质量由首个斜率与 \(\|g'\|_\infty\int|g''|\) 控制；在声明的 real-shear triangular system 中，exact contraction、目标行变差和黏性支付给出与根数无关的 all-root estimate。付款区间包含 launch 后，\(\mathcal R_Y\) 把逐根分母换成一次 \(\sup Y\)，从而在 bounded coupling 下得到 \(M^{-2}\) suppression。fixed observation window 的 retention 可以指数消失；strong coupling 与 shrinking layer 仍开放。
en: R0.71Z's complete all-root closure: the zero-slope mass of a complex \(W^{2,1}\) function is controlled by the first slope and \(\|g'\|_\infty\int|g''|\). In the declared real-shear triangular system, exact contraction, target-row variation, and viscous payment give an all-root estimate independent of the root count. Once the payment interval contains launch, \(\mathcal R_Y\) replaces the rootwise denominators by one \(\sup Y\), yielding \(M^{-2}\) suppression under bounded coupling. Fixed-observation-window retention can vanish exponentially; strong coupling and a shrinking layer remain open.

zh: 同一 real-shear triangular lattice 的 complete-root 上界可按观察层内的实际暴露支付：令 \(\eta=|\delta|\Omega\)、\(I=[A,A+L]\)，则 \(\ell_2(I)\le\min\{L,C_\kappa\}\)，normalized launch-inclusive ledger 至多为 \(C\nu^{-2}e^{2\lambda_0L}M^{-2}\eta^{4/3}[4+\eta\min\{L,C_\kappa\}]\)。当 \(\eta=M^\alpha\)、\(L=M^{-\beta}\) 时，这个充分上界在 \(\alpha<\min\{3/2,(6+3\beta)/7\}\) 内消失。有限支撑 launch 可取 \(A_0=0\)，但 normalized ledger 必须从 reference launch 开始；只有 \(A=A_0=0\) 时观察层与付款层相同。
en: The complete-root upper bound for the same real-shear triangular lattice can be paid by the actual exposure inside the observation layer: let \(\eta=|\delta|\Omega\) and \(I=[A,A+L]\). When \(\eta=M^\alpha\) and \(L=M^{-\beta}\), this sufficient upper bound vanishes for \(\alpha<\min\{3/2,(6+3\beta)/7\}\). Finite-support launch allows \(A_0=0\), but the normalized ledger must start at the reference launch; the observation and payment layers coincide only when \(A=A_0=0\).

zh: exact Bessel 构造说明，即使 observation layer 缩到 \(O(R^{-3})\)，前 \(R\) 个 simple roots 仍可留下对数 rescaled target-row mass；相应物理 \(x\)-导数质量多一个 \(\delta_R^2\) 因子。因此 \(\eta\)-independent rescaled target-row all-root 常数不存在。它没有证明 normalized nonlinear ledger 发散，也没有控制 full nonlinear rotational charge。结论仍限于声明的 triangular lattice，不是一般 NSE 的 complete atom theorem。
en: The exact Bessel construction shows that, even when the observation layer shrinks to \(O(R^{-3})\), the first \(R\) simple roots can retain logarithmic rescaled target-row mass; the corresponding physical \(x\)-derivative mass carries one additional factor \(\delta_R^2\). The conclusion remains confined to the declared triangular lattice and is not a general NSE complete-atom theorem.

zh: R0.68A 的十阶及以上目标尾求和，以及 R0.68B 系列的八阶有限关口。R0.68B-2 是明确标为“进行中”的中间页；d/e 与 f/g/h 才补齐严格导数、主根质量和完整缺陷修正，最终证明一个固定八阶系数严格为负。这些都是源与构造族锁定的系数结论。
en: R0.68A sums the target tail from order ten onward, while the R0.68B series treats the finite eighth-order gate. R0.68B-2 is an intermediate page explicitly marked “in progress”; only d/e and f/g/h supply the rigorous derivative, leading root mass, and full defect correction, ultimately proving that one fixed eighth-order coefficient is strictly negative. These coefficient conclusions are locked to their sources and construction families.

zh: R0.70A 的非显式比例邻域、共同短时连续性与移动标签恒等式；显式比例区间没有认证，诊断 pilot 不能升级为证书。R0.70B–I 随后给出匹配尺度反桥、真实小数据 signed cancellation、固定分辨率负部障碍、Yu remainder 横截性、相邻源伸缩缺陷、核心矩变化与尖锐 \(s^{-1/2}\) 时间 Hardy 核；frozen-low sector 闭合，moving-low 与 deviatoric diagonal 仍开放。
en: R0.70A gives a non-explicit ratio neighborhood, common short-time continuity, and the moving-label identity; no explicit ratio interval is certified, and the diagnostic pilot cannot be promoted to a certificate. R0.70B–I then gives the matched-scale anti-bridge, genuine small-data signed cancellation, the fixed-resolution negative-part obstruction, Yu-remainder transversality, the adjacent-source dilation defect, core-moment variation, and the sharp temporal Hardy kernel \(s^{-1/2}\). The frozen-low sector closes, while the moving-low and deviatoric-diagonal sectors remain open.

zh: R0.70A 只由比例四的严格余量推出非显式开邻域和共同短时连续性；诊断 pilot 的 \(3.9<\rho<4.1\) 不是认证区间。移动环带标签本身也不会给出边界控制。匹配尺度、动态符号、固定尺度覆盖、单壳奇偶结构、仿射一阶展开、相邻源差分与核心矩变化随后被检查。冻结低频部分可由能量控制；移动低频与偏差对角项仍受临界时间 Hardy 核限制。
en: R0.70A derives only a non-explicit open neighborhood and common short-time continuity from the strict margin at ratio four; the diagnostic pilot interval \(3.9<\rho<4.1\) is not certified. A moving annulus label also supplies no boundary control by itself. Matched scales, dynamic signs, fixed-scale coverings, single-shell parity, affine first-order expansion, adjacent-source differences, and core-moment variation are checked afterward. Energy controls the frozen low-frequency part; the moving low frequencies and deviatoric diagonal remain limited by the critical temporal Hardy kernel.

zh: R0.70A–R0.72C 已公开并封存版本
en: R0.70A–R0.72C published and archived releases

zh: R0.71U 给出 zero-count-independent all-shell second-time-jet theorem；finite prescribed recurrence 的量词是对每个 \(N\) 和给定有限时刻集合另选一条 exact 解，不是一条轨道无限回返。R0.71V 把第一行账本转成 Leray–Hopf right-rooted excursion-height packing，并分离 level integral 与 fixed zero-level atom。R0.71W 排除 data-uniform complete first-row bound，R0.71X 在 fixed-dimensional small-coupling family 内补齐 complete roots 并达到 \(D^{1/3}\) endpoint。R0.71Y 证明 bounded observation coupling 下 selected growing-root ratio 至多为 \(C\nu^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}/N\)。R0.71Z 不再计数根：复值 \(W^{2,1}\) 函数的 BV 零点斜率引理、实剪切三角系统的 exact contraction 与 dissipative target row 直接控制全部 exact roots 的 squared-slope mass；把付款区间扩到 launch 后，\(\mathcal R_Y\) 又消去逐根 enstrophy floor，给出 \(C\nu^{-2}M^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})\) 的 complete ratio。bounded coupling 下该量按 \(M^{-2}\) 消失；结论只覆盖声明的 triangular class。
en: R0.71U gives a zero-count-independent all-shell second-time-jet theorem; finite prescribed recurrence means that, for each \(N\) and each prescribed finite set of times, a separate exact solution is chosen, not that one trajectory returns infinitely often. R0.71V converts the first-row ledger into Leray–Hopf right-rooted excursion-height packing and separates the level integral from the fixed zero-level atom. R0.71W rules out a data-uniform complete first-row bound, and R0.71X closes complete roots in a fixed-dimensional small-coupling family and reaches the \(D^{1/3}\) endpoint. R0.71Y proves that, under bounded observation coupling, the selected growing-root ratio is at most \(C\nu^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}/N\). R0.71Z no longer counts roots: a BV zero-slope lemma for complex-valued \(W^{2,1}\) functions, exact contraction for the real-shear triangular system, and the dissipative target row directly control the squared-slope mass of all exact roots. Extending the payment interval back to launch lets \(\mathcal R_Y\) remove the rootwise enstrophy floor and gives the complete ratio \(C\nu^{-2}M^{-2}\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})\). Under bounded coupling, this quantity vanishes as \(M^{-2}\); the conclusion covers only the stated triangular class.

zh: R0.72B 的 \(M^{-10/3}\) 是 exact-launch coherent family 的改进率。R0.72C 证明它不能 phase-uniform 保持：任意物理相位在正确的共轭配对模型中仍受 \(M^{-8/3}\) 上界，而 Rudin–Shapiro 符号族使这个代数前因子达到同阶。固定正时间的热参与率再把 tail 压到 \(M^{-3}\)，但 pre-ledger 仍不可删除。
en: The \(M^{-10/3}\) rate in R0.72B is an improvement for the exact-launch coherent family. R0.72C proves that it cannot persist phase-uniformly: arbitrary physical phases in the correct conjugate-paired model still satisfy an \(M^{-8/3}\) upper bound, and the Rudin–Shapiro sign family attains the same order for this algebraic prefactor. At fixed positive time, heat participation further compresses the tail to \(M^{-3}\), but the pre-ledger still cannot be removed.

zh: R0.72C · 任意物理相位、热参与率与尖锐 phase-free 尺度
en: R0.72C · Arbitrary physical phases, heat participation, and sharp phase-free scales

zh: R0.72C 的 arbitrary-physical-phase extension：相反位移必须携带 \(w_l\) 与 \(\overline{w_l}\)，不能把旧公式直接复系数化。标量 slope estimate 对每个实 \(\delta\) 成立；target-row root-mass theorem 只在 \(\delta\ne0\) 时成立。联合 participation inequality 给出 exact-launch phase-uniform \(M^{-8/3}\) 与固定正时间 tail \(M^{-3}\)；Rudin–Shapiro 与同相族分别使这两个代数前因子达到同阶。它们不是 actual root-mass lower bounds，也不触及一般三维正则性。
en: R0.72C extends the model to arbitrary physical phases: opposite shifts must carry \(w_l\) and \(\overline{w_l}\), rather than directly complexifying the old formula. The scalar slope estimate holds for every real \(\delta\); the target-row root-mass theorem holds only when \(\delta\ne0\). The joint participation inequality gives the exact-launch phase-uniform scale \(M^{-8/3}\) and the fixed-positive-time tail scale \(M^{-3}\); the Rudin–Shapiro and phase-aligned families respectively attain these two algebraic prefactors to the same order. They are not actual root-mass lower bounds and do not address general three-dimensional regularity.

zh: R0.72D · 高频平移 Rudin–Shapiro 与真实 normalized saturation
en: R0.72D · High-frequency shifted Rudin–Shapiro and genuine normalized saturation

zh: R0.72D 的 shifted Rudin–Shapiro dynamical saturation：\(r_j=M+j\) 的热权 multiplier 满足 \(\int\|V_M\|\lesssim M^{-3/2}\)、\(\int\|V_M\|^2\lesssim M^{-1}\)；\(\eta\asymp M^2\) 时仍有 bounded Dyson exposure。一个 \(O(M^{-1/2})\) launch adjustment 在 \(\tau_M=M^{-3}\) 产生 exact simple interior root，slope 为 \(M\) 量级。匹配 background 与 full-frequency projected charge 给 bounded \(\mathcal R_Y\) 和 \(\Lambda_1\)，从而 complete normalized ledger 有正下界。该比值不发散，结论仍限于 exact triangular class。
en: R0.72D shifted Rudin–Shapiro dynamical saturation: the heat-weighted multiplier for \(r_j=M+j\) satisfies \(\int\|V_M\|\lesssim M^{-3/2}\) and \(\int\|V_M\|^2\lesssim M^{-1}\); the Dyson exposure remains bounded when \(\eta\asymp M^2\). An \(O(M^{-1/2})\) launch adjustment produces an exact simple interior root at \(\tau_M=M^{-3}\), with slope of order \(M\). The matched background and full-frequency projected charge give bounded \(\mathcal R_Y\) and \(\Lambda_1\), so the complete normalized ledger has a positive lower bound. The ratio does not diverge, and the conclusion remains confined to the exact triangular class.

zh: 这页接在 R0.00–R0.60 的阶段回顾之后，整理 R0.61 到 R0.72E 的 95 个研究节点。我按时间记录每一段实际证明了什么、哪条设想被具体反例或尺度分析排除，以及哪些条件还没有从 Navier–Stokes 方程中推出。这里的节点状态描述证据类型，不把版本封存误写成阶段目标已经解决。
en: This page follows the R0.00–R0.60 phase recap and organizes the research nodes from R0.61 through R0.72E, 95 in total. It records chronologically what each segment actually proved, which proposals were ruled out by a concrete counterexample or scaling analysis, and which conditions have not been derived from the Navier–Stokes equations. Node status describes the evidence type and does not mistake an archived release for a solved phase objective.

zh: Feynman–Kac 把完整 \(A_q^{-1}\) action 化成 kinetic Brownian path 的振荡平均；驻相和 Kusuoka–Stroock 的定量漂移括号密度界给 \(Q_{\delta,q_0}\lesssim\log(2+\delta)/\delta\)。取 \(\delta_R=R^4\)、\(P_R=q_0^2\delta_R\)、\(S_R^2=\delta_R/\log(2+\delta_R)\)，则 \(D_R\asymp\delta_R^2\)、\(\Lambda_1=O(1)\)、\(\mathcal J_{\rm all}\gtrsim\delta_R\)，从而 normalized ratio 至少按 \(R^{4/3}\) 发散。这个结果排除一条候选中间估计，但所有解仍全局光滑。
en: Feynman–Kac converts the complete \(A_q^{-1}\) action into an oscillatory average along kinetic Brownian paths; stationary phase and the quantitative drift-bracket density bound of Kusuoka–Stroock give \(Q_{\delta,q_0}\lesssim\log(2+\delta)/\delta\). With \(\delta_R=R^4\), \(P_R=q_0^2\delta_R\), and \(S_R^2=\delta_R/\log(2+\delta_R)\), one has \(D_R\asymp\delta_R^2\), \(\Lambda_1=O(1)\), and \(\mathcal J_{\rm all}\gtrsim\delta_R\), so the normalized ratio diverges at least as \(R^{4/3}\). This excludes a candidate intermediate estimate, while every solution remains globally smooth.

zh: R0.00–R0.60 的内容保留在上一份阶段回顾中。R0.60 的结论是：完整 Fourier–Leray 结构与高阶计算可以继续做，但还没有控制一般三维解的临界量。后面的 95 个节点沿着这个缺口推进；R0.70A–R0.72E 的 57 个版本已经公开并封存，但其中仍包含条件定理、反例、有限诊断和开放缺口。
en: The R0.00–R0.60 material remains in the preceding phase recap. The R0.60 conclusion was that the complete Fourier–Leray structure and higher-order calculations could continue, but the critical quantity for general three-dimensional solutions was not controlled. The following 95 nodes advance along this gap; the releases from R0.70A through R0.72E number 57 and are published and archived, while still containing conditional theorems, counterexamples, finite diagnostics, and open gaps.

After the full-frequency \(H^{-1}\) rotational charge, genuine data cost, and fixed-interval enstrophy are all included, a one-carrier exact triangular family that remains globally smooth still makes the complete-root ledger diverge relative to \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\).

zh: R0.72E · 单载波 supercritical ledger 与候选 \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) payment 失效
en: R0.72E · One-carrier supercritical ledger and failure of the candidate \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) payment

zh: R0.72E 的 one-carrier supercritical no-go：固定整数 \(q_0>R_*\) 后，R0.72A 的 Bessel 根通过精确 diagonal conjugacy 保持。Feynman–Kac、\(A_q^{-1}\) 驻相与定量 parabolic Hörmander density 给 full-frequency action \(Q_{\delta,q_0}\lesssim\log(2+\delta)/\delta\)。在 \(\delta_R=R^4\)、\(S_R^2=\delta_R/\log(2+\delta_R)\) 下，完整数据、固定区间 enstrophy contrast 与 rotational charge 都被支付，而 \(\mathcal J_{\rm all}/(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1)\gtrsim R^{4/3}\)。这严格排除候选 \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) complete-root 中间估计，但不产生爆破或一般正则性结论。
en: R0.72E one-carrier supercritical no-go: after fixing an integer \(q_0>R_*\), exact diagonal conjugacy preserves the Bessel roots from R0.72A. Feynman–Kac, \(A_q^{-1}\) stationary phase, and a quantitative parabolic Hörmander density bound give the full-frequency action \(Q_{\delta,q_0}\lesssim\log(2+\delta)/\delta\). With \(\delta_R=R^4\) and \(S_R^2=\delta_R/\log(2+\delta_R)\), the complete data, fixed-interval enstrophy contrast, and rotational charge are all paid, while \(\mathcal J_{\rm all}/(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1)\gtrsim R^{4/3}\). This rigorously excludes the candidate \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) complete-root intermediate estimate, but yields neither blowup nor a general regularity result.

zh: 对 \(w_{\beta,\gamma}(s)=s^{-\beta}[1+\log(1/s)]^\gamma\)，Leray 能量在 \(\beta<1/2\) 时支付对应 projected-Lamb action；仅凭 \(Y\in L_t^1\)，这个 \(1/2\) 端点不能改善。R0.72E exact family 则给 \(Q_{\beta,\gamma}\asymp\delta^{\beta-1}(\log\delta)^\gamma\)，使 selected-root ratio 按 \(\delta^{1/3-\beta}(\log\delta)^{1-\gamma}\) 缩放。最小共同边界因此是 \(w_*(s)=s^{-1/3}[1+\log(1/s)]\)，且 \(\|w_*\|_2^2=75\)。
en: For \(w_{\beta,\gamma}(s)=s^{-\beta}[1+\log(1/s)]^\gamma\), Leray energy pays for the corresponding projected-Lamb action when \(\beta<1/2\); from \(Y\in L_t^1\) alone, this \(1/2\) endpoint cannot be improved. The R0.72E exact family gives \(Q_{\beta,\gamma}\asymp\delta^{\beta-1}(\log\delta)^\gamma\), so the selected-root ratio scales as \(\delta^{1/3-\beta}(\log\delta)^{1-\gamma}\). The minimal common boundary is therefore \(w_*(s)=s^{-1/3}[1+\log(1/s)]\), with \(\|w_*\|_2^2=75\).

zh: R0.72F 对 \(w_{\beta,\gamma}(s)=s^{-\beta}[1+\log(1/s)]^\gamma\) 分别计算 Leray payment 与 selected Bessel obstruction：能量支付要求 \(\beta<1/2\)，exact family 强制 \(\beta>1/3\)，或在端点取 \(\gamma\ge1\)。最小共同边界是 \(w_*(s)=s^{-1/3}[1+\log(1/s)]\)。

zh: R0.72G 的 exact one-carrier complete-root theorem：实相位 gauge、两个目标行恒等式与 Rolle–BV 归约给出根数无关的 \(G_{\rm all}\lesssim\log\delta\)；selected Bessel roots 给匹配下界。原始幅度序列上 \(\mathcal J_{\rm all}\asymp D^{1/3}\Lambda_{1,*}\asymp\delta\)，所以 critical-log payment 对完整根集尖锐。结论只覆盖固定 \(q_0\)、实单载波、\(\delta\ge1\) 与 \(A_\delta=O(\delta)\)；多载波和一般三维传递仍开放。
en: R0.72G exact one-carrier complete-root theorem: the real-phase gauge, two target-row identities, and the Rolle–BV reduction give \(G_{\rm all}\lesssim\log\delta\) independently of root count, while the selected Bessel roots give a matching lower bound. On the original amplitude sequence, \(\mathcal J_{\rm all}\asymp D^{1/3}\Lambda_{1,*}\asymp\delta\), so the critical-log payment is sharp on the complete root set. The conclusion covers only fixed \(q_0\), one real carrier, \(\delta\ge1\), and \(A_\delta=O(\delta)\); multi-carrier and general three-dimensional transfer remain open.

zh: R0.72G 的定理限于精确实单载波三角形 2.5D 光滑解族。本回顾没有证明三维 Navier–Stokes 的全局光滑性或有限时破裂；Clay 正式问题仍然开放。
en: The R0.72G theorem is limited to the exact real one-carrier triangular 2.5D smooth-solution family. This recap does not prove global smoothness or finite-time breakdown for the three-dimensional Navier–Stokes equations; the formal Clay problem remains open.

The next obstruction moves to the mixed row for finitely many real carriers; general three-dimensional transfer remains open.

The weaker unstable conjugate pair with real part approximately \(0.04\) in the finite Galerkin diagnostic carries no proof weight for continuum-operator existence or multiplicity and does not conflict with the uniqueness conclusion, which counts only the region \(\operatorname{Re}\lambda>0.11\).

zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73O 的全部 131 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。
en: This page preserves, from R0.61 through R0.73O, all 131 nodes. R0.61–R0.69W progresses from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, the internal entry boundary, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B addresses strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer to a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance departure, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then selects the seed using the full action and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance departure at a fixed physical time. The background changes with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional effects, singularity, and Clay are not extrapolated. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) while the background changes with it, planar perturbations scaled down according to the full action can retain order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: any coexisting strong solution obeys finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations obey a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; sufficiently small full three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive stability tube of global strong solutions. Thus the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a fixed background. R0.73O rules out the \(H^3\)-small instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, its accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and it has a positive stability radius valid for every starting time. The forced contrast retains infinite accumulated strain and supplies, through planar directions, globally smooth witnesses whose initial perturbations tend to zero in \(H^3\), while their \(L^2\) distance from the forced equilibrium is bounded below by a fixed positive constant at suitable times.

R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations with \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes with the reference orbit; what remains uncrossed is the preceding early weak interval.

zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73Q 的全部 133 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。
en: This page retains all nodes from R0.61 through R0.73Q, 133 in total. R0.61–R0.69W moves from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer to a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar departure, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies the inviscid spectral branch of the continuum operator; R0.73K closes the parameter-uniform viscous rank-one spectral branch; and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action. R0.73M then specifies the seed through the full action and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance departure at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit stays in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional effects, singularity, and Clay are not extrapolated. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) with the background varying accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain fixed-order output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Hence the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small inputs escaping to a fixed distance on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbation instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, has finite accumulated \(H^4\) action, and possesses a positive stability radius valid at every initial time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain and supplies a globally smooth planar witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output escapes by a fixed \(L^2\) distance. R0.73P closes the critical stability and band-limited input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid at every initial time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may tend to zero in \(L^2\) while diverging in \(H^3\). Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes relative to the reference orbit; the uncrossed part is the preceding early weak interval. This section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and finite Volterra recursion to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open.

R0.73J certified an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closed a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgraded the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then used the full action to select the seed and closed a two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional perturbations, singularity, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) and the background changes with it, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys a finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Therefore, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input on one fixed background with fixed-distance escape. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbation-instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, the accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius works for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain and, through a planar direction, supplies a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) tends to zero while its output escapes by a fixed \(L^2\) distance. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube works for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may have \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. This section uses the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence to construct a critical caloric stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it includes smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness is established in the literature, while the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as a "reliable bridge lemma and counterexample tool," not as a high-level regularity theorem. Its retainable value is that it separates energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase into distinct layers; provides a rigorous certificate recomputable from finite Fourier data; and uses a deterministic isospectral family to show that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient.
