zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73S 的全部 135 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。
en: This page retains the nodes from R0.61 through R0.73S, all 135 of them. R0.61–R0.69W progressed from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examined moving scales, the critical ledger, the internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treated strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treated frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer in a fixed positive half-plane, gain for moving profiles, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar departure, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certified an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closed a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgraded the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then used the full action to specify the seed and closed a two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance departure at a fixed physical time. The background changes with \(\Lambda\), while the trajectory stays in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to a prefactor limit, a two-term WKB expansion, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional perturbations, singularity, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) with the background changing accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain an output of fixed order at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Therefore, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small inputs escaping a fixed distance on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbative instability route around a known unforced global background: every trajectory eventually decays, the accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius is valid for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain and, through a planar direction, supplies a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output exhibits a fixed \(L^2\) escape. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited input interfaces around a fixed global strong trajectory: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may have vanishing \(L^2\) norm while their \(H^3\) norm diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball regularizes after a common delay and synchronizes relative to the reference trajectory; the part that cannot be crossed is the earlier weak interval. This section constructs a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times by using the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence. An exact Fourier family proves that it admits smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; the bare Kato supremum is blocked by a time-endpoint counterexample. whole-space Besov openness belongs to the known literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool, not a high-level regularity theorem. What should be retained is the layered separation of energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase; a rigorous certificate that can be recomputed from finite Fourier data; and an isospectral deterministic family proving that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient. This section actually completes three narrower but usable tasks.

zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73U 的全部 137 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。 限定式碰撞检索没有发现与“标量能量密度自相关 \(A Q\) + 两个精确非自治见证”完全相同的打包，但有限检索不是新颖性或优先权证明。本站只把它称为可审计的本地综合。 我对 R0.73U 的价值判断是：它没有解决全局正则性，但把 R0.73T 的两个信息缺口分开了。
en: This page retains all 137 nodes from R0.61 through R0.73U. R0.61–R0.69W progresses from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, critical ledgers, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I then treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer in a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuinely nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then uses the full action to specify the seed and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity, or Clay. R0.73M proves that when \(\Lambda\to\infty\) and the background varies with it, planar perturbations reduced according to the full action can retain order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution has finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations obey a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Thus the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the small-\(H^3\)-perturbation instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, the accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius works for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain and provides, in the planar direction, a globally smooth witness with initial \(H^3\) tending to zero and fixed \(L^2\) output escape. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interface around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube works for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may have \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes with the reference orbit; the earlier weak interval remains inaccessible. That section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it includes smooth safe data outside the earlier \(H^{1/2}\) tube, while a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness is known in the literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool, not as a major regularity theorem. Its reusable parts are the separation of energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase; rigorous certificates recomputable from finite Fourier data; and a deterministic isospectral family showing that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient. This section completes three narrower but usable tasks. A restricted collision search found no package identical to scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) plus two exact non-autonomy witnesses, but a finite search is not proof of novelty or priority. This site calls it only an auditable local synthesis. My assessment of R0.73U is that it does not solve global regularity, but it separates the two information gaps left by R0.73T.

en: This page retains all 138 nodes from R0.61 through R0.73V. R0.61–R0.69W progresses from reduced recurrence to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, critical ledgers, internal entry, and the complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I in sequence treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer to a fixed right half-plane, gain along moving profiles, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then specifies the seed using the full action and closes planar nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background changes with \(\Lambda\), and the orbit remains in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, a two-term WKB expansion, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional perturbations, singularity, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) with the background changing accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down according to the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N supplies the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys finite cumulative strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Thus the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small inputs escaping a fixed distance on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbation instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every trajectory eventually decays, the cumulative \(H^4\) action is finite, and there is a positive stability radius valid for all starting times. The forced comparison retains infinite cumulative strain and, in a planar direction, gives a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output has a fixed \(L^2\) escape. R0.73P closes the critical stability and band-limited input interface around a fixed global strong trajectory: the critical tube is valid for all starting times, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations whose \(L^2\) norm tends to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. All weak branches in the energy ball become regular after a common delay and synchronize relative to the reference trajectory; what remains inaccessible is the preceding early weak interval. This section uses the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform in the starting time. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as “a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool,” not a high-level regularity theorem. What remains useful is the separation of energy, additive geometry, and high-order phase into layers; a rigorous certificate reproducible from finite Fourier data; and a same-spectrum deterministic family showing that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient. This section actually completes three narrower but usable tasks. The bounded collision search did not locate an identical package of “scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) + two exact nonautonomy witnesses,” but a finite search is not proof of novelty or priority. This site calls it only a locally auditable synthesis. My assessment of R0.73U is that it does not solve global regularity, but it separates the two information gaps left by R0.73T. The real threshold on this route is not another higher-order identity, but new, non-circular signed control from the energy class. That threshold has not yet been crossed.

zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73W 的全部 139 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。 限定式碰撞检索没有发现与“标量能量密度自相关 \(A Q\) + 两个精确非自治见证”完全相同的打包，但有限检索不是新颖性或优先权证明。本站只把它称为可审计的本地综合。 我对 R0.73U 的价值判断是：它没有解决全局正则性，但把 R0.73T 的两个信息缺口分开了。 这条路线的真正门槛不是再写一个高阶恒等式，而是从能量类获得新的、非循环的符号控制。这个门槛目前仍未跨过。
en: This page retains all 139 nodes from R0.61 through R0.73W. R0.61–R0.69W progresses from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, critical ledgers, internal entry boundaries, and complete-root boundaries; R0.72A–R0.73B addresses strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the full linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, fixed-right-half-plane transfer, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies an inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then uses the full action to specify the seed and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in an exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to a prefactor limit, a two-term WKB expansion, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) with the background changing accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds a fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution obeys finite accumulated-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive stability tube of global strong solutions. Consequently, the order of quantifiers in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a single fixed background. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbative-instability route around a known unforced global background: every orbit ultimately decays, the accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius works for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite accumulated strain, and its planar direction provides a globally smooth witness with initial \(H^3\) norm tending to zero and fixed \(L^2\) escape at the output. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and smooth perturbations may have vanishing \(L^2\) norm while their \(H^3\) norm diverges. All weak branches in the energy ball regularize after a common delay and synchronize relative to the reference orbit; the part that cannot be crossed is the preceding early-time weak interval. This section constructs a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times using the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a bare Kato supremum is obstructed by a time-endpoint counterexample. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, while the Clay conclusion remains open. The current value of R0.73R is assessed as "a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool," rather than a major regularity theorem. Its retainable contributions are: separating energy, additive geometry, and high-order phase layer by layer; providing a rigorous certificate reproducible from finite Fourier data; and using an isospectral deterministic family to show that the quadratic energy spectrum is insufficient. This section actually completes three narrower but usable tasks. A qualified collision search found no package exactly matching "scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) + two exact nonautonomous witnesses," but a finite search does not establish novelty or priority. The site describes it only as an auditable local synthesis. The assessment of R0.73U is that it does not solve global regularity, but separates the two information gaps in R0.73T. The genuine threshold for this route is not another higher-order identity, but new, non-circular sign control from the energy class. That threshold has not yet been crossed.

zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73X 的全部 140 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。 我把 R0.73R 的当前价值评为“可靠的桥接引理与反例工具”，而不是高水平正则性主定理。可保留之处是：分层拆开能量、加法几何与高阶相位；给出有限 Fourier 数据可复算的严格证书；用同谱确定性族证明二次能谱不足。 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。 限定式碰撞检索没有发现与“标量能量密度自相关 \(A Q\) + 两个精确非自治见证”完全相同的打包，但有限检索不是新颖性或优先权证明。本站只把它称为可审计的本地综合。 我对 R0.73U 的价值判断是：它没有解决全局正则性，但把 R0.73T 的两个信息缺口分开了。 这条路线的真正门槛不是再写一个高阶恒等式，而是从能量类获得新的、非循环的符号控制。这个门槛目前仍未跨过。
en: This page retains all 140 nodes from R0.61 through R0.73X. R0.61–R0.69W proceeds from reduced recursions to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, critical ledgers, interior entry, and complete-root boundaries; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–I successively treats frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer in a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, fixed-distance planar deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies the inviscid continuous spectral branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to a genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then specifies the seed using the full action and closes a two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background changes with \(\Lambda\), while the orbit remains in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional behavior, singularity formation, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, when \(\Lambda\to\infty\) and the background changes accordingly, a planar perturbation reduced according to the full action can retain a fixed-order output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution satisfies finite cumulative-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie in a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Therefore, the order of quantifiers in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a single fixed background. R0.73O closes the \(H^3\)-small perturbation instability route on known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, the cumulative \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius is valid for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite cumulative strain and supplies, in the planar direction, a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output undergoes a fixed \(L^2\) escape. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations with \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. All weak branches in the energy ball become regular after a common delay and synchronize relative to the reference orbit; the part that cannot be crossed is the preceding early weak interval. This section constructs a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting points using the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recursion. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness is known in the literature, while the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the present value of R0.73R as "a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool," not a high-level main regularity theorem. Its retained contributions are: separating energy, additive geometry, and higher-order phase by layers; providing a rigorous certificate reproducible from finite Fourier data; and using an isospectral deterministic family to prove that the quadratic energy spectrum is insufficient. This section completes three narrower but usable results. A bounded collision search found no package exactly matching "scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) + two exact nonautonomous witnesses," but a finite search does not prove novelty or priority. The site describes it only as an auditable local synthesis. I assess R0.73U as not solving global regularity but separating the two information gaps in R0.73T. The real threshold on this route is not another higher-order identity, but new, non-circular sign control derived from the energy class. That threshold has not yet been crossed.

en: \(A_{j,Q,+}\) is the soft/zero-padded positive-entry atom for each shell–cell, not the positive jump of ordinary hard BV and not, in general, the positive Jordan part of the signed aggregate: \[ A_+-(A_+-A_-)^+=\min(A_+,A_-). \] An even-order touch can make the hard positive jump zero while retaining the full \(A_+\).

zh: \(N=2\) 的两个输入标签第一次出现在 5 阶与 4 阶，输出第一次出现在 10 阶。 两个输入对 R0.22 尖锐横向方向的投影都精确非零，对称根相互作用也不精确抵消。 但实际归一化增益为 \(0.3045602145\ldots\)，只相当于同标签专门尖锐极化的 \(0.0043346408\ldots\)。
en: For \(N=2\), the two input labels first appear at orders five and four, and the output first appears at order ten. Both inputs have exactly nonzero projections onto the sharp transverse direction from R0.22, and the two symmetric root interactions do not cancel exactly. The actual normalized gain is \(0.3045602145\ldots\), only \(0.0043346408\ldots\) times the gain from the specially chosen sharp polarization with the same label.

zh: \(N=3\) 的 8 阶与 7 阶输入仍有精确非零的尖锐方向投影，对称根相互作用也不为零。 真实归一化增益从 \(N=2\) 的 \(0.304560\) 略升到 \(0.361556\)， 但真实/尖锐比降到 \(0.00195675\)，半径乘积归一化增益约减半。
en: The order-8 and order-7 inputs at \(N=3\) still have exactly nonzero sharp-direction projections, and the symmetrized root interaction is also nonzero. From its \(N=2\) value of \(0.304560\), the generated normalized gain rises slightly to \(0.361556\), but the generated/sharp ratio falls to \(0.00195675\), while the radius-product-normalized gain is roughly halved.

zh: \(q=4\) 是该能量插值族内最优端点，但 Young 后仍留下 \(\mu_v\sigma_v^3\)。时间尖峰证明二次 CKN 质量不能通过纯时间不等式控制该三次项；尖峰不是 Navier–Stokes 解。
en: \(q=4\) is optimal within this energy-interpolation family, but Young's inequality still leaves \(\mu_v\sigma_v^3\). A time spike proves that quadratic CKN mass cannot control this cubic term through a time-only inequality; the spike is not a Navier–Stokes solution.

The five analytic sectors \(s=0,-1,1\), \(2\le s<241\), and \(s\ge241\) exhaust all tail monomials. At \(r=0.376\), their bounds are 0.766741, 0.980676, 0.202951, 0.995205, and 0.997706, respectively, so the complete correlated tail bound is \[ 0.99770647568583198433<1. \] The ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and regular-stretch gates all pass.

The characteristic polynomial of the 204-dimensional image space factors exactly as \[ \chi_{\rm im}(x)=x^{56}(x-4096)^{14} q_{4,256}(x)^{14}q_{10,16}(x)^6q_{18}(x). \] After one transient, the full vector satisfies an exact degree-33 recurrence and the generating function has no factor cancellation. Hence the reachable scalar obeys \[ Y_{8,r}=C_{8,0}\nu^r+O(4800^r), \qquad 6438.806869529984<\nu<6438.806869530010, \] with \[ -0.02612679363405570 <C_{8,0} <-0.02612679362708268. \]

zh: 243 个竞争对象与所有大荷、全尾次数扇区都严格落后。 最近者已从 \(s=164\) 切换为 \(s=0\)，严格间隙为 \(1.7808194822375234792\times10^{-5}\)。全部 \(s\ge241\) 的统一上界为 \(0.99813502986433707146\)，负一荷扇区也由 正导数余量完成全次数端点证明。
en: All 243 competitors and every large-charge and all-tail-degree sector are strictly lower. The nearest competitor has switched from \(s=164\) to \(s=0\), with strict gap \(1.7808194822375234792\times10^{-5}\). The uniform upper bound for all \(s\ge241\) is \(0.99813502986433707146\), and a positive derivative margin proves the all-degree endpoint for the minus-one-charge sector.

zh: 27 个时间层比较的最大相对残差为 \(1.11\times10^{-15}\)， 八态整数递推在前 10 个二进制层级与直接卷积完全一致。 六个未加权相关最坏目标延伸到 \(M=131072\) 和约 289.78 亿条路径， 仍保持 \(S_{4,m}/M<0.02\)，但消去条件数已达到 \(5.06\times10^4\)。
en: Across 27 time-layer comparisons, the largest relative residual is \(1.11\times10^{-15}\), and the eight-state integer recurrence agrees exactly with direct convolution through the first 10 dyadic levels. Six worst-case targets for the unweighted correlation extend to \(M=131072\) and about 28.978 billion paths (289.78 hundred million); they still satisfy \(S_{4,m}/M<0.02\), while the cancellation condition number reaches \(5.06\times10^4\).

The 278 fixed positive-charge records, \(s=1\), \(s=-1\), and the parity/Bernstein tail record covering all \(s\ge280\) are strictly below the zero-charge equality. The nearest competitor is \((j,s)=(81,162)\), with gap greater than \(1.4883451915609408904\times10^{-6}\). At the fixed radius \(r_0=0.382628\), the linearization margin is greater than \(2.3070276529233482826\times10^{-6}\), the residual norm is less than \(7.5271302784558830723\times10^{-31}\), and the exact restart passes.

zh: 40 次精确有理二分把根隔离在 \[ 0.376932499290527340<r_*<0.376932499290527341. \] 独立的 81 项 Sturm 序列在两端的变号数由 40 降到 39， 且没有端点零值，所以该宽度 \(10^{-18}\) 的区间恰含一根。
en: Forty exact rational bisections isolate the root in \[ 0.376932499290527340<r_*<0.376932499290527341. \] The independent 81-term Sturm sequence has 40 and 39 sign variations at the two endpoints, respectively, with no zero endpoint values, so this width-\(10^{-18}\) interval contains exactly one root.

zh: 62 维低阶逆被证明在认证尾空间上严格无作用；真正的增益来自次数分离后的全阶尾部界，共同解析半径提高到 \(59/500\)。
en: The 62-dimensional low-order inverse is proved to be exactly inert on the certified tail space; the genuine gain comes from the degree-separated all-order tail bound, which raises the common analytic radius to \(59/500\).

zh: 79 节完整封存
en: 79 sections fully sealed

zh: 按实际增益归一化的平面固定距离偏离
en: Planar fixed-distance departure normalized by the actual gain

zh: 按振幅展开后，完整 Picard 森林塌缩为单条有序链 \[ (\partial_t-\Delta_{12})G_n=-F_1\partial_2G_{n-1}. \] 令 \(N=LM\)、\(H=4N\)。三次项满足 \(|\xi_1|\ge3N+1>3H/4\)，所以其目标投影严格为零。 三、五、七、九阶到零平面的距离下界分别为 \(3N+1,2N+2,N+3,4\)。
en: After expansion in amplitude, the full Picard forest collapses to one ordered chain \[ (\partial_t-\Delta_{12})G_n=-F_1\partial_2G_{n-1}. \] Set \(N=LM\) and \(H=4N\). The cubic term obeys \(|\xi_1|\ge3N+1>3H/4\), so its target projection vanishes exactly. The distances of orders three, five, seven, and nine from the zero plane are bounded below by \(3N+1,2N+2,N+3,4\), respectively.

zh: 八个 signed 初始频率在有理 charge–offset 坐标下恰好构成一个线性变换立方体。 因而 \(L\) 叶支持精确含 \((L+1)^3\) 个标签；偶数 \(L\) 去掉零频后少一个。 不可压缩恒等式与纵向半范数同时消除了表面上的 \(4^n\) 壳层损失。
en: In rational charge–offset coordinates, the eight signed initial frequencies form an exact linear image of a cube. The support with \(L\) leaves therefore contains exactly \((L+1)^3\) labels, or one fewer when \(L\) is even and the zero frequency is removed. The incompressibility identity and the longitudinal seminorm together remove the apparent \(4^n\) shell loss.

zh: 八阶零时间循环的精确谱与可达主投影
en: Exact spectrum and reachable dominant projection of the eighth-order zero-time cycle

zh: 把 \(A\) 换成 \(-A\) 会翻转 production，而 stress 和 \(D\) 不变； 因此不存在对所有光滑无散数据成立的单边符号律。比值 随 \(A\to\infty\) 无界，所以文中指定的同时刻、振幅无关二次吸收也不成立。
en: Replacing \(A\) by \(-A\) reverses production while leaving stress and \(D\) unchanged; hence no one-sided sign law can hold for all smooth divergence-free data. The ratio is unbounded as \(A\to\infty\), so the stated simultaneous-time, amplitude-independent quadratic absorption also fails.

zh: 把 \(b_r\)、\(N_r\) 与加权壳层极限逐项对照现有局部能量、Morrey 与压力正则性判据，判断是否存在真正更弱的条件。
en: Compare \(b_r\), \(N_r\), and the weighted shell limit term by term with existing local-energy, Morrey, and pressure regularity criteria to determine whether a genuinely weaker condition exists.

zh: 把 R0.8 极化沿 \(M\) 输运并固定每壳 \(\dot H^{1/2}\) 能量后， 下一壳目标对的最大第一 Picard 能量满足 \(4^{5j}H_j\to81/(173056\sqrt3)\)。 一般的频率壳估计还给出 \(m_N/N^3\) 上界，其中 \(m_N\) 是每个输出的输入配对重数。
en: Polarize R0.8 along the \(M\) transport and fix each shell \(\dot H^{1/2}\) energy, then the maximum first Picard energy of the next shell target satisfies \(4^{5j}H_j\to81/(173056\sqrt3)\). General frequency shell estimates also provide an upper bound on \(m_N/N^3\), where \(m_N\) is the multiplicity of each input pair for output.

zh: 把精确七单形核插入全部 35 种时间次序，完成有限矩提升、主热投影和严格解析余项；这是与 R0.68A 无限尾定理合并前的最后有限关口。
en: Insert the exact seven-simplex kernel into all 35 time orderings and complete the finite-moment lift, dominant heat projection, and rigorous analytic remainder. This is the last finite gate before combining the result with the R0.68A infinite-tail theorem.

zh: 把谱分成强制、近面与近线三种区域，先建立过滤协方差到未过滤临界范数的桥接目标，并写出主方向的精确演化账本。
en: I will partition the spectrum into coercive, near-plane, and near-line regimes, first formulate the target estimate linking filtered covariance to an unfiltered critical norm, and then derive the exact evolution ledger for the principal directions.

zh: 把完整非线性映射写成 \(\Phi_c=\tau_c\Phi\tau_c^{-1}\) 后， 共轭半径为 \(s=2\rho_*/7\)、\(S=4\rho_*/7\)，比值恰为 \(1/2\)。 一般全阶常数为 \[C(\lambda)=\frac{11}{3}M_1(\lambda)\bigl(M_2(\lambda)+M_1(\lambda)^2\bigr),\] 本步因此仍取 \(C(1/2)=121/48\)。
en: After writing the complete nonlinear map as \(\Phi_c=\tau_c\Phi\tau_c^{-1}\), the conjugated radii are \(s=2\rho_*/7\) and \(S=4\rho_*/7\), with ratio exactly \(1/2\). The general all-order constant is \[C(\lambda)=\frac{11}{3}M_1(\lambda)\bigl(M_2(\lambda)+M_1(\lambda)^2\bigr),\] so this step still has \(C(1/2)=121/48\).

zh: 把已知结果、预印本、计算、猜想和失败尝试分开写。
en: Distinguish known results, preprints, computations, conjectures, and failed attempts.

zh: 把远场四极矩写成 dyadic 壳系数序列，检验速度生成的压力源是否强迫 telescoping、Carleson 或 square-function 控制。
en: Write the far-field quadrupole as a sequence of dyadic-shell coefficients and test whether velocity-generated pressure sources force telescoping, Carleson, or square-function control.

zh: 半径缩小一半后，一阶、二阶和混合导数乘子的精确上界分别是 \(1/2,9/8,1/4\)， 从而得到外半径到半半径的双线性界 \(121/48\)。这是延拓所需的一个部件，但还没有近似逆、尾部余项或到达候选的合法圆盘链。
en: After halving the radius, the exact bounds for first, second, and mixed derivative multipliers are \(1/2,9/8,1/4\), yielding the outer-to-half-radius bilinear bound \(121/48\). This is one component needed for continuation, but there is still no approximate inverse, tail remainder, or valid disk chain reaching the candidate.

zh: 半群方法和尺度临界空间逐渐形成现代适定性框架。
en: The semigroup method and scale-critical spaces gradually form a modern well-posedness framework.

zh: 保留 Fourier 反例、常数失控或端点失败的具体计算。
en: Keep Fourier counterexamples, constant loss of control or endpoint failures in specific calculations.

zh: 保留 joint heat exposure，或直接利用 \(V\) 翻转奇偶格点，可得 \(G_{\rm all}^{\rm ex}\asymp M^2\)。R0.72I complete-ledger 的物理归一化比值在 \(0<g\le\gamma_0M^{3/2}\) 内满足 \(CM^{-4/9}(\log M)^{-2/3}\to0\)。因此这个族不是候选 physical inequality 的反例。
en: Retaining joint heat exposure, or directly using the fact that \(V\) flips lattice parity, gives \(G_{\rm all}^{\rm ex}\asymp M^2\). The physically normalized R0.72I complete-ledger ratio, for \(0<g\le\gamma_0M^{3/2}\), satisfies \(CM^{-4/9}(\log M)^{-2/3}\to0\). Hence this family is not a counterexample to the candidate physical inequality.

zh: 保留符号的完整拉伸账本精确消去裸幅值梯度，并把剩余问题定位到投影块散度缺陷。
en: The complete signed stretching ledger cancels the bare amplitude gradient exactly and locates the remaining issue in the divergence defect of the projected block.

zh: 保留解析尾项的精确周期块收缩：有界—逃逸胞元二分
en: Exact-tail periodic contraction through the compact–escaping cell dichotomy

zh: 保留精确恒等式 \[ \omega(x)\times\omega(x+z) =\omega(x)\times\bigl(\omega(x+z)-\omega(x)\bigr) \] 后，近场核从临界径向测度 \(ds/s\) 改善为可积的 \(ds\)。 极大函数与三维插值给出 \(C_{\rm n}rA^{1/2}B^{5/2}\)，能量控制的远场给出 \(C_{\rm f}r^{-3/2}A^3\)。15 项形式检查全部通过。
en: After retaining the exact identity \[ \omega(x)\times\omega(x+z) =\omega(x)\times\bigl(\omega(x+z)-\omega(x)\bigr) \], the near-field kernel improves from the critical radial measure \(ds/s\) to the integrable \(ds\). The maximal function and three-dimensional interpolation give \(C_{\rm n}rA^{1/2}B^{5/2}\), while the energy-controlled far field gives \(C_{\rm f}r^{-3/2}A^3\). All 15 formal checks passed.

zh: 保留三单形时间积分后，三个载频顺序都能逐项写成独立高斯权的 三次多项式系数。底层 \(P,Q\) 两态递推因此精确提升为八个三次 \(P/Q\) 状态；再乘目标符号后，自然得到十六态与进位闭合系统。
en: After retaining the three-simplex time integral, each carrier ordering becomes a cubic polynomial coefficient with separate Gaussian weights. The base two-state \(P,Q\) recursion therefore lifts exactly to eight cubic \(P/Q\) states; multiplying by the target sign yields a natural sixteen-state, carry-closed system.

zh: 保留实际 enstrophy 与 action 后，小耦合不再是共同频带的边界
en: With actual enstrophy and action retained, small coupling is no longer the common-band boundary

zh: 保留一份可以逐行检查的 HTML/PDF 笔记，并列出已经被小算例排除的普适估计。
en: Keep an HTML/PDF notebook that can be checked line by line, listing general estimates that have been excluded by small examples.

zh: 保留周期 Biot–Savart 拉伸核的反对称性与涡量方向夹角，构造空间尺度—时间壳的有符号算子；若只重述已知涡量方向相干准则，则记录对应关系后转向压力通道。
en: Retain the antisymmetry of the periodic Biot-Savart stretching kernel and the angle between vorticity directions, and construct a signed operator over spatial scales and time shells. If this only restates a known vorticity-direction coherence criterion, record the correspondence and move to the pressure channel.

zh: 本版本严格关闭的是“只靠固定核心静态环带符号得到统一严格亏损”的子路线；它没有证明全空间 Γ 等于一，也没有给出沿真实解传播的耗减或正则性结论。下一步必须改变径向形状，并显式纳入过渡—过渡点对。
en: This version rigorously closes the sub-route that seeks a uniform strict deficit from fixed-core static annular signs alone. It does not prove that the full-space Gamma equals one, nor does it provide depletion or regularity propagated along genuine solutions. The next step must change the radial shape and explicitly include transition–transition pairs.

zh: 本节必须同时保留四条不同结论：全三维同步 \((H^3,H^3)\) 稳定性已经 闭合；全三维 \(H^3\)-输入/\(L^2\)-输出只是前者的自定义推论；平面不变 子系统内的同步 \((H^3_{\rm pl},L^2_{\rm pl})\) 稳定性具有真正的 \(L^2\) 初值小性；全三维 FPS \((H^3,L^2)\) 稳定性仍为 OPEN。这里的同步比较 固定从 \(t_0=0\) 出发，不允许轨道相移，也不声称对所有起始时刻一致。
en: Four distinct conclusions must remain separated in this section: full-three-dimensional synchronized \((H^3,H^3)\) stability has been closed; full-three-dimensional \(H^3\)-input/\(L^2\)-output is only a custom corollary of that result; synchronized \((H^3_{\rm pl},L^2_{\rm pl})\) stability in the planar invariant subsystem has genuine smallness in the initial \(L^2\) norm; and full-three-dimensional FPS \((H^3,L^2)\) stability remains OPEN. The synchronized comparison here is fixed to start from \(t_0=0\); no orbital phase shift is permitted, and no uniformity over all starting times is claimed.

zh: 本节定位的是投影正则性的缺口，不是对所有带附加几何假设的投影估计作否定。
en: This section locates the gap in projection regularity; it does not rule out every projection estimate with additional geometric hypotheses.

zh: 本节分类并停止“仅靠时间解析性与复域上界”的直接路线；没有给出 uniform NSE zero count、无限 frame、Leray 极限、继续性或全局正则性结论。反例族不是 NSE 重复进入轨道。
en: This section classifies and stops the direct route based only on time analyticity and complex-domain upper bounds; it gives no uniform NSE zero count, infinite-frame estimate, Leray limit, continuation result, or global-regularity conclusion. The counterexample families are not NSE trajectories with repeated entries.

zh: 本节覆盖 parent-only broad frequency frame 和 global cell。它不覆盖 R0.71E 的 lo/hi child refinement、matched spatial cells、denominator/refresh faces、另一 NSE budget、完整 weighted BV、无条件继续性或奇性构造。
en: This section covers the parent-only broad frequency frame and the global cell. It does not cover the R0.71E lo/hi child refinement, matched spatial cells, denominator or refresh faces, another NSE budget, complete weighted BV, an unconditional continuation result, or a singularity construction.

zh: 本节给出量词明确的光滑小数据族，只排除相应统一反向控制；它没有触及大数据候选奇性。
en: This section gives a smooth small-data family with explicit quantifiers and rules out only the corresponding uniform reverse control; it does not address candidate singularities in the large-data regime.

zh: 本节关闭 bounded overlap + Bernstein + Leray energy + rowwise absolute values 这一条 fixed-cell collar 路线。它不排除 signed fused cancellation、额外临界 increment/Carleson 输入、faces、moving cells、继续性或全局正则性。
en: This section closes the fixed-cell collar route based on bounded overlap, Bernstein estimates, Leray energy, and rowwise absolute values. It does not rule out signed fused cancellation, additional critical increment/Carleson input, faces, moving cells, continuation, or global regularity.

zh: 本节关闭的是“完成 projective square 后把它当作新耗散”这一条 fixed-cell 代数路线。它没有证明 signed second jet 不能由其他 NSE 机制控制，也没有得到继续性、奇性或全局正则性结论。
en: This section closes the fixed-cell algebraic route that treats the completed projective square as new dissipation. It does not prove that the signed second jet cannot be controlled by another NSE mechanism, and it gives no continuation, singularity, or global-regularity conclusion.

zh: 本节关闭的是“已知 increment defect + 当前 Cauchy/Bernstein split”这一条直接证明路线。它没有证明 increment 在逻辑上不能控制更小的 signed tangent，也没有得到继续性、奇性或全局正则性结论。
en: This section closes the direct proof route “known increment defect + current Cauchy/Bernstein split.” It does not prove that increments cannot logically control a smaller signed tangent, and it yields no conclusion on continuation, singularity, or global regularity.

zh: 本节关闭的是“soft denominator 自动删除 fixed-cell faces”这一想法。它没有证明完整 NSE weighted face sum 发散，也没有得到继续性、奇性或全局正则性结论。
en: This section closes the idea that a soft denominator automatically deletes fixed-cell faces. It does not prove divergence of the complete NSE weighted face sum and gives no continuation, singularity, or global-regularity conclusion.

zh: 本节关闭的是声明光滑双环分量的 heat-volume-only 支付，不是完整 face-paid BV。它没有覆盖预设宽单环 frame、完整 Parseval frame、所有 frame、Leray 极限、无条件继续性或奇性构造。
en: This section closes heat-volume-only payment for the stated smooth two-annulus component, not the full face-paid BV. It does not cover prescribed broad single-annulus frames, the full Parseval frame, all frames, the Leray limit, unconditional continuation, or a singularity construction.

zh: 本节关闭的是一组预先固定 aligned matched partitions 上的 local heat/support-only 支付。它不覆盖 phase-misaligned、moving/deforming cells、general denominator faces、refresh atoms、child-refined frame、无限 frame–cell identity、无条件 weighted BV、继续性、全局光滑性或有限时破裂。
en: This section closes local heat/support-only payment on a family of aligned matched partitions fixed in advance. It does not cover phase-misaligned or moving/deforming cells, general denominator faces, refresh atoms, a child-refined frame, an infinite frame–cell identity, unconditional weighted BV, continuation, global smoothness, or finite-time breakdown.

zh: 本节关闭的是原目标由 bare Leray time integral 支付的这一类 temporal-packet 方案。genuine NSE no-go 包含 initial observation face，不覆盖只计算 internal entries 的定理；这里没有构造 NSE 多进入轨道，也没有得到 continuation、singularity 或 global regularity。
en: This section closes the class of temporal-packet schemes in which the original target is paid by the bare Leray time integral. The genuine NSE no-go includes an initial observation face and does not cover theorems that count only internal entries; no NSE multiple-entry trajectory, continuation result, singularity result, or global regularity result is obtained here.

zh: 本节没有得到 outgoing occupation packing、continuation、singularity 或 global regularity。no-go 只排除 covariant frame/window、常数沿该解族一致、RHS 恰为 bare normalized Leray-Lamb time integral 的声明类。
en: This section does not obtain outgoing-occupation packing, continuation, singularity, or global regularity. The no-go rules out only the class of claims with a covariant frame/window, a constant uniform along this solution family, and a right-hand side equal exactly to the bare normalized Leray-Lamb time integral.

zh: 本节没有得到 weak zero-jet、继续性、finite-time singularity 或 global regularity；closed-response figure 只作可复现 corroboration。
en: This section obtains no weak zero-jet, continuation, finite-time singularity, or global regularity; the closed-response figure is reproducible corroboration only.

zh: 本节没有删除 second-time-jet recurrence tax，没有得到 weak-solution jet trace、single-trajectory infinite recurrence、continuation、finite-time singularity 或 global regularity。
en: This section does not remove the second-time-jet recurrence tax and does not establish a weak-solution jet trace, single-trajectory infinite recurrence, continuation, a finite-time singularity, or global regularity.

zh: 本节排除固定尺度正平均到未解析负部的统一直接桥；动态自适应覆盖和更强观测仍需另行分析。
en: This section rules out a uniform direct bridge from positive fixed-scale averages to the unresolved negative part; dynamically adaptive covers and stronger observations require separate analysis.

zh: 本节区分固定时间控制与时空累计，不排除额外 occupation 或包络信息能够改善后者。
en: This section distinguishes fixed-time control from space-time accumulation. It does not rule out improvements to the latter from additional occupation or envelope information.

zh: 本节真正完成的是三件较窄但可用的工作。
en: This section actually completes three narrower but usable tasks.

zh: 本节证明 finite, scale-compatible absolute size at positive heat scale，不证明 smallness、absorption、coercivity、weighted tent、s=0 endpoint 或 epsilon regularity；translated packet 是 p=mu=0 的静态 functional 见证，通常不是 NSE trajectory，不反驳 associated-pressure 或 NSE-only estimates。
en: This section proves finite, scale-compatible absolute size at positive heat scale; it does not prove smallness, absorption, coercivity, weighted tent control, the s=0 endpoint, or epsilon regularity. The translated packet is a static functional witness with p=mu=0, is generally not an NSE trajectory, and does not refute associated-pressure or NSE-only estimates.

zh: 本节证明面积与投影缺陷不等价；它没有单独排除对 signed work 的其他几何控制。
en: This section proves that area and projection defect are not equivalent; by itself, it does not rule out other geometric controls on signed work.

zh: 本节证明同刻 batch 的一次 time-slice square-function estimate，没有给出 uniform NSE temporal packing、内部多 face、无限 frame、Leray 极限、继续性或全局正则性结论。
en: This section proves a single time-slice square-function estimate for the same-time batch; it gives no result on uniform NSE temporal packing, multiple interior faces, the infinite frame, the Leray limit, continuation, or global regularity.

zh: 本节只关闭固定有限阶展开的统一求和路线，不排除随尺度增长的阶数或其他非局部机制。
en: This section closes only the uniform summation route based on a fixed finite-order expansion; an order that grows with scale or another nonlocal mechanism is not ruled out.

zh: 本节只排除 certificate (3.3) 的一参数 endpoint-square、termwise source-square 无条件闭合；其他 Duhamel designs 保持开放。这里没有证明 uniform incidence、temporal packing、continuation、singularity 或 global regularity，也不排除 signed / bilinear scale-critical packet。
en: This section rules out only unconditional closure of the one-parameter endpoint-square, termwise source-square certificate (3.3); other Duhamel designs remain open. It proves no uniform incidence, temporal packing, continuation, singularity, or global regularity result, and does not exclude a signed / bilinear scale-critical packet.

The degree-ten moment lift, heat coefficients, same-displacement defect, and dominant-root resolvent have not yet been combined, so this is neither the final eighth-order heat-sign theorem nor a general three-dimensional regularity result.

en: Obtaining a conditional theorem that is strictly weaker than known Serrin's hypothesis but sufficient to prevent continuous migration towards high frequencies.
The low-degree \(42\)-dimensional Jacobian has an exact two-sided inverse, with \(\|J_8^{-1}\|_1=35183/350\).

zh: 低秩本身不能消除该通道。结果不排除额外方向传播或动态相位信息产生的控制。
en: Low rank alone cannot eliminate this channel. The result does not rule out control from additional directional propagation or dynamic phase information.

zh: 第二，展开为 Germano 的透明账本后， 完整二阶 stress 方程不只含速度三阶 cumulant \(\kappa_s\)，还含压力--速度 covariance \(Q_s\)、压力--应变 covariance \(R_s\)、 梯度 covariance 和 resolved production。只保留 \(\kappa_s\) 会漏项。
en: Second, after expanding the formula into Germano's transparent ledger, the complete second-order stress equation contains not only the third-order velocity cumulant \(\kappa_s\), but also the pressure–velocity covariance \(Q_s\), the pressure–strain covariance \(R_s\), gradient covariance, and resolved production. Retaining only \(\kappa_s\) omits terms.

zh: 第三，若已经假设经典临界强范数 \(u\in L_t^4L_x^6\)，则 \(\kappa_s\) 与 \(Q_s\) 进入 \(L_t^{4/3}L_x^2\) 通量行。取 stress 方程的一半迹后，\(R_{ii,s}\) 严格消失，完整标量三阶通量也进入这一行。不过方程仍保留带符号的 production \(-\tau_s:\nabla v_s\)，而且临界估计仍以强范数为前提。
en: Third, if one already assumes the classical critical strong norm \(u\in L_t^4L_x^6\), then \(\kappa_s\) and \(Q_s\) enter the \(L_t^{4/3}L_x^2\) flux row. After taking half the trace of the stress equation, \(R_{ii,s}\) vanishes exactly and the full scalar third-order flux also enters this row. The equation nevertheless retains the signed production \(-\tau_s:\nabla v_s\), and the critical estimate still presupposes the strong norm.

en: All 34,690 valid carrier tuples and ten time orderings in the first four-bit cycle have been summed exactly, and the complete sixth-order heat coefficient is strictly positive.

The second retains \(\nu^2\|\omega_t\|_2^2+\|L_t\|_{\dot H^{-1}}^2\), is finite only at the classical level, and is not controlled by the ordinary Leray energy inequality. zh: 定理只覆盖固定 \(q_0\)、\(\delta\ge1\)、实单载波与 \(A_\delta=O(\delta)\) 的 exact triangular 2.5D 光滑解族；不是一般三维 continuation theorem，也没有解决千禧年问题。
en: The theorem covers only fixed \(q_0\), \(\delta\ge1\), one real carrier, and \(A_\delta=O(\delta)\) within an exact triangular 2.5D smooth-solution family. It is not a general three-dimensional continuation theorem and does not solve the Millennium Problem.

en: The theorem controls selected exact roots only and assumes real shear, unit phases, a fixed target, and matched floors. It is not an all-root theorem, universal endpoint, continuation criterion, finite-time singularity, or global-regularity result; the floor-free, strong-coupling, \(A_{0,N}\to0\), non-unit-phase, and different-geometry cases remain open.

en: For a directional packet with \(h_\beta=\theta_\beta\kappa_{j_\beta}^{-2}\), sampling coherence and a finite Bessel hypothesis give \[ \sum_\beta a_\beta \le \frac{B_{\rm crit}}{\mu^2(1-\delta)^2\theta_-} \int\sum_j\kappa_j^{-2}\frac{\|F_j\|_2^2}{Y}\,dt. \] This is a rigorous finite conditional theorem; sampling coherence, a uniformly positive \(\theta_-\), and \(B_{\rm crit}\) have not been derived automatically from NSE.

zh: 对 \(L=\mathbb P(u\times\omega)\)，精确物理时间演化保留全部壳间作用。令 \(C=\nabla\times(\chi e^{s\Delta}T_j\omega)\)、\(F=e^{s\Delta}T_jL\)、 \(E=C/\|C\|_2\) 与 \(\beta=\langle F,E\rangle\)。在 \(\|C\|_2>0\) 时， \[ \beta_t=\langle e^{s\Delta}T_j\partial_tL,E\rangle +\|C\|_2^{-1}\langle P_{E^\perp}F,C_t\rangle. \] 径向增长精确消去，只剩 Lamb 加速度和角向旋转；零分母处则必须使用 \(q_\varepsilon\) 或保留内部时间面。
en: For \(L=\mathbb P(u\times\omega)\), the exact physical-time evolution retains every inter-shell interaction. Set \(C=\nabla\times(\chi e^{s\Delta}T_j\omega)\), \(F=e^{s\Delta}T_jL\), \(E=C/\|C\|_2\), and \(\beta=\langle F,E\rangle\). When \(\|C\|_2>0\), \[ \beta_t=\langle e^{s\Delta}T_j\partial_tL,E\rangle +\|C\|_2^{-1}\langle P_{E^\perp}F,C_t\rangle. \] Radial growth cancels exactly, leaving only Lamb acceleration and angular rotation; at a zero denominator one must use \(q_\varepsilon\) or retain internal time faces.

zh: 对 \(L=1\)、\(M_r=16^r\)、\(q_r=2(16^r-1)/15\)， 四十八态被提升到二元整数矩，正式计算保留总次数 \(96\)。 完整单形核展开到阶数 \(48\)，其后全部项由解析公式作有理向外包络。
en: For \(L=1\), \(M_r=16^r\), \(q_r=2(16^r-1)/15\), the forty-eight states are lifted to bivariate integer moments, with total degree \(96\) retained in the formal computation. The complete simplex kernel is expanded through order \(48\), and every later term is enclosed outward by an analytic rational formula.

zh: 对 \(M=2N+1\) 个 unit-modulus carrier phases、实 shear 与 fixed target，exact triangular Fourier-lattice evolution 是 \(\ell^2\) contraction。在每个 selected exact root 上，diagonal heat coordinate 消失，目标斜率精确等于 shear multiplication operator 作用于 active scalar 后的一个坐标。
en: For \(M=2N+1\) unit-modulus carrier phases, real shear, and a fixed target, the exact triangular Fourier-lattice evolution is an \(\ell^2\) contraction. At every selected exact root the diagonal heat coordinate vanishes, and the target slope is exactly one coordinate of the shear multiplication operator acting on the active scalar.

zh: 对 \(q=\operatorname{tr}((\nabla u)^2)=\partial_i\partial_j(u_i u_j)\)， 我把 dyadic 截断放在速度应力 \(u_i u_j\) 上。每个壳层源分别具有零质量和零偶极矩，并满足 \[ |Q^{(m)}|\le CR_m^{-5}\int\chi_m|u|^2. \] 这比一般标量源的 \(R_m^{-3}\) 多出两个距离幂。正半定能量张量 \(\operatorname{diag}(1,2,0)\) 仍产生非零 \(R^{-5}\) 系数，因此该幂次是尖锐的。14 项形式检查全部通过。
en: For \(q=\operatorname{tr}((\nabla u)^2)=\partial_i\partial_j(u_i u_j)\), I place the dyadic cutoff on the velocity stress \(u_i u_j\). Every shell source separately has zero mass and zero dipole and satisfies \[ |Q^{(m)}|\le CR_m^{-5}\int\chi_m|u|^2. \] This gains two distance powers over \(R_m^{-3}\) for a general scalar source. The positive-semidefinite energy tensor \(\operatorname{diag}(1,2,0)\) still produces a nonzero \(R^{-5}\) coefficient, so the power is sharp. All 14 formal checks passed.

zh: 对 \(s\ge241\)，最低次数格点恰分成偶数 \(J_s=s/2\) 与奇数 \(J_s=(s+3)/2\) 两支。令 \(y=1/s\) 后，两支都是精确有理函数。偶数支导数与奇数支负导数各有 319 个 318 次 Bernstein 系数，并且在完整区间内全部严格为正；没有做区间细分。
en: For \(s\ge241\), the minimum-degree lattice splits exactly into the even branch \(J_s=s/2\) and the odd branch \(J_s=(s+3)/2\). After setting \(y=1/s\), both are exact rational functions. The even derivative and negative odd derivative each have 319 Bernstein coefficients of degree 318, all strictly positive on the complete interval; no interval subdivision is used.
