zh: 对 \(w_{\beta,\gamma}=s^{-\beta}[1+\log(1/s)]^\gamma\)，Leray energy 在 \(\beta<1/2\) 时支付 action；R0.72E exact family 则强制 \(\beta>1/3\)，或在端点取 \(\gamma\ge1\)。
en: For \(w_{\beta,\gamma}=s^{-\beta}[1+\log(1/s)]^\gamma\), Leray energy pays for the action when \(\beta<1/2\), while the R0.72E exact family requires \(\beta>1/3\), or \(\gamma\ge1\) at the endpoint.

zh: 对 \(X\in W^{2,1}(I;B)\) 的每个相邻根隙，我用右端导数的 norming functional 定义实投影。零端点使投影导数的平均值为零，由此得到 \(\sum_{j=2}^m\|X'(t_j)\|^2\le2\int\|X'\|\|X''\|\)。系数 2 尖锐，首根项必要。
en: On each adjacent root gap of \(X\in W^{2,1}(I;B)\), I define a real projection using a norming functional for the right-endpoint derivative. The zero endpoints make the projected derivative have zero mean, yielding \(\sum_{j=2}^m\|X'(t_j)\|^2\le2\int\|X'\|\|X''\|\). The factor 2 is sharp and the first-root term is necessary.

zh: 对 \[ \dot Q=\Sigma Q+Q\Sigma+F, \qquad \dot G=\Sigma G, \] 应变传播子拉回 \(\widehat Q=G^{-1}QG^{-\mathsf T}\) 满足精确恒等式 \[ \dot{\widehat Q}=G^{-1}FG^{-\mathsf T}. \] 但 \(G\) 只是 strain-only propagator，不是物理形变梯度。返回欧氏变量时，优化后的相对残差仍最多损失 \(\kappa_2(G)^2\)，并且指数 2 由显式正定矩阵族达到。
en: For \[ \dot Q=\Sigma Q+Q\Sigma+F, \qquad \dot G=\Sigma G, \], the strain-propagator pullback \(\widehat Q=G^{-1}QG^{-\mathsf T}\) satisfies the exact identity \[ \dot{\widehat Q}=G^{-1}FG^{-\mathsf T}. \] But \(G\) is only a strain-only propagator, not the physical deformation gradient. On returning to Euclidean variables, the optimized relative residual still incurs a factor of up to \(\kappa_2(G)^2\), and exponent 2 is attained by an explicit positive-definite matrix family.

zh: 对 R0.57 的相干频率包逐项积分，固定低模的精确系数为 \[ d_L(t)=e^{-t}\sum_{N=L}^{2L-1} \frac{1-e^{-2N^2t}}{2N^2}. \] 在抛物观察时间 \(t_L=(\log2)/(2L^2)\)，对每个 \(L\ge1\) 都有 \[ \frac1{32L}\le d_L(t_L)\le\frac1{2L}, \] 且 \(Ld_L(t_L)\) 收敛到一个严格为正的 Riemann 积分。
en: Integrating the coherent frequency packet from R0.57 term by term gives the exact fixed-low-mode coefficient \[ d_L(t)=e^{-t}\sum_{N=L}^{2L-1} \frac{1-e^{-2N^2t}}{2N^2}. \] At the parabolic observation time \(t_L=(\log2)/(2L^2)\), every \(L\ge1\) satisfies \[ \frac1{32L}\le d_L(t_L)\le\frac1{2L}, \] and \(Ld_L(t_L)\) converges to a strictly positive Riemann sum.

zh: 对 R0.69P 的紧支撑仿射核心，我利用轴对称性把跨边界点对积分降到五维，并运行 16 个独立 scrambled-Sobol 扰动、每个 \(2^{22}\) 对，共 67,108,864 对。核心载荷均值为 \(3.41900136\)，精确值为 \(8\pi/(3\sqrt6)=3.42013288\)；主要正载荷位于 \(j=-2,-1\)，唯一稳定负项是 \(j=1\) 的 \(-0.00604200\)。探索性核心载荷比为 \(0.996478\)。
en: For the compact affine core from R0.69P, I use axial symmetry to reduce the cross-boundary pair integral to five dimensions and run 16 independent scrambled-Sobol replicates with \(2^{22}\) pairs each, totaling 67,108,864 pairs. The mean core carrier is \(3.41900136\), while the exact value is \(8\pi/(3\sqrt6)=3.42013288\). The main positive carrier lies at \(j=-2,-1\), and the only stably negative term is \(j=1\), with value \(-0.00604200\). The exploratory core-carrier ratio is \(0.996478\).

zh: 对 R0.71E §10.1 已声明的 smooth broad parent frame，一个固定能量、全局光滑的 2D3C 解族在 \(\kappa=4K\) 的 parent 上满足 \(d(0)=3942K^4>0\)、\(a(0)=0\)，随后产生正振幅。完整 frequency frame 的 one-sided creation 至少为 \(A_*/(64K^2)\)，同一 frame 的 physical-time heat endpoint 至多为 \((1-2^{-1/9})/(2\nu K^4)\)。对每个固定 \(\nu>0\) 和所有充分大 dyadic \(K\)，两者比值至少按 \(K^2\) 增长。
en: For the smooth broad parent frame declared in R0.71E §10.1, a fixed-energy, globally smooth 2D3C solution family on the parent at \(\kappa=4K\) satisfies \(d(0)=3942K^4>0\) and \(a(0)=0\), then develops a positive amplitude. One-sided creation for the complete frequency frame is at least \(A_*/(64K^2)\), while the physical-time heat endpoint for the same frame is at most \((1-2^{-1/9})/(2\nu K^4)\). For every fixed \(\nu>0\) and all sufficiently large dyadic \(K\), their ratio grows at least as \(K^2\).

zh: 对 tight real-even scalar frame， \[ \int_0^\infty\Theta_s^2\,ds \le\frac12\|(-\Delta)^{-1/2}L\|_2^2 \le\frac12\|u\|_4^4. \] 除以 enstrophy 后，Leray 能量无条件推出 \(\mathcal V\in L_t^1\)。但消费端满足 \[ A_{\rm sb,+}=\Lambda_L^2\mathcal V. \] 一个固定光滑 Parseval frame 和六模态初值生成的全局光滑 2D3C NSE 解在初始热迹上精确实现 \(A_{\rm sb,+}(0)=2K^2\mathcal V(0)\)，所以从热体积恢复底边不能免除两个频率幂。
en: For a tight real-even scalar frame, \[ \int_0^\infty\Theta_s^2\,ds \le\frac12\|(-\Delta)^{-1/2}L\|_2^2 \le\frac12\|u\|_4^4. \] After division by enstrophy, Leray energy unconditionally yields \(\mathcal V\in L_t^1\). The quantity required by the regularity criterion, however, satisfies \[ A_{\rm sb,+}=\Lambda_L^2\mathcal V. \] A fixed smooth Parseval frame together with a globally smooth 2D3C NSE solution generated by six-mode initial data exactly realizes \(A_{\rm sb,+}(0)=2K^2\mathcal V(0)\) at the initial heat trace, so recovering the bottom trace from the heat bulk cannot avoid two powers of frequency.

zh: 对称化主动递推并使用精确支持 \(Q\ge-1\)，我得到 \(A_L\le\frac32\sum_{i+j=L}\min(i,j)A_iA_j\)；输运层满足相同类型的线性卷积界。 卷积常数的全阶手算界 \(H_L<32\) 使保守常数 \(K=96\) 关闭归纳。
en: By symmetrizing the active recurrence and using the exact support \(Q\ge-1\), I obtain \(A_L\le\frac32\sum_{i+j=L}\min(i,j)A_iA_j\); the transport layers satisfy a linear convolution bound of the same type. The hand-verifiable all-order bound \(H_L<32\) for the convolution constant lets the conservative constant \(K=96\) close the induction.

zh: 对冻结的对称无迹源 \(\Sigma\)，相关 \(q=\Sigma:B\) 满足 \[ \dot q=2\operatorname{tr}\!\left[R(\Sigma-qI)^2\right]\ge0, \qquad R=Q/E. \] 这是一条强化对齐的方差律，不是阻尼律。另一个非线性恒为零的精确周期 Navier–Stokes 双模剪切解给出 \(d|B|_F^2/dt=12\nu p(1-p)(2p-1)\)，在 \(p=1/5\) 与 \(4/5\) 分别取相反符号，证明归一化后的黏性也没有普适单调性。
en: For a frozen symmetric trace-free source \(\Sigma\), the correlation \(q=\Sigma:B\) satisfies \[ \dot q=2\operatorname{tr}\!\left[R(\Sigma-qI)^2\right]\ge0, \qquad R=Q/E. \] This is a variance law that strengthens alignment, not a damping law. Another exact periodic two-mode Navier–Stokes shear solution, whose nonlinearity vanishes identically, gives \(d|B|_F^2/dt=12\nu p(1-p)(2p-1)\); it has opposite signs at \(p=1/5\) and \(4/5\), proving that normalized viscosity also has no universal monotonicity.

zh: 对非负权重的滤波涡量协方差 \[ \mathcal Q_k=\sum_jw_jQ_j, \qquad Q_j=\int\chi_j\,\Omega_j\otimes\Omega_j\,dx, \] 最优 frame 常数与核满足 \[ c_*=\frac{\lambda_{\min}(\mathcal Q_k)}{\operatorname{tr}\mathcal Q_k}, \qquad \ker\mathcal Q_k=\bigcap_{j:w_j>0}\ker Q_j. \] 因此非负的尺度、中心或时间求和不能删除所有观测共享的零方向。
en: For the filtered-vorticity covariances with nonnegative weights \[ \mathcal Q_k=\sum_jw_jQ_j, \qquad Q_j=\int\chi_j\,\Omega_j\otimes\Omega_j\,dx, \] the optimal frame constant and kernel satisfy \[ c_*=\frac{\lambda_{\min}(\mathcal Q_k)}{\operatorname{tr}\mathcal Q_k}, \qquad \ker\mathcal Q_k=\bigcap_{j:w_j>0}\ker Q_j. \] Therefore, nonnegative summation over scales, centers, or times cannot remove a null direction shared by all observations.

zh: 对非零非共线三元组 \(p+q=k\)，我使用旋转协变标架 \[ n=\frac{p\times q}{|p\times q|},\qquad t_p=n\times\widehat p,\quad t_q=n\times\widehat q,\quad t_k=n\times\widehat k. \] 若 \(a=a_nn+a_tt_p\)、\(b=b_nn+b_tt_q\)，归一化有序核满足精确恒等式 \[ \mathcal K_{p,q}(a,b) =g_Na_t\bigl[b_nn+c_qb_tt_k\bigr], \quad g_N=\frac{|p\times q|}{|p||k|}, \quad c_q=\widehat q\cdot\widehat k. \]
en: For a nonzero non-collinear triad \(p+q=k\), I use the rotation-covariant frame \[ n=\frac{p\times q}{|p\times q|},\qquad t_p=n\times\widehat p,\quad t_q=n\times\widehat q,\quad t_k=n\times\widehat k. \]. If \(a=a_nn+a_tt_p\), \(b=b_nn+b_tt_q\), the normalized ordered kernel satisfies the exact identity \[ \mathcal K_{p,q}(a,b) =g_Na_t\bigl[b_nn+c_qb_tt_k\bigr], \quad g_N=\frac{|p\times q|}{|p||k|}, \quad c_q=\widehat q\cdot\widehat k. \]

zh: 对固定非零输出 \(k\)，定义 \[ \mathfrak B_k(U,V) =\frac1{|k|}P_k\sum_{p+q=k}(q\cdot U_p)V_q. \] 无散条件给出 \(q\cdot U_p=k\cdot U_p\)，从而 \[ |\mathfrak B_k(U,V)| \le\left(\sum_{p+q=k}|U_p|^2\right)^{1/2} \left(\sum_{p+q=k}|V_q|^2\right)^{1/2}. \]
en: For fixed nonzero output \(k\), define \[ \mathfrak B_k(U,V) =\frac1{|k|}P_k\sum_{p+q=k}(q\cdot U_p)V_q. \] The divergence-free condition gives \(q\cdot U_p=k\cdot U_p\), and therefore \[ |\mathfrak B_k(U,V)| \le\left(\sum_{p+q=k}|U_p|^2\right)^{1/2} \left(\sum_{p+q=k}|V_q|^2\right)^{1/2}. \]

zh: 对固定有限的 frame/cell 指标族，R0.71I 的标量式逐项给出 \[ 2\mathcal Z_+ =\partial_t\mathcal A_w +2\nu\sum_\gamma a_\gamma+2\mathcal Z_-. \] 所以 ordinary signed shell transfer 不能穿过逐壳正部。唯一 telescope 是 weighted amplitude endpoint；黏性振幅质量与 negative-source defect 都非负。soft denominator 还增加一个非负径向阻尼项。
en: For a fixed finite frame/cell index family, the R0.71I scalar equation gives term by term \[ 2\mathcal Z_+ =\partial_t\mathcal A_w +2\nu\sum_\gamma a_\gamma+2\mathcal Z_-. \] Thus ordinary signed shell transfer cannot pass through shellwise positive parts. The weighted amplitude endpoint is the only telescope; the viscous amplitude mass and negative-source defect are nonnegative. The soft denominator adds another nonnegative radial damping term.

zh: 对固定族 \(u_a=aU_1+(1-a)U_{1/4}\)，精确振幅代数给出 \[ \mathcal A_0(u_a)=a(c_1+c_2a+c_3a^2). \] 真实光滑卷积截断的外向舍入证书严格证明 \(c_3<0\) 与 \(c_2^2-4c_1c_3<0\)，因此 \(\mathcal A_0(u_a)<0\) 对每个 \(a>0\) 同时成立；退化端点另由 \(\mathcal A_{-2}(u_0)<0\) 封闭。这里没有对振幅作网格采样。
en: For the fixed family \(u_a=aU_1+(1-a)U_{1/4}\), exact amplitude algebra gives \[ \mathcal A_0(u_a)=a(c_1+c_2a+c_3a^2). \] An outward-rounded certificate for the true smooth convolved cutoff rigorously proves \(c_3<0\) and \(c_2^2-4c_1c_3<0\), so \(\mathcal A_0(u_a)<0\) simultaneously for every \(a>0\); the degenerate endpoint is closed separately by \(\mathcal A_{-2}(u_0)<0\). No amplitude grid is used.

zh: 对光滑无散解，基本能量恒等式为
en: Basic energy equality for smooth divergence-free solutions is

zh: 对光滑有界参考解， \(\|v\|_{X_\tau}\le2\sqrt\tau\|v\|_\infty\)。 因而先减小 \(\tau\)，再增大 \(\lambda\)，两个严格门槛 总能满足。强 \(BMO^{-1}\) 内点迹不再是必要假设； 全部过去到未来的耦合由有限下三角前代递推求和。 18 项形式检查与 16 组高精度矩阵交叉核对全部通过。
en: For a smooth bounded reference solution, \(\|v\|_{X_\tau}\le2\sqrt\tau\|v\|_\infty\). Decreasing \(\tau\) and then increasing \(\lambda\) therefore makes both strict gates hold. A strong interior \(BMO^{-1}\) trace is no longer required; all past-to-future coupling is summed by finite lower-triangular forward substitution. All 18 formal checks and 16 high-precision matrix cross-checks passed.

zh: 对归一化等幅候选，去混叠 Galerkin 演化的临界能量峰值为 1.09699，时间约为 0.05454； 只保留初始十模态时峰值为 1.00466，时间约为 0.01569。 初始支撑先转为不利传递，生成模态在短时内维持总增长并承担大部分涡量拉伸。
en: Critical energy peak of the de-aliased Galerkin evolution for normalized amplitude candidates is 1.09699, time about 0.05454; when only initial ten modes are retained, the peak is 1.00466, time about 0.01569. Initial support transforms to unfavorable transfer, generating modes maintain total growth and bear most of the vorticity stretching in short time.

zh: 对归一化输入，第一 Picard 目标能量的小包主项为 \(c_*\delta^3\)，其中 \(c_*=136\pi\sqrt6/688905\approx0.00151917\)； 非目标泄漏为 \(O(\delta^5)\)，所以相对泄漏是 \(O(\delta^2)\)。 在 \(\delta=0.12,N=48\) 的直接枚举中，目标占第一代输出的 98.817%。
en: For normalized inputs, the main term of the first Picard target energy packet is \(c_*\delta^3\), where \(c_*=136\pi\sqrt6/688905\approx0.00151917\); non-target leakage is \(O(\delta^5)\), so relative leakage is \(O(\delta^2)\). In direct enumeration of \(\delta=0.12,N=48\), the target accounts for 98.817% of first generation outputs.

zh: 对归一化输运 \(T_a f=(L-1)^{-1}\{a,f\}\)，中心单项式 \((i,q)\) 与输入单项式 \((j,s)\) 的精确加权列因子为 \[ \frac{i+j}{i+j-1}\frac{|i(s/j)-q|}{3}. \] 固定 \(j\) 后，完整列和关于输入斜率 \(x=s/j\in[-1,2]\) 是凸函数，所以全局最大值只需比较 \(x=-1\) 与 \(x=2\)。
en: For normalized transport \(T_a f=(L-1)^{-1}\{a,f\}\), the exact weighted column factor for center monomial \((i,q)\) and input monomial \((j,s)\) is \[ \frac{i+j}{i+j-1}\frac{|i(s/j)-q|}{3}. \] For fixed \(j\), the complete column sum is convex in the input slope \(x=s/j\in[-1,2]\), so its global maximum requires only the comparison of \(x=-1\) and \(x=2\).

For active input charge \(S=162\), let \(\alpha=\lambda/(1+162\lambda)\) and \(\beta=\mu/(1+162\mu)\). The weight ratio becomes \(c^q(1+\alpha q)(1+\beta q)\) exactly. The unique positive root of the zero-charge column satisfies \[ 0.382628602237879637<r_*<0.382628602237879638. \]

zh: 对基流的任意非零竖直频率 \(s\)，平面 \(k_3=s\) 是完整 线性化 Fourier 方程的精确不变边带。一个载波 \(p=(R,0,0)\) 与种子 \(q=(-R,m,s)\) 的完整 Fourier–Leray 符号在合适无散基下化为 \[ [\mathscr T_{R,m,s}] = \begin{pmatrix} md/Q&0\\ -Rs/Q&m \end{pmatrix}. \] 非对角伸长项在 \(s\ne0\) 时确实非零，但精确半正定恒等式 给出 \(\|\mathscr T_{R,m,s}\|\le\sqrt{m^2+s^2}\)。
en: For every nonzero vertical frequency \(s\) of the base flow, the plane \(k_3=s\) is an exact invariant sideband of the complete linearized Fourier equation. In suitable divergence-free bases, the complete Fourier–Leray symbol for a carrier \(p=(R,0,0)\) and seed \(q=(-R,m,s)\) becomes \[ [\mathscr T_{R,m,s}] = \begin{pmatrix} md/Q&0\\ -Rs/Q&m \end{pmatrix}. \] The off-diagonal stretching term is genuinely nonzero when \(s\ne0\), while an exact positive-semidefinite identity gives \(\|\mathscr T_{R,m,s}\|\le\sqrt{m^2+s^2}\).

zh: 对精确 Fourier 三线性形式进行 dyadic 分解：low–high、high–low、high–high 与近共振三波。
en: Dyadic decomposition of exact Fourier trilinear form: low–high, high–low, high–high, and near-resonant triad.

zh: 对精确无外力两谐波剪切背景族，初始扰动 \(\rho e^{-\Lambda\mathcal A_*}\phi_\Lambda\) 在固定物理时刻 \(T_*=1/1800\) 产生至少 \(c_*\rho\) 的 selected-pair 距离，同时初始 \(H^3\) 范数趋于零。
en: For the family of exact, unforced, two-harmonic shear backgrounds, the initial perturbation \(\rho e^{-\Lambda\mathcal A_*}\phi_\Lambda\) produces, at the fixed physical time \(T_*=1/1800\), a selected-pair distance of at least \(c_*\rho\), while its initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero.

zh: 对临界线 \(2/q+3/p=1\)，投影积分分部误差经标准能量类范数恰好只落在 \(L_t^1\)。一个固定环面上的同范数集中序列进一步证明：对每个 \(s>1\)， 仅靠两个能量范数和临界投影范数都不存在有限的统一 \(L_t^s\) 控制函数。
en: On the critical line \(2/q+3/p=1\), the projector integration-by-parts error, estimated through the standard energy-class norms, lies exactly only in \(L_t^1\). A same-norm concentration sequence on a fixed torus further proves that, for every \(s>1\), no finite uniform \(L_t^s\) control function can depend only on the two energy norms and the critical projector norm.

zh: 对满足 \(\inf_KY>0\) 的 compact classical trajectory，Hilbert-valued zero sampling 给出 all-shell estimate \[ \mu_J(K)\lesssim \mathcal R_Y(K)\left[ |K|^{-1}\!\int_K\!Y^{-1}\sum_j\kappa_j^{-6}\|C_{j,t}\|_2^2 +|K|\!\int_K\!Y^{-1}\sum_j\kappa_j^{-6}\|C_{j,tt}\|_2^2\right]. \] 常数不依赖 zero count、minimum separation 或 finite shell truncation。closed-interval endpoints 可用 classical trace 纳入。
en: For a compact classical trajectory satisfying \(\inf_KY>0\), Hilbert-valued zero sampling gives the all-shell estimate \[ \mu_J(K)\lesssim \mathcal R_Y(K)\left[ |K|^{-1}\!\int_K\!Y^{-1}\sum_j\kappa_j^{-6}\|C_{j,t}\|_2^2 +|K|\!\int_K\!Y^{-1}\sum_j\kappa_j^{-6}\|C_{j,tt}\|_2^2\right]. \] The constant is independent of zero count, minimum separation, or finite shell truncation. Closed-interval endpoints are included through classical traces.

zh: 对每个平移不变的标量环带滤波器，Lamb 交换子 \[ \mathcal R_j=T_j(u\times\omega)-u\times T_j\omega \] 有精确的二次速度增量公式。resolved transport 与 \(\operatorname{curl}\mathcal R_j\) 单独都不必保持环带支撑；只有二者融合后的 \(G_j\) 恢复 band limitation。
en: For every translation-invariant scalar annular filter, the Lamb commutator \[ \mathcal R_j=T_j(u\times\omega)-u\times T_j\omega \] has an exact quadratic velocity-increment formula. Resolved transport and \(\operatorname{curl}\mathcal R_j\) need not preserve annular support separately; only the fused \(G_j\) recovers band limitation.

zh: 对每个正 gap、\(c_\mu\ne0\)，lifted tangent line 不 invariant；只有 \(c_\mu\to c_0\ne0\) 才给 nonzero hidden-mean limit，fixed \(\Lambda\) raw-\(q\) limit 保持 OPEN。
en: For every positive gap with \(c_\mu\ne0\), the lifted tangent line is not invariant; only \(c_\mu\to c_0\ne0\) gives a nonzero hidden-mean limit, while the fixed \(\Lambda\) raw-\(q\) limit remains OPEN.

At either endpoint, the degree factor decreases with \(j\), so every input degree reduces to \(j=1\). At \(N=80\) and \(r_*=32/125\), the two complete endpoint bounds are \(0.8585562829\) and \(0.8621992110\), whereas the R0.39 termwise transport bound is \(1.3859898383\).

zh: 对任意 dyadic \(L,M\)，令 \(H=4LM\)，并把一个连续高频壳切成 \(M\) 个长度为 \(L\) 的块。对载频 \[ R_{r,n}=H+rL+n \] 使用张量 Rudin--Shapiro 符号 \(c_{r,n}=b_ra_n\)，在 \(p_{r,n}=(R_{r,n},0,0)\) 与 \(q_{r,n}=(-R_{r,n},r+1,0)\) 放置正交极化。
en: For arbitrary dyadic \(L,M\), set \(H=4LM\) and split one consecutive high-frequency shell into \(M\) blocks of length \(L\). For carrier \[ R_{r,n}=H+rL+n \], use tensor Rudin--Shapiro signs \(c_{r,n}=b_ra_n\) and place orthogonal polarizations at \(p_{r,n}=(R_{r,n},0,0)\) and \(q_{r,n}=(-R_{r,n},r+1,0)\).

zh: 对任意 physical Fourier coefficients，正确的两侧移位必须写成 \(w_lF_{r-r_l}+\overline{w_l}F_{r+r_l}\)。它对应实值 shear multiplier，因而保留 skew coupling 与能量收缩；把旧的对称移位直接换成复系数会破坏这一结构。精确 target row 仍满足 \[ \rho_A^2=2K_z^2\sum_l|w_l|^2e^{-2\kappa r_l^2A_0}. \]
en: For arbitrary physical Fourier coefficients, the two shifts must be written as \(w_lF_{r-r_l}+\overline{w_l}F_{r+r_l}\). This form corresponds to a real-valued shear multiplier and therefore preserves skew coupling and energy contraction; directly replacing the old symmetric shifts by complex coefficients destroys that structure. The exact target row still satisfies \[ \rho_A^2=2K_z^2\sum_l|w_l|^2e^{-2\kappa r_l^2A_0}. \]

zh: 对任意对称无迹张量 \(S\) 与向量 \(w\)，精确恒等式是 \[ S:\operatorname{dev}(w\otimes w)=w^{\mathsf T}Sw. \] 纯 helicity 实波的相位平均核为 \(K_S(\xi)=-\xi^{\mathsf T}S\xi\)，与 helicity 符号无关。取 \(S_0=\operatorname{diag}(1/2,1/2,-1)\) 可构造逐点恒等于一的 Beltrami 见证；完整球平均只消去有符号二次谐波，正部平均仍为 \(\sqrt3/9\)。
en: For any symmetric trace-free tensor \(S\) and vector \(w\), the exact identity is \[ S:\operatorname{dev}(w\otimes w)=w^{\mathsf T}Sw. \] The phase-averaged kernel of a real pure-helicity wave is \(K_S(\xi)=-\xi^{\mathsf T}S\xi\), independent of the helicity sign. Taking \(S_0=\operatorname{diag}(1/2,1/2,-1)\) produces a Beltrami witness that is identically one pointwise; the full-sphere average cancels only the signed quadratic harmonic, while the positive-part average remains \(\sqrt3/9\).

zh: 对任意无迹对称应变矩阵，我证明尖锐点态界 \[ |\omega\cdot S\omega| \le\sqrt{\frac23}|S||\omega|^2. \] 取 \(S=\operatorname{diag}(-1,-1,2)/\sqrt6\)、涡量沿最大伸长方向即可取等。 更关键的是，向量势 \(B_A=-x\times(Ax)/3\) 与 \(v_A=\nabla\times(\chi B_A)\) 把任意无迹仿射速度梯度嵌入紧支撑无散场，并在整个小球上保持取等。 20 项形式检查全部通过。
en: For every symmetric trace-free strain matrix, I prove the sharp pointwise bound \[ |\omega\cdot S\omega| \le\sqrt{\frac23}|S||\omega|^2. \] Taking \(S=\operatorname{diag}(-1,-1,2)/\sqrt6\) and aligning vorticity with the most extensional direction gives equality. More importantly, the vector potential \(B_A=-x\times(Ax)/3\) and \(v_A=\nabla\times(\chi B_A)\) embed every trace-free affine velocity gradient in a compactly supported solenoidal field and preserve equality on an entire ball. All 20 formal checks passed.

zh: 对声明的 real-shear exact triangular Fourier-lattice evolution，不再尝试统一限制 raw root count。复标量 bounded-variation zero lemma 把任意有限根子集上的 squared slopes 压到首个斜率与一次总变差；目标行中 \(V_z'\) 和 \(V_z(D_q+\lambda_0)\) 合并后，exact contraction 与耗散恒等式给出 \[ \sum_{F_0(\tau)=0}|F_0'(\tau)|^2 \le e^{2\lambda_0L}(4+C_\kappa\delta_{\rm obs}) \delta_{\rm obs}^2M. \] 上确界处理完整零集，因此常数不含 root count、minimum gap、fill distance 或 second spectral moment。
en: For the declared real-shear exact triangular Fourier-lattice evolution, no uniform raw-root-count bound is attempted. A complex scalar bounded-variation zero lemma reduces the squared slopes on any finite root subset to the first slope and one total-variation term. After \(V_z'\) and \(V_z(D_q+\lambda_0)\) are combined in the target row, exact contraction and the dissipation identity give \[ \sum_{F_0(\tau)=0}|F_0'(\tau)|^2 \le e^{2\lambda_0L}(4+C_\kappa\delta_{\rm obs}) \delta_{\rm obs}^2M. \] Taking the supremum handles the complete zero set, so the constant has no root-count, minimum-gap, fill-distance, or second-spectral-moment cost.

zh: 对数辛恒等式、指数分解和有限截断不闭合都是全阶形式结论。 总次数 119 的 GMP 回归只检查实现；尚未证明最终符号、主导奇点或 Navier–Stokes 正则性。
en: The log-symplectic identities, exponential factorization, and nonclosure of finite truncations are all-order formal results. The GMP regression through total degree 119 checks only the implementation; eventual signs, dominant singularities, and Navier–Stokes regularity remain unproved.

zh: 对数辛输运与无限电荷阶梯
en: Log-symplectic transport and the infinite charge ladder

zh: 对所有 \(\varepsilon=gB/R^2>0\)，我得到保留 \(K=\mathcal R_Y\) 与 \(x=\Theta Q_*\) 的 full-lattice complete-root upper bound。对带固定背景、phase-aligned、row-aligned 的 launch，local exact correction 在 \(\tau=c_*/(R^2+gB)\) 产生精确根并给出 \(x\ge Z\)。
en: For every \(\varepsilon=gB/R^2>0\), I obtain a full-lattice complete-root upper bound retaining \(K=\mathcal R_Y\) and \(x=\Theta Q_*\). For a launch with a fixed background, phase alignment, and row alignment, the local exact correction produces an exact root at \(\tau=c_*/(R^2+gB)\) and gives \(x\ge Z\).

zh: 对特征值 \(\lambda_1\ge\lambda_2\ge\lambda_3\ge0\)，最佳平面残差与最佳直线残差分别是 \[ \lambda_3, \qquad \lambda_2+\lambda_3. \] 在 \(E=\operatorname{tr}Q>0\) 且取 \(0<2\delta<\eta<1/2\) 后，强制、近线与近面区域可以定义成互斥完备的三分法，并给出相应主投影的定量谱隙。
en: For eigenvalues \(\lambda_1\ge\lambda_2\ge\lambda_3\ge0\), the best-plane and best-line residuals are respectively \[ \lambda_3, \qquad \lambda_2+\lambda_3. \] On \(E=\operatorname{tr}Q>0\), once \(0<2\delta<\eta<1/2\) is fixed, the coercive, near-line, and near-plane regions form a disjoint and exhaustive trichotomy, with quantitative spectral gaps for the corresponding principal projectors.

zh: 对同一 real-shear exact triangular lattice，令 \(\eta=|\delta|\Omega\)、\(I=[A,A+L]\)，并以 \(\ell_2(I)=\Omega^{-2}\int_I\|V_z(x)\|^2dx\) 记录局部暴露。exact contraction、BV 零点采样与耗散给出 \[ G_{\rm all}^{\rm ex}(I) \le e^{2\lambda_0L}M\Omega^2 \bigl[4+\eta\min\{L,C_\kappa\}\bigr]. \] 对从 reference launch 开始的 mixed window，normalized ledger 因而至多为 \[ C\nu^{-2}e^{2\lambda_0L}M^{-2}\eta^{4/3} \bigl[4+\eta\min\{L,C_\kappa\}\bigr]. \]
en: For the same real-shear exact triangular lattice, let \(\eta=|\delta|\Omega\), \(I=[A,A+L]\), and record local exposure by \(\ell_2(I)=\Omega^{-2}\int_I\|V_z(x)\|^2dx\). Exact contraction, BV zero sampling, and dissipation give \[ G_{\rm all}^{\rm ex}(I) \le e^{2\lambda_0L}M\Omega^2 \bigl[4+\eta\min\{L,C_\kappa\}\bigr]. \] For a mixed window starting at the reference launch, the normalized ledger is therefore at most \[ C\nu^{-2}e^{2\lambda_0L}M^{-2}\eta^{4/3} \bigl[4+\eta\min\{L,C_\kappa\}\bigr]. \]

zh: 对同一时刻的全部 entries，leading direction 支撑在 cutoff cell 中。bounded overlap 与 annular \(\dot H^{-1}\) square sum 给出 \[ \mathsf e_\Lambda(t) \le M_\chi C_T\frac{\|L(t)\|_{\dot H^{-1}}^2}{Y(t)} \lesssim M_\chi C_T\|u(t)\|_2Y(t)^{1/2}. \] 因而同刻 batch 被一次 time-slice square-function estimate 吸收。
en: For all entries at the same time, the leading direction is supported in the cutoff cell. Bounded overlap and the annular \(\dot H^{-1}\) square sum give \[ \mathsf e_\Lambda(t) \le M_\chi C_T\frac{\|L(t)\|_{\dot H^{-1}}^2}{Y(t)} \lesssim M_\chi C_T\|u(t)\|_2Y(t)^{1/2}. \] Thus a single time-slice square-function estimate absorbs the same-time batch.

zh: 对移动 cutoff \(\chi_Q\)，projected-Lamb 热方程的局部账本完整保留时间面、两个热高度面、cutoff–curl 功、运输/形状残差和黏性 collar。projected 与 material 两种写法由 \[ \int\chi_QW_{j,s}\cdot G_{j,s} =B_Q^L-\int e_{j,s}u\cdot\nabla\chi_Q \] 精确互换，不能把两套边界误算成两个独立缺陷。
en: For a moving cutoff \(\chi_Q\), the local ledger for the projected-Lamb heat equation fully retains the temporal faces, both heat-height faces, cutoff–curl work, transport/shape residuals, and the viscous collar. The projected and material forms are exchanged exactly by \[ \int\chi_QW_{j,s}\cdot G_{j,s} =B_Q^L-\int e_{j,s}u\cdot\nabla\chi_Q \], so the two sets of boundary terms cannot be miscounted as two independent defects.

zh: 对有符号功 \(w_i\)、正权 \(d_i\) 和任意有限分区 \(\Pi\)，令 \[ E_\Pi=\sum_{B\in\Pi} \frac{\left((\sum_{i\in B}w_i)^+\right)^2} {\sum_{i\in B}d_i}. \] 若 \(\Pi'\) 细化 \(\Pi\)，则 \(E_\Pi\le E_{\Pi'}\)；在二叉树上，细账本精确等于根账本加全部非负细化缺陷。
en: For signed works \(w_i\), positive weights \(d_i\), and any finite partition \(\Pi\), set \[ E_\Pi=\sum_{B\in\Pi} \frac{\left((\sum_{i\in B}w_i)^+\right)^2} {\sum_{i\in B}d_i}. \] If \(\Pi'\) refines \(\Pi\), then \(E_\Pi\le E_{\Pi'}\); on a binary tree, the fine ledger equals the root ledger plus all nonnegative refinement defects exactly.

zh:
对有序 Fourier--Leray 双线性项，无散条件把 \(q\cdot\widehat u(p)\) 精确改写成 \(k\cdot\widehat u(p)\)。输出临界权 \(|k|^{-1}\) 随之消去，得到 \[ \|\mathcal T(u,v)\|_{\mathcal E_
u} \le
u^{-1}\|u\|_{\mathcal E_
u} \|v\|_{\mathcal E_
u}. \] 标准次数主控 \(M=z+M^2\) 的精确半径为 \(1/4\)，但它与 R0.54 的约化半径没有已证明的数值可比性。
en:
For the ordered Fourier--Leray bilinear term, the divergence-free condition rewrites \(q\cdot\widehat u(p)\) exactly as \(k\cdot\widehat u(p)\). The critical output weight \(|k|^{-1}\) then cancels, giving \[ \|\mathcal T(u,v)\|_{\mathcal E_
u} \le
u^{-1}\|u\|_{\mathcal E_
u} \|v\|_{\mathcal E_
u}. \] The standard degree majorant \(M=z+M^2\) has exact radius \(1/4\), but no proved numerical comparison relates it to the reduced radius in R0.54.

zh: 对真正改变无量纲半径比的族 \(u_{\varepsilon,a}=aU_1+(1-a)U_\varepsilon\)，我证明了精确三次生产律 \[ \mathcal V=V_q\bigl(a^3+\varepsilon^3(1-a)^3\bigr) +\varepsilon^3a(1-a)^2C_q, \] 其中 \(a^2(1-a)\) 系数因紧支撑分部积分精确为零。更关键的是，纯尺度环带序列在 \(\ell^1\) 中分离，全部混合项相对质量一致为 \(O(\varepsilon(1+\log(1/\varepsilon)))\)，所以 \(\sup_a|\Gamma_{\rm ann}(u_{\varepsilon,a})-\Gamma_q|\to0\)。
en: For the family \(u_{\varepsilon,a}=aU_1+(1-a)U_\varepsilon\), which genuinely changes a dimensionless radius ratio, I proved the exact cubic production law \[ \mathcal V=V_q\bigl(a^3+\varepsilon^3(1-a)^3\bigr) +\varepsilon^3a(1-a)^2C_q, \] where the \(a^2(1-a)\) coefficient vanishes exactly by compact-support integration by parts. More importantly, the pure-scale annular sequences separate in \(\ell^1\), while the relative mass of all mixed terms is uniformly \(O(\varepsilon(1+\log(1/\varepsilon)))\), so \(\sup_a|\Gamma_{\rm ann}(u_{\varepsilon,a})-\Gamma_q|\to0\).

zh: 对中心单项式 \((i,q)\) 与严格尾输入 \((j,s)\)，我保留精确列因子中的共同斜率 \[ \frac{i+j}{i+j-1}\left|i\frac{s}{j}-q\right|\frac{|s-q|}{3|s+q|}. \] 固定 \(2\le s\le240\) 后，完整中心核关于 \(x=s/j\) 是凸函数，因此全部允许输入次数只需比较 \(x=0\) 与 \(x=s/J_s\) 两个共同端点。
en: For center monomial \((i,q)\) and strict-tail input \((j,s)\), I retain the common slope in the exact column factor \[ \frac{i+j}{i+j-1}\left|i\frac{s}{j}-q\right|\frac{|s-q|}{3|s+q|}. \] For fixed \(2\le s\le240\), the complete center kernel is convex in \(x=s/j\), so every admissible input degree requires only the two common endpoints \(x=0\) and \(x=s/J_s\).

zh: 多起点变分搜索定位到一个 2D3C 子族。在该子族中，固定临界范数和三线性注入的泄漏极小可化为一元方程。 解析候选提升为稠密包后，把逃逸/注入比降到约 6.25。
en: Multi-start variational search locates a 2D3C subfamily. In this subfamily, fixing the critical norm and minimizing leakage of trilinear injection reduces to an algebraic equation. Analytic candidates are promoted to dense packets, reducing escape/injection ratio to about 6.25.

zh: 多载波、multiscale physical absorption 与一般三维正则性仍开放。
en: Multiple carriers, multiscale physical absorption, and general three-dimensional regularity remain open.

zh: 二阶传播给出一个公共催化负曲率方向，说明反对称二维降维会漏项；显式有理极化把目标比例提高到 \(5.2532\%\)。
en: Second-order propagation gives a common catalytic negative curvature direction, indicating antisymmetric two-dimensional reduction would miss terms; explicit rational polarization raises the target ratio to \(5.2532\%\).

zh: 二阶耗散把压力余项降回二次涡量，主障碍转向三维拉伸
en: Second-derivative dissipation reduces the pressure remainder to quadratic enstrophy, shifting the main obstruction to three-dimensional stretching

zh: 二阶时间 jet 可以求和，raw recurrence 不能计数
en: The second-time jet is summable; raw recurrence cannot be counted uniformly

zh: 二进仿射截断族的固定核心载体最终精确饱和，但完整场只是临界自相似膨胀，全空间双增量比严格不变。因此核心限制的静态统一亏损路线关闭，全空间问题转向真正改变形状的两尺度族。
en: The fixed-core carrier of the dyadic affine-cutoff family eventually saturates exactly, but the complete field is only a critical self-similar dilation and the full-space double-increment ratio is strictly invariant. The core-restricted static uniform-deficit route therefore closes, and the full-space problem moves to a genuinely shape-changing two-scale family.

zh:
二维中涡量拉伸项消失；三维中 \((\omega\cdot
abla)u=S\omega\) 可以放大涡量，其中 \(S=(
abla u+
abla u^\mathsf T)/2\) 是应变张量。相应的 enstrophy 恒等式含有无定号项
en:
Stretching term of vorticity vanishes in two dimensions; in three dimensions, the \((\omega\cdot
abla)u=S\omega\) can amplify vorticity, where \(S=(
abla u+
abla u^\mathsf T)/2\) is the strain tensor. The corresponding enstrophy identity contains a non-symmetric term

zh: 二元支持锥 \(s\le2j\) 把 \(s\ge241\) 扇区的统一输入次数下界从 81 提高到 121，预定失败点 \(r=0.330\) 已转为严格全阶通过。
en: The binary support cone \(s\le2j\) raises the uniform input degree floor in the \(s\ge241\) sector from 81 to 121, turning the designated failure point \(r=0.330\) into a strict all-order pass.

zh: 发散的是分离上界，不是真实完整根账本
en: The separated upper bound diverges, not the true complete-root ledger

zh: 法向近饱和方向的归一化球面测度为 \[ \frac{|\{\widehat p:g_N\ge1-\delta\}|}{|S^2|} =\sqrt{2\delta-\delta^2}, \] 同样与壳分离无关。这严格排除了只对法向增益做正角向包络或 \(L^s\) 平均来获得壳衰减的路线。
en: The normalized spherical measure of the normal near-saturation directions is \[ \frac{|\{\widehat p:g_N\ge1-\delta\}|}{|S^2|} =\sqrt{2\delta-\delta^2}, \], likewise independent of the shell separation. This strictly rules out the route of obtaining shell decay only by applying a positive angular envelope to the normal gain or averaging \(L^s\).

zh: 法向增益 \(g_N=\sin\angle(p,k)\) 是整个有序核的精确算子范数， 当且仅当 \(p\cdot k=0\) 时达到一。面内增益为 \(g_T=g_N|c_q|<g_N\)。令 \(\varepsilon=|k|/|p|\)、\(\mu=\widehat p\cdot\widehat k\)，则 \[ g_N=\sqrt{1-\mu^2},\qquad g_T=\frac{\sqrt{1-\mu^2}|\varepsilon-\mu|} {\sqrt{1+\varepsilon^2-2\varepsilon\mu}}. \]
en: The normal gain \(g_N=\sin\angle(p,k)\) is the exact operator norm of the entire ordered kernel, attaining one if and only if \(p\cdot k=0\). The in-plane gain is \(g_T=g_N|c_q|<g_N\). Let \(\varepsilon=|k|/|p|\), \(\mu=\widehat p\cdot\widehat k\); then \[ g_N=\sqrt{1-\mu^2},\qquad g_T=\frac{\sqrt{1-\mu^2}|\varepsilon-\mu|} {\sqrt{1+\varepsilon^2-2\varepsilon\mu}}. \]

zh: 反例覆盖的是页面中列出的桥接与正规形，不排除加入额外动态信息后的其他估计，也没有给出正则性定理。
en: The counterexamples cover the bridges and normal forms listed on this page. They do not rule out other estimates with additional dynamic information, and they do not give a regularity theorem.

zh: 反例只排除声明的 majorant 闭合，不排除保留更多符号或时空耦合的估计。
en: The counterexample rules out only the stated majorant closure; estimates that retain more sign or space-time coupling are not excluded.

en: return to top ↑

en: return to the top of the home page

zh: 方向
en: direction

zh: 方向核的精确相消不能抵抗涡量模长集中
en: Exact cancellation of the directional kernel cannot resist vorticity-magnitude concentration

zh: 方向扩散只是总涡量耗散的一部分，尖锐仿射核心排除内部自动吸收
en: Direction diffusion is only part of total vorticity dissipation; the sharp affine core rules out automatic interior absorption

zh: 方向零点采样闭合 complete complex-target ledger；common-band 完整物理根账本统一衰减。
en: Directional zero sampling closes the complete complex-target ledger; the complete common-band physical root ledger decays uniformly.

zh: 仿射荷权重越过乘法全局最优边界
en: An affine charge weight beyond the global multiplicative optimum

zh: 仿射与高阶 harmonic Taylor 项逐阶带来局部增益；但对 bounded reservoirs，任意预先固定的展开阶数仍留下可线性累计的 gap 核。
en: Affine and higher-order harmonic Taylor terms produce local gains order by order; for bounded reservoirs, however, every expansion order fixed in advance still leaves a gap kernel that can accumulate linearly.

zh: 非二分图、三角返回和物理反族是三道不同的门
en: A non-bipartite graph, triangle return, and a physical counterfamily are three distinct gates

zh: 非负核提供结构分解，不提供 signed stretching 的双边等价，也没有自动产生正则性。
en: The nonnegative kernel provides a structural decomposition, not a two-sided equivalence for signed stretching, and it does not automatically produce regularity.

zh: 非交换回路是精确矩阵 ODE 见证，尚未嵌入无外力周期 NSE 轨道；秩缺陷则由独立的精确 NSE 剪切流实现。Leray 能量仍未控制拉回余项，本阶段没有得到新的继续性判据。
en: The noncommutative loop is an exact matrix-ODE witness and has not yet been embedded in an unforced periodic NSE trajectory; the rank defect is realized by a separate exact NSE shear flow. Leray energy still does not control the pulled-back residuals, and this stage yields no new continuation criterion.

zh: 非局部涡量差分消去一个近场奇性阶，但精确优化仍返回经典六次代价
en: The nonlocal vorticity difference removes one near-field singular order, but exact optimization still returns the classical sextic cost

zh: 非零均值 packet 的单包对角精确满足 \(B_{\rm crit}\ge\kappa_j^2\)。同向聚簇事件的最优有限常数是 Gram 矩阵的最大特征值，并随事件密度增长。反向热伴随对未归一化方向源 \(g=\langle F,e\rangle\) 的 strong norm 为常数；在 frozen-denominator 模型中，相对 Leray-order input \(\kappa^{-1}g\) 精确带回 \(\kappa^2\)。variable \(Y\) 还会产生 \(\sqrt Y\) 或 \(Y_t/(2Y)\) 项。一类 normalized bilinear temporal kernels 服从同一二分：非零均值看见 entry 并支付两阶；零均值漏掉常值 directional signal。even touch 还使双侧 signed face 完全抵消。
en: The single-packet diagonal of a nonzero-mean packet satisfies exactly \(B_{\rm crit}\ge\kappa_j^2\). The optimal finite constant for same-direction clustered events is the largest eigenvalue of the Gram matrix and grows with event density. The backward-heat adjoint has constant strong norm for the unnormalized directional source \(g=\langle F,e\rangle\); in the frozen-denominator model, relative to the Leray-order input \(\kappa^{-1}g\), it recovers exactly the \(\kappa^2\) factor. Variable \(Y\) also produces \(\sqrt Y\) or \(Y_t/(2Y)\) terms. A class of normalized bilinear temporal kernels obeys the same dichotomy: nonzero mean sees the entry and pays two orders, while zero mean misses a constant directional signal. An even touch also makes the two-sided signed face cancel completely.

zh: 非自伴绝热跟踪与匹配增长作用量
en: Nonselfadjoint adiabatic tracking and matching growth action

zh: 分离的 \(B_AQ_*\) 正项不能逐项物理吸收；同一全奇族的真实 complete ledger 由 joint exposure 与 parity 修复并统一衰减。
en: The separated positive \(B_AQ_*\) term cannot be physically absorbed term by term; the true complete ledger of the same all-odd family is repaired by joint exposure and parity and decays uniformly.

zh: 分离极化尺度与正定联合 Hessian
en: separation of polarization scales from positive definite joint Hessian

zh: 分离指标的优化可以精确完成： \[ B_M-B_{M+1} =\bigl(2^{-5M}-2^{-5(M+1)}\bigr) \sum_{m\ge M+1}e_m\ge0, \qquad \inf_M B_M=\sum_{m\ge2}2^{-5m}e_m. \] 因此增大 \(A\) 会缩小合并远场尾，却只是把固定壳层迁入过渡和；极限不是零。14 项形式检查全部通过。
en: The separation index can be optimized exactly: \[ B_M-B_{M+1} =\bigl(2^{-5M}-2^{-5(M+1)}\bigr) \sum_{m\ge M+1}e_m\ge0, \qquad \inf_M B_M=\sum_{m\ge2}2^{-5m}e_m. \] Thus increasing \(A\) shrinks the lumped far tail but merely moves fixed shells into the transition sum; the limit is not zero. All 14 formal checks passed.

zh: 分裂半径的唯一最优值正比于 \(A/B\)，代回后精确得到 \[ |\mathcal V|\le C_*A^{3/2}B^{3/2}. \] 振幅缩放与 Navier–Stokes 空间缩放还证明，只使用 \(A=\|\omega\|_2\)、\(B=\|\nabla\omega\|_2\) 时，指数 \(p=q=3/2\) 是唯一可能。Young 吸收因而仍产生 \(A^6\) 余项。
en: The unique optimal splitting radius is proportional to \(A/B\), and substitution gives exactly \[ |\mathcal V|\le C_*A^{3/2}B^{3/2}. \] Amplitude scaling and Navier-Stokes spatial scaling further prove that when only \(A=\|\omega\|_2\) and \(B=\|\nabla\omega\|_2\) are used, \(p=q=3/2\) is the only possible choice. Young absorption therefore still produces an \(A^6\) remainder.

zh: 风险
en: risk

zh: 否定捷径：
en: Rejected shortcuts:

zh: 否定推断：
en: Rejected inferences:

zh: 浮点探针显示旧 \(s=162,j=81\) 活跃列会与零荷扇区相遇。 正式证明只固定邻近有理参数 \(c=19939/25000\)、\(\lambda=7653/10000\)，不把探针当成 二参数全局最优证书。固定范数的唯一锐根被隔离在 \[ 0.382624471846022<r_*<0.382624471846023. \] 81 项 Sturm 链的端点变号数为 40 与 39。
en: The floating-point probe shows the old active \(s=162,j=81\) column meeting the zero-charge sector. The formal proof fixes only the nearby rational parameters \(c=19939/25000\) and \(\lambda=7653/10000\); it does not treat the probe as a certificate of two-parameter global optimality. The unique sharp root for the fixed norm is isolated in \[ 0.382624471846022<r_*<0.382624471846023. \] The endpoint variation counts of the 81-element Sturm chain are 40 and 39.

zh: 负边缘递推精确降成两个标量生成方程；电荷一端点扩展到 \(N=75\) 后，有限窗口显示 \(|\sigma_{B,N}|\) 接近一，而不是按 \(N^{-1}\) 变小。
en: The negative-edge recurrence reduces exactly to two scalar generating equations. After extending the charge-one endpoint through \(N=75\), the finite window shows \(|\sigma_{B,N}|\) approaching one rather than decreasing like \(N^{-1}\).

zh: 负尺度核心范数化成尖锐 Hardy 核，frozen-low sector 可以闭合
en: The negative-scale core is normalized into a sharp Hardy kernel, and the frozen-low sector closes

zh: 负尺度核心范数精确化成 \(s^{-1/2}\) 时间 Hardy 核。冻结低频部分可由能量关闭；moving-low 与偏差对角项仍停在临界边界。
en: The negative-scale core norm becomes exactly a \(s^{-1/2}\) temporal Hardy kernel. The frozen low-frequency part closes by energy; the moving-low and off-diagonal deviation terms remain at the critical boundary.

zh: 负面：有限时破裂
en: negative: finite time blow-up

zh: 复参数夹逼尚未严格退化为等号； 结论仍只覆盖 R0.11 固定极化和第五阶纯非线性齐次项，不包含热项、Taylor 余项或完整 PDE。
en: complex parameter squeezing has not yet strictly degenerated into equality; the conclusion only covers fixed polarization at R0.11 and fifth-order pure nonlinear homogeneous terms, without heat terms, Taylor remainder, or full PDE.

zh: 复导数不必为零；每个根隙只需要自己的实投影
en: The complex derivative need not vanish; each root gap needs only its own real projection

zh: 复振幅等号与极化一阶下降
en: equality of complex amplitudes with first-order polarization decrease

zh: 复振幅问题已闭合，但四角极化空间的全局最优仍未知； 热项、Taylor 余项、稠密包与逐壳 PDE 迭代仍未包含。
en: the problem of complex amplitudes is closed, but the global optimum in the four-corner polarization space remains unknown; heat terms, Taylor remainders, dense packets, and shell-by-shell PDE iterations are still not included.

zh: 该 exact shear 类是真实的光滑周期 NSE 解。对所有实振幅，signed production 在每个正 heat 尺度上为零；对非零振幅 \(A\ne0\)，gradient covariance 严格为正且正尺度 size 按 \(|A|^3\) 增长。本节因此关闭 production-only coercivity 路线，但不提供任意三维解的新正估计。
en: This exact shear class consists of genuine smooth periodic NSE solutions. For every real amplitude, signed production vanishes at every positive heat scale; for every nonzero amplitude \(A\ne0\), the gradient covariance is strictly positive, and the positive-scale size grows as \(|A|^3\). This section therefore closes the production-only coercivity route, but provides no new positive estimate for arbitrary three-dimensional solutions.

zh: 该结论是单壳代数与有限 Fourier 见证，不自动延伸为全壳动态控制，也不是一般正则性结论。
en: This conclusion is single-shell algebra with a finite Fourier witness. It does not automatically extend to full-shell dynamic control and is not a general regularity result.

zh: 该区间没有证明盒内局部根就是精确实数 意义下唯一的全局最大点，也没有建立到任意三维无散速度场、尺度临界 PDE 范数或完整 Fourier 相互作用几何的控制桥梁。
en: This enclosure does not prove that the local root in the box is the unique global maximizer in the exact-real sense, or establish a control bridge to arbitrary three-dimensional divergence-free velocity fields, scale-critical PDE norms, or the complete Fourier interaction geometry.

zh: 改进主控与统一解析域
en: Improved majorant and unified analytic domain

zh: 高阶 Picard 目标真实存在；R0.59 剪切包仍不是奇点候选。
en: The higher-order Picard targets are genuinely present, but the R0.59 shear packet is still not a singularity candidate.

zh: 高频对相干地产生共同低模属于经典范数膨胀机制； 当前结果是它与 R0.56 法向通道的精确对齐及相应估计类的不可能性定理。 它没有估计时间积分 Duhamel 算子，没有控制任意大初值，也不是三维 Navier--Stokes 正则性结论。
en: Coherent production of a common low mode by high-frequency pairs is a classical norm-inflation mechanism. The present result identifies its exact alignment with the R0.56 normal channel and proves an impossibility theorem for the corresponding estimate class. It does not estimate the time-integrated Duhamel operator, control arbitrarily large initial data, or establish any three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity result.

zh: 高频平移 Rudin–Shapiro 块把 phase-free 尖锐尺度实现为真实动力学下界
en: A high-frequency shifted Rudin–Shapiro block realizes the sharp phase-free scale as a genuine dynamical lower bound

zh: 高频族只排除纯空间时间切片函数不等式，不是奇性解。R0.69L 原式因此不是新的 \(\varepsilon\)-正则性判据；可保留的是严格远场 Morrey 引理。
en: The high-frequency family rules out only a purely spatial time-slice functional inequality; it is not a singular solution. The original R0.69L bound is therefore not a new \(\varepsilon\)-regularity criterion; the rigorous far-field Morrey lemma is the part retained.

zh: 高涡量区的方向相干性可削弱 vortex stretching 并保证正则。
en: direction coherence in high vorticity regions can weaken vortex stretching and ensure regularity.

zh: 根节点分解表明，主贡献来自一个初始叶作用于四阶外部子树，而不是预定的均匀五门链。 对 R0.11 固定极化和两种等幅同相催化模态，纯六次第五阶系数的外部/目标能量比 有唯一全局极小 \(45.7393489647\ldots\)，目标比例至多为 \(2.139525\%\)。
en: root node decomposition shows that the main contribution comes from an initial leaf acting on a fourth-order external subtree rather than the predetermined uniform five-gate chain. For fixed polarization at R0.11 and two coherent phase-same amplitude catalytic modes, there is a unique global minimum for the ratio of external/target energy for pure sixth-order fifth-order coefficients \(45.7393489647\ldots\), with the target ratio at most as \(2.139525\%\).

zh: 根仍只在原 observation interval \(I=[a,b]\) 计数，付款区间改为包含 launch 的 \(K=[\sigma_q,b]\)。先把公共 \(1/\mathcal R_Y(K)\) 分配进 atom sum，再用 launch enstrophy 取得 \(\sup_KY\gtrsim q^2(S^2K_s+P^2K_v)\)，从而消去逐根 matched background floor。unit phases 的 \(K_s\gtrsim M^3\) 最终给出 \[ \frac{\mathcal J_{\rm all}(I)}{D^{1/3}\Lambda_1(K)} \le C\nu^{-2} \frac{\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})}{M^2}. \]
en: Roots are still counted only in the original observation interval \(I=[a,b]\), while the payment interval becomes the launch-inclusive \(K=[\sigma_q,b]\). First distribute the common \(1/\mathcal R_Y(K)\) through the atom sum, then use launch enstrophy to obtain \(\sup_KY\gtrsim q^2(S^2K_s+P^2K_v)\), eliminating the rootwise matched-background floor. For unit phases, \(K_s\gtrsim M^3\) finally gives \[ \frac{\mathcal J_{\rm all}(I)}{D^{1/3}\Lambda_1(K)} \le C\nu^{-2} \frac{\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}(1+\delta_{\rm obs})}{M^2}. \]

zh: 根式与生成元已从系数递推中完全提出；整个认证根盒上，\(8\le N\le40\) 的奇偶符号和 \(18\le N\le40\) 的连续比值分离得到精确有理数证书。
en: roots and generating elements have been completely extracted from coefficient recursion; throughout the certification root box, odd-even signs of \(8\le N\le40\) and continuous ratios of \(18\le N\le40\) are obtained with exact rational number certificates.

zh: 共同定义域上的 Kato transport、固定快时间块和移动补空间相对衰减已经闭合。真实 selected orbit 在完整 \(D\in[0,1/450]\) 上取得与 \(\exp(\varepsilon^{-1}\int_0^D\lambda_0)\) 匹配的两侧增益，乘法常数不随 \(\varepsilon\downarrow0\) 发散。
en: Kato transport on the common domain, fixed fast-time blocks, and moving-complement relative decay are closed. Across the full \(D\in[0,1/450]\), the exact selected orbit attains a two-sided gain matching \(\exp(\varepsilon^{-1}\int_0^D\lambda_0)\), with multiplicative constants that do not diverge as \(\varepsilon\downarrow0\).

zh: 共同解析域和认证半径属于约化系统；它们不能直接控制一般三维解。
en: The common analytic domain and certified radius belong to the reduced system; they do not directly control general three-dimensional solutions.

zh: 共同输入斜率、凸性端点定理与 0.370 精确重启
en: Common input slope, convex endpoint theorem, and exact restart at 0.370

zh: 共同响应不随壳距衰减；保留正输出后得到精确的 enstrophy 消费端
en: Common response does not decay with shell separation; retaining the positive output yields an exact enstrophy consumer

zh: 共同转动一阶导数恒为零，根盒上的共同二阶块满足严格 Sylvester 下界；与 R0.18 的三变量块合并后，所选五变量 Hessian 正定。
en: common first-order derivatives vanish on the root box; the common second-order block satisfies a strict Sylvester lower bound; after merging with three-variable blocks at R0.18, the selected five-variable Hessian is positive definite.

zh: 构造改变对数径向形状的两尺度非自相似族，分离核心—过渡与过渡—过渡点对，直接审计完整全空间双增量环带比；只有该比值的解析饱和或临界严格亏损才进入主路线。
en: Construct a two-scale, non-self-similar family that changes shape in logarithmic radius, separate core–transition and transition–transition pairs, and audit the complete full-space double-increment annular ratio directly. Only analytic saturation or a critical strict deficit for that ratio enters the main route.

zh: 构造满足精确 NS 相互作用、光滑初值与正式外力条件的级联，并严密验证奇点。
en: construct a cascade satisfying exact NS interactions, smooth initial data, and formal external force conditions, and rigorously validate singularities.

zh: 构造周期 Koch–Tataru 临界路径空间的时间重启、端点迹与局部逆拼接定理，在每个认证光滑参考区间上给出可计算的 \(\mathfrak M_v(T)\) 上界；若端点结构不足，则精确定位失效的迹或局部化估计。
en: Construct a time-restart, endpoint-trace, and local-inverse gluing theorem for the periodic Koch–Tataru critical path space, giving a computable upper bound for \(\mathfrak M_v(T)\) on every certified smooth reference interval. If the endpoint structure is insufficient, locate the failed trace or localization estimate exactly.

zh: 构造最小 Fourier 三波和多壳样例，检验所有拟议临界不等式。
en: construct minimal Fourier triad and shell-like examples to test all proposed critical inequalities.

zh: 固定 \(M\) 的任意静态相位 Morse shape gate 已经闭合
en: The arbitrary-static-phase Morse shape gate for fixed \(M\) is closed

zh: 固定 \(M\) 与 jet dominance 不能删除；任意时变相位和任意快速变化振幅的 ED 未证明；caustic 只标记 Morse applicability，不是 ED 失败。
en: Fixed \(M\) and jet dominance cannot be removed; enhanced dissipation for arbitrary time-dependent phases or arbitrarily fast amplitude variation is not proved; the caustic marks only Morse applicability, not failure of enhanced dissipation.

zh: 固定 cutoff 下，完整 localized-vorticity row 满足 \[ M_Q=\mathsf A_Q\left[\nu(\Delta+\kappa^2)W_j+\mathcal G_j\right]. \] 因而 raw viscous collar 与 localized Laplacian commutator 不是两个独立源。单 Laplace eigenspace 例子中，两个 expanded rows 分别非零却逐点完全相消；先分开取绝对值会制造 representation-dependent cost。
en: Under a fixed cutoff, the complete localized-vorticity row satisfies \[ M_Q=\mathsf A_Q\left[\nu(\Delta+\kappa^2)W_j+\mathcal G_j\right]. \] Therefore the raw viscous collar and localized Laplacian commutator are not two independent sources. In a single-Laplace-eigenspace example, the two expanded rows are separately nonzero yet cancel pointwise exactly; taking their absolute values separately creates a representation-dependent cost.

zh: 固定 cutoff 只使 motion row 与 refresh atom 为零；cutoff–curl、denominator collar、viscous collar、projective tangent 和 \(Y_t/Y\) rows 都被保留。黏性 collar 的 weighted absolute budget 可以达到 \(K^{-2}\)，与正生成同阶，但目前没有从 Leray energy 得到它的独立支付。
en: A fixed cutoff makes only the motion row and refresh atom vanish; cutoff–curl, denominator collar, viscous collar, projective tangent, and the \(Y_t/Y\) rows are all retained. The weighted absolute budget of the viscous collar can reach \(K^{-2}\), the same order as positive creation, but no independent payment for it has yet been obtained from Leray energy.

zh: 固定 target \(K_y=K_z=1\) 与固定 macroscopic window 的 exact unforced 2.5D NSE 序列，对 second prescribed root 与 selected singleton target-shell rows 满足 \[ J_{2,q}/((2/\ell)B_{1,q}^{(*)})\asymp q^2,\qquad J_{2,q}/((7\ell/3)B_{2,q}^{(*)})\asymp q^{-2}. \] selected second-time row 能支付该事件，同一 selected first-time row 单独不能；singleton selection 已经失败。这不是 complete fixed-frame ledger 的 no-go。该族不证明 \(7\ell/3\) sharp，也不排除完整 global \(\nu^2\) baseline 或另一 dynamical charge。
en: With fixed target \(K_y=K_z=1\) and fixed macroscopic window, the exact unforced 2.5D NSE sequence satisfies, for the second prescribed root and selected singleton target-shell rows, \[ J_{2,q}/((2/\ell)B_{1,q}^{(*)})\asymp q^2,\qquad J_{2,q}/((7\ell/3)B_{2,q}^{(*)})\asymp q^{-2}. \] The selected second-time row pays for the event, while the same selected first-time row alone does not; the singleton selection already fails. This is not a no-go theorem for the complete fixed-frame ledger. The family does not prove \(7\ell/3\) sharp and does not exclude the complete global \(\nu^2\) baseline or another dynamical charge.

zh: 固定半平面 \(\operatorname{Re}z\ge0.12\) 内无其他谱点。补空间 reduced resolvent 一致有界，半群满足 \(Ce^{0.12t}\) 增长上界；选定 rank-one 谱块的逆向群满足 \(Ce^{-0.16t}\)，保守实部安全间隔为 \(1/25\)。
en: The fixed half-plane \(\operatorname{Re}z\ge0.12\) contains no other spectral points. The complementary-space reduced resolvent is uniformly bounded, and the semigroup obeys a \(Ce^{0.12t}\) growth bound; the selected rank-one spectral block has the backward-group bound \(Ce^{-0.16t}\), and the conservative real-part safety margin is \(1/25\).

zh: 固定背景 Lyapunov 不稳定性的可行性与障碍审计；不预设闭合。
en: Feasibility and obstruction audit for fixed-background Lyapunov instability; closure is not presupposed.

zh: 固定充分小 coupling、complete root set 与 \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) 的 declared-family internal saturation 已闭合。
en: Fixed sufficiently small coupling, the complete root set, and declared-family internal saturation of \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) are closed.

zh: 固定充分小的 \(0<\delta\le\delta_*\)，并取 \(\mathscr A_{q,\delta}=\delta q^2\)。uniform IFT 分支保留。ECT 零点预算、compact \(C^1\) 分离和半直线 integrating factor 共同证明：声明区间中的 positive target roots 恰好是预设的 \(N\) 个 simple roots。
en: Fix sufficiently small \(0<\delta\le\delta_*\) and take \(\mathscr A_{q,\delta}=\delta q^2\). The uniform IFT branch persists. The ECT zero budget, compact \(C^1\) separation, and a half-line integrating factor together prove that the positive target roots in the declared interval are exactly the prescribed \(N\) simple roots.

zh: 固定初始动能的全局光滑 2D3C NSE 解族证明：对任意 \(M<\infty\)， 可使低壳局部正功在 \(0\le t\le M/(\nu K^2)\) 保持正号。 这排除 sign-only 的统一常数，但不排除定量高迹；在同一见证族的弱非线性极限， \(B/B(0)\to e^{-4\theta}\)、\(q/q(0)\to e^{-6\theta}\)，固定正相对阈值仍按 \((\nu K^2)^{-1}\) 退出。
en: A globally smooth 2D3C NSE family with fixed initial kinetic energy proves that for every \(M<\infty\), low-shell local work can remain positive on \(0\le t\le M/(\nu K^2)\). This rules out a uniform sign-only constant but does not rule out a quantitative high trace. In the weakly nonlinear limit of the same witness family, \(B/B(0)\to e^{-4\theta}\) and \(q/q(0)\to e^{-6\theta}\), while a fixed positive relative level still exits on the \((\nu K^2)^{-1}\) scale.

zh: 固定从 \(w_0\) 出发的参考解 \(v\in X_T\)，令 \(\mathcal A_vz=\mathcal B(v,z)+\mathcal B(z,v)\)。若 \(I-\mathcal A_v\) 在目标区间上可逆，且 \(M_T=\|(I-\mathcal A_v)^{-1}\|<\infty\)，则两条真正 非线性轨道之差满足精确方程 \[ z_r=e^{t\Delta}U_r(0)+\mathcal A_vz_r+\mathcal B(z_r,z_r). \]
en: Fix \(w_0\) and its reference solution \(v\in X_T\), and set \(\mathcal A_vz=\mathcal B(v,z)+\mathcal B(z,v)\). If \(I-\mathcal A_v\) is invertible on the target interval and \(M_T=\|(I-\mathcal A_v)^{-1}\|<\infty\), then the difference between the two genuinely nonlinear trajectories obeys the exact equation \[ z_r=e^{t\Delta}U_r(0)+\mathcal A_vz_r+\mathcal B(z_r,z_r). \]

zh: 固定第二频率后，平行剪切方程的 Picard 展开只有一条 时间有序 Dyson 链。Rudin--Shapiro 热包络把完整相互作用参数压到 \[ \Theta_m(t_H)\le\frac{1+\sqrt2}{4}\frac{\varepsilon}{L}, \] 与载频数 \(M\) 无关。
en: After fixing the second frequency, the Picard expansion of the parallel-shear equation contains only one time-ordered Dyson chain. The Rudin--Shapiro heat envelope bounds the complete interaction parameter by \[ \Theta_m(t_H)\le\frac{1+\sqrt2}{4}\frac{\varepsilon}{L}, \] independently of the number of carrier frequencies \(M\).

zh: 固定仿射权重 \(c=0.79756,\lambda=0.7653\) 保持代数常数一，并把阈值严格提高到 \(0.382624471846022<r_*<0.382624471846023\)。相对 R0.50 的半径增益大于 12.174 ppm；最近竞争者切换为零荷扇区。
en: The fixed affine weight \(c=0.79756,\lambda=0.7653\) preserves algebra constant one and strictly raises the threshold to \(0.382624471846022<r_*<0.382624471846023\). The radius gain over R0.50 exceeds 12.174 ppm, and the nearest competitor switches to the zero-charge sector.

zh: 固定负荷精确端点、统一导数证书与 0.371 重启
en: Exact fixed-negative-charge endpoint, uniform derivative certificate, and restart at 0.371

zh: 固定光滑参考区间上的临界线性化预解已经证明有限
en: The critical linearized resolvent is now proved finite on a fixed smooth reference interval

zh: 固定核心边界载体最终精确无抵消；纯自相似膨胀却无法改变全空间环带比
en: The fixed-core boundary carrier eventually has exactly no cancellation, while pure self-similar dilation cannot change the full-space annular ratio

zh: 固定荷 \(s=-1\) 的完整列在 \(t=1/j\in[0,1/82]\) 上有严格正导数，真实最大值是 \(j=82\)；共同半径推进到 0.371，而 0.372 在同一精确诱导列上超过一。
en: The complete fixed-charge \(s=-1\) column has strictly positive derivative on \(t=1/j\in[0,1/82]\), and its exact maximum is attained at \(j=82\). The common radius advances to 0.371, while the same exact induced column exceeds one at 0.372.

zh: 固定荷抽取使用 \(Z=\Xi^{-1},W=R\Xi^2\)。一个位于 \(|Z|<\rho_Z,|W|<\rho_W\) 内的圆形 \(\Xi\) 轮廓存在，当且仅当 \[|R|<\rho_Z^2\rho_W.\] R0.32 高阶有限候选需要的最小平衡双变量半径约为 \(0.90834\)，是 R0.31 认证半径 \(4/81\) 的 18.3937 至 18.3943 倍。
en: Fixed-charge extraction uses \(Z=\Xi^{-1},W=R\Xi^2\). Inside \(|Z|<\rho_Z,|W|<\rho_W\), a circular \(\Xi\)-contour exists if and only if \[|R|<\rho_Z^2\rho_W.\] The high-cut finite R0.32 candidate needs a minimum balanced bivariate radius of about \(0.90834\), which is 18.3937 to 18.3943 times the R0.31 certified radius \(4/81\).

zh: 固定荷抽取域、非零中心平移障碍和同半径算子不有界性已经证明；外半径到半半径的显式全阶界为 \(121/48\)。
en: The fixed-charge extraction domain, the nonzero-center translation obstruction, and same-radius operator unboundedness are now proved; the explicit all-order outer-to-half-radius bound is \(121/48\).

zh: 固定荷级数与奇点候选
en: Fixed-charge series and singularity candidate

zh: 固定荷延拓几何与同半径障碍
en: Fixed-charge continuation geometry and the same-radius obstruction

zh: 固定目标、记号和检查方法
en: fix target, notation, and inspection methods

zh: 固定能量的 matched low-block 分片只证明底边–bulk 的临界分离，不是 full-frame 两侧估计。严格内部 one-block 缩放只排除纯乘法 \(o(r^{-2})\) 因子；临界 \(Cr^{-2}\) 被饱和而未被否定。本节没有得到无条件底边迹可积性、奇性构造或全局正则性。
en: The fixed-energy matched low-block partition proves only critical bottom-versus-bulk separation, not a full-frame two-sided estimate. The strictly interior one-block scaling rules out only purely multiplicative \(o(r^{-2})\) factors; the critical \(Cr^{-2}\) factor is saturated, not refuted. This section obtains neither unconditional bottom-trace integrability, a singularity construction, nor global regularity.

zh: 固定能量全局光滑 2D3C 解只排除统一的点态角速度能量界；同一族的 \(K^{-2}\)-weighted variation 在固定黏性时间窗反而趋零。非恒定 matched cutoff 给出的 \(D_\delta,R_\delta,J_\delta\) 又显示，正源比可达到有限临界常数， 同时被黏性 projective curvature 在主阶抵消。
en: A fixed-energy, globally smooth 2D3C solution rules out only a uniform pointwise angular-velocity energy bound; for the same family, the \(K^{-2}\)-weighted variation instead tends to zero on a fixed viscous time window. The values \(D_\delta,R_\delta,J_\delta\) from a nonconstant matched cutoff also show that the positive source ratio can reach a finite critical constant while being canceled at leading order by viscous projective curvature.

zh: 固定能量全局光滑 2D3C 族排除统一 sign-only 驻留常数；固定正相对阈值仍保持临界黏性时间。
en: A fixed-energy globally smooth 2D3C family rules out a uniform sign-only residence constant; fixed positive relative levels still retain the critical viscous time.

zh: 固定匹配空间小区仍保留两阶热支付差，黏性 collar 留在主阶
en: Fixed matched spatial cells still retain a two-power heat-payment gap, while the viscous collar remains at leading order

zh: 固定时间的核心矩变化可以估计；进入真实嵌套时空积分后，时间窗与尺度耦合产生 \(r_k^{-2}\) 放大，抵消了静态矩的小量。
en: The change of core moments can be estimated at each fixed time; after entering the genuine nested space-time integral, the coupling between the time window and the scale produces an \(r_k^{-2}\) amplification that cancels the small static moment.

zh: 固定时间核心矩变化可控，嵌套时间窗却放大两个临界尺度
en: Core-moment variation is controlled at fixed time, but nested time windows amplify two critical scales

zh: 固定实系数同一直线相位（同相或反相） 1:2 正类的完整多载波传播门已经闭合
en: The full multi-carrier propagation gate is closed for the fixed real-collinear-phase (in-phase or antiphase) 1:2 positive class

zh: 固定输出的有符号聚合仍不能产生壳衰减。一个实值无散、同壳且位于收缩反向角帽内的相干频率包，使法向通道精确达到 \(\ell^2\times\ell^2\) 常数一；交换项逐个为零，瞬时热演化后等号仍保持。
en: Signed aggregation at a fixed output still does not produce shell decay. A real-valued divergence-free coherent packet, supported in one shell and in shrinking oppositely directed angular caps, makes the normal channel attain the sharp \(\ell^2\times\ell^2\) value one. Every exchanged term vanishes, and equality persists under instantaneous heat evolution.

zh: 固定四位仿射传输的主谱投影严格非零；完整热加权四次系数满足 \(S_r=C_*\lambda^r+O(r16^r)\)，其中 \(C_*<-2\times10^{-5}\)。
en: The dominant spectral projection of the fixed four-bit affine transfer is rigorously nonzero. The complete heat-weighted quartic coefficient satisfies \(S_r=C_*\lambda^r+O(r16^r)\), where \(C_*<-2\times10^{-5}\).

zh: 固定物理紧集内的 all-center graph constant 给 all-start exact-path semigroup 与 integrated A2 energy；Bloch twist 与 strong-row direct sum 只在 A2 rate 上闭合。
en: On a fixed physical compact set, the all-center graph constant gives the all-start exact-path semigroup and integrated A2 energy; the Bloch twist and strong-row direct sum close only at the A2 rate.

zh: 固定小耦合在声明的 triangular family 内达到三分之一次方端点
en: Fixed small coupling reaches the one-third endpoint within the declared triangular family

zh: 固定小区的完整 projective pairing 精确化为 \[ \langle P_QF_j,P_QM_Q\rangle =\int\chi_Q\left(G_j-\frac{B_Q}{d_Q}\operatorname{curl}C_Q\right) \cdot(G_j+\nu H_j). \] 当前直接 Cauchy 产生 resolved transport、differentiated commutator、projective denominator geometry 与 viscous annular mismatch 四行尺度临界消费者；这是充分账本，不是必要条件。
en: The complete projective pairing on a fixed cell becomes exactly \[ \langle P_QF_j,P_QM_Q\rangle =\int\chi_Q\left(G_j-\frac{B_Q}{d_Q}\operatorname{curl}C_Q\right) \cdot(G_j+\nu H_j). \] Direct Cauchy currently produces four scale-critical consumers: resolved transport, the differentiated commutator, projective denominator geometry, and viscous annular mismatch. This is a sufficient ledger, not a necessary condition.

zh: 固定小区上，完整标量先有精确的平方—余项表示 \[ \mathcal J_Q =\frac{\mathcal P_Q^\square+\mathfrak R_Q}{\sqrt{Yd_Q}}, \qquad \mathcal P_Q^\square =\int\chi_Q\left|G_j+\frac\nu2H_j\right|^2. \] 名义率 \(\nu\kappa_j^2\) 与 radial/projective 坐标中的项精确消去。
en: On a fixed cell, the complete scalar first has the exact square–residual representation \[ \mathcal J_Q =\frac{\mathcal P_Q^\square+\mathfrak R_Q}{\sqrt{Yd_Q}}, \qquad \mathcal P_Q^\square =\int\chi_Q\left|G_j+\frac\nu2H_j\right|^2. \] The nominal rate \(\nu\kappa_j^2\) cancels exactly against the term in radial/projective coordinates.

zh: 固定一个阶一光滑横向初值 \(w_0\)，在其参考解临界路径范数有限的任意时间区间上，比较从 \(w_0+U_r(0)\) 与 \(w_0\) 出发的两条真正非线性轨道；目标是证明差以 \(O(\rho^r)\) 收敛，或定位一个明确的阶一非线性端点损失。
en: Fix a smooth order-one transverse datum \(w_0\). On every interval where its reference solution has finite critical path norm, compare the two genuinely nonlinear trajectories starting from \(w_0+U_r(0)\) and \(w_0\). The goal is to prove convergence of their difference at rate \(O(\rho^r)\), or to locate a concrete order-one nonlinear endpoint loss.

zh: 固定有限电荷带不闭合；两个尖锐输运数组同时约化为一组对数辛坐标和一个显式指数分解。
en: A fixed finite charge band does not close; the two sharp transport arrays reduce simultaneously to log-symplectic coordinates and an explicit exponential factorization.

zh: 固定整数 \(q_0>R_*\)，取 \(\nu=d=K_z=r_1=1\)、\(K_y=0\)。 载波隔离、精确 diagonal conjugacy 与 Bessel \(C^1\) 比较给前 \(R\) 个正时间简单根； selected target-row mass 为 \((8/\pi^2)\log R+O(1)\)。
en: Fix an integer \(q_0>R_*\) and set \(\nu=d=K_z=r_1=1\) and \(K_y=0\). Carrier isolation, exact diagonal conjugacy, and a Bessel \(C^1\) comparison give the first \(R\) simple positive-time roots; the selected target-row mass is \((8/\pi^2)\log R+O(1)\).

zh: 固定正半平面分裂与对数快时间传递
en: Fixed-positive-half-plane splitting and logarithmic fast-time transfer

zh: 固定注入下的频谱泄漏优化
en: optimize spectral leakage under fixed injection

zh: 关闭的是对所有光滑解成立的普适正标量 frame 常数；条件性方向激励、矩阵值混合观测与低秩区域的正则性问题仍然开放。本阶段没有得到新的继续性判据，也没有解决千禧年问题。
en: I have closed only the possibility of a universal positive scalar frame constant valid for every smooth solution; conditional directional excitation, matrix-valued mixed observations, and regularity in low-rank regimes remain open. At this stage I have obtained neither a new continuation criterion nor a solution of the Millennium Problem.

zh: 关闭的是高频盲有限观测到未过滤临界横向涡量的统一直接桥。光滑族不排除单个解的定性有限性或固定正延迟估计；周期反例也不能直接调用陈述于全空间的 Miller 定理。本阶段没有得到新的继续性判据，也没有解决千禧年问题。
en: What is closed is the uniform direct bridge from finite high-frequency-blind observations to unfiltered critical transverse vorticity. The smooth family does not exclude qualitative finiteness for an individual solution or an estimate after a fixed positive delay; nor can the periodic counterexample directly invoke Miller's theorem, which is stated on the whole space. This stage obtains no new continuation criterion and does not solve the Millennium problem.

zh: 关键不是分别最大化各块后组装矩阵，而是先把同一个输入列的两块输出合并， 再对输入次数与荷取上确界。刻意粗糙的 \(2\times2\) 块矩阵在目标上 仍严格失败：\(D+BC-1=0.0812566985>0\)；相关列却保留了被该矩阵 丢掉的互补信息。
en: The key is not to maximize the blocks separately and then assemble a matrix, but to combine the two outputs of the same input column before taking the supremum over input degree and charge. The deliberately coarse \(2\times2\) block matrix still strictly fails at the target: \(D+BC-1=0.0812566985>0\); the correlated column retains the complementary information discarded by that matrix.

zh: 关键一步
en: key step

zh: 观察层缩短可压低强耦合上界，但 Bessel 根仍留下对数斜率质量
en: Shortening the observation layer reduces the strong-coupling upper bound, but Bessel roots still leave logarithmic slope mass

zh: 光滑解局部存在
en: local existence of smooth solutions

zh: 归一化把形状变得有界，却不会自动产生耗散律
en: Normalization makes the shape bounded, but does not automatically produce a dissipation law

zh: 归一化两个自由卷积指标以后，每个 \(0100\) 周期成为同一个 四十八态仿射测度算子。12,288 条精确分支的质量矩阵具有唯一主根 \(25.1515893341015<\lambda<25.1515893341016\)。
en: After the two free convolution indices are normalized, every \(0100\) cycle becomes the same forty-eight-state affine measure operator. The mass matrix of its 12,288 exact branches has the unique dominant root \(25.1515893341015<\lambda<25.1515893341016\).

zh: 规范五原子提升 \(J\) 使缺陷 \(R=\mathcal PJ-JL\) 消去常数和全部四个仿射坐标。 路径绝对转移满足 \(A_{\rm abs}w=65536w\)，而二阶泰勒 余项带来 \(16^{-2}\) 收缩，因此零仿射空间上的增长至多为 \(256\)。
en: The canonical five-atom lift \(J\) makes the defect \(R=\mathcal PJ-JL\) annihilate constants and all four affine coordinates. The pathwise absolute transfer satisfies \(A_{\rm abs}w=65536w\), while the second-order Taylor remainder supplies a factor \(16^{-2}\); therefore growth on the zero-affine space is at most \(256\).

zh: 过小种子的非线性相对放大与精确二维屏障
en: Nonlinear relative amplification for an over-small seed and the exact planar barrier

zh: 还需要解决的问题
en: still open problems to be solved

zh: 耗散 action 不在安全分支；时变剪切仍给次线性 cubic
en: The dissipative action is not on the safe branch; the time-dependent shear still gives a sublinear cubic

zh: 荷 \(q=2k-n\) 来自带权圆周作用 \(\gamma_\theta(Z,W)=(e^{-i\theta}Z,e^{2i\theta}W)\)。 因而 \(\Pi_q\) 是沿整条荷圆周轨道的 Fourier 投影，而不是普通局部 Taylor 系数选择。
en: The charge \(q=2k-n\) comes from the weighted circle action \(\gamma_\theta(Z,W)=(e^{-i\theta}Z,e^{2i\theta}W)\). Therefore \(\Pi_q\) is Fourier projection along the full charge-circle orbit, not ordinary local Taylor coefficient selection.

en: Charge-resolved kernel, infinite-sector closure, and analytic-radius expansion

zh: 横向扰动与预解拼接
en: Transverse perturbations and resolvent patching

zh: 横向伸长仍然存在，但完整临界线性增益几何消失
en: Transverse stretching persists, but the complete critical linear gain vanishes geometrically

en: subsequent propositions can clearly refer back to the assumption without mixing \(\mathbb R^3\), channels with periodic domains.

zh: 回到有符号 Biot–Savart 核的物理空间环带分解，完整保留截断交换子和边界通量，并用仿射核心与六模态场做双重压力测试。
en: Return to a physical-space annular decomposition of the signed Biot-Savart kernel, retain every cutoff commutator and boundary flux, and stress-test it against both the affine core and the six-mode field.

zh: 活跃列的唯一正根已被隔离到宽度 \(10^{-18}\) 的有理区间；整个相邻百万分位窗口内，243 个竞争对象均严格更小。
en: The unique positive root of the active column has been isolated in a width-\(10^{-18}\) rational interval; throughout the adjacent-millionth window, all 243 competitors remain strictly smaller.

zh: 活跃约束和零荷约束对 \((A,B)\) 都是仿射函数。 精确矩符号把可行性化为三个必要不等式 \(H\le0\)、\(P\le0\)、\(Q\le0\)。在 \(r=0.382629\)、\(0.1337\le c\le0.803\) 上， 自适应张量 Bernstein 覆盖只需 14 个闭矩形：9 个由 \(H>0\) 排除，1 个由 \(P>0\) 排除，4 个由 \(Q>0\) 排除。两个根矩形的精确叶质量都等于一。
en: The active and zero-charge constraints are both affine functions of \((A,B)\). Exact moment signs reduce feasibility to three necessary inequalities \(H\le0\), \(P\le0\), and \(Q\le0\). On \(r=0.382629\), \(0.1337\le c\le0.803\), the adaptive tensor Bernstein cover needs only 14 closed rectangles: 9 excluded by \(H>0\), 1 by \(P>0\), and 4 by \(Q>0\). The exact leaf mass on each root rectangle equals one.

zh: 机器证书在现有 50/49 项系数窗口内枚举 216 个相关尾部主子式，其中 67 个为负。 这证明表中次数范围内的全称排除；“更晚没有负见证”仍只是一项有限窗口事实，不能反过来证明更高次背景存在。
en: The machine certificate enumerates 216 relevant tail principal minors within the available 50/49-coefficient window, of which 67 are negative. This proves the universal exclusions over the degree ranges in the table; no later negative witness remains only a finite-window fact and cannot be reversed into proof that a higher-degree background exists.

zh: 极化二阶鞍点与有限有理改进
en: polarized second-order saddle point and finite rational improvement

zh: 极化通道分解把唯一的二次项定位为 \(N^2|\sigma_A\sigma_B|\)；\(N=4,5\) 的高精度探针仍与 \(|\sigma|=O(N^{-1})\) 假设相容。
en: The polarization-channel decomposition identifies \(N^2|\sigma_A\sigma_B|\) as the only quadratic term; the high-precision probes at \(N=4,5\) remain consistent with the hypothesis \(|\sigma|=O(N^{-1})\).

zh: 几何基线
en: Geometric baseline

zh: 计算机辅助弱非唯一性预印本
en: computer-assisted weak non-uniqueness preprint

zh: 记 \(\delta_r=\|U_r(0)\|_{BMO^{-1}_{\rm per}}\) 与 \(\chi_r=4C_BM_T^2C_H\delta_r\)。当 \(\chi_r<1\) 时， 较小二次根同时封闭自映射与严格压缩，得到唯一的邻近解分支 \[ \|u_r-v\|_{X_T} \le \frac{1-\sqrt{1-\chi_r}}{2C_BM_T} \le2M_TC_H(6+4\sqrt2)\rho^r. \] 完整扰动自相互作用没有被删去，非线性只改变有界前因子， 不改变 \(\rho^r\) 的几何指数。18 项源锁定检查全部通过。
en: Let \(\delta_r=\|U_r(0)\|_{BMO^{-1}_{\rm per}}\) and \(\chi_r=4C_BM_T^2C_H\delta_r\). When \(\chi_r<1\), the smaller quadratic root closes both the self-map and strict-contraction estimates, producing the unique nearby solution branch \[ \|u_r-v\|_{X_T} \le \frac{1-\sqrt{1-\chi_r}}{2C_BM_T} \le2M_TC_H(6+4\sqrt2)\rho^r. \] The full perturbation self-interaction is retained: nonlinearity changes only a bounded prefactor, not the geometric exponent \(\rho^r\). All 18 source-locked checks pass.

zh: 记录方式
en: records method

zh: 继承的主动尾界为 \(0.9944093112<1\)，完整残差约为 \(1.7968\times10^{-42}\)，球映射与 Lipschitz 条件严格通过。 相邻探针 \(257/1000\) 的多项式输运仍为 \(0.8672866880<1\)，但主动尾充分界变为 \(1.0002561524>1\)；瓶颈已经重新落在主动尾估计。
en: The inherited active-tail bound is \(0.9944093112<1\), the complete residual is about \(1.7968\times10^{-42}\), and the ball-mapping and Lipschitz conditions pass strictly. At the adjacent probe \(257/1000\), polynomial transport remains \(0.8672866880<1\), but the sufficient active-tail bound becomes \(1.0002561524>1\); the bottleneck has moved back to the active-tail estimate.

zh: 继承端点严格小于 \(1/450\)；完整传播子得到显式连续体上作用量；完整顶谱块的最小、最大增益在零窗口具有共同切向速率 \(a\)。
en: The inherited endpoint is strictly below \(1/450\); the full evolution has an explicit continuum upper action; and the minimum and maximum gains on the complete top block share zero-window tangent rate \(a\).

zh: 继续优化 \(\tau,\lambda\) 或无符号时间分片没有研究收益。 信息损失发生在把方向、符号与空间几何压成 \(\sup_I\|v\|_\infty\) 这一步。
en: Further optimization of \(\tau,\lambda\) or unsigned time partitions has no research payoff. The information is lost when direction, sign, and spatial geometry are compressed into \(\sup_I\|v\|_\infty\).

zh: 加权 Wiener 重启与解析半径扩张
en: Weighted Wiener restart and analytic-radius expansion

zh: 加权目标还有独立的点态账本 \(H_m=\sup_{K_m}\mathcal H\)。Temam 尺度按 \((1+\sup\|u\|_{H^1}^2)^{-2}\) 缩小；若该尺度在潜在奇点端点一致，本身已经是 continuation-level input。
en: The weighted target also has an independent pointwise ledger \(H_m=\sup_{K_m}\mathcal H\). Temam's scale shrinks like \((1+\sup\|u\|_{H^1}^2)^{-2}\); if this scale remains uniform at a potential singular endpoint, it is already continuation-level input.

zh: 加入最小的 signed third-order lift，寻找其 physical-time 方程中可被 \(\nu\partial_s\) 或 Stokes smoothing 吸收的组合；保留 tensor-only 无符号 envelope，检验式 (8.8) 能否与式 (1.2) 的 carré-du-champ 正项配对，并把 \(s^{-1/2}\) 损失放进可积的时间结构。
en: Add the minimal signed third-order lift and seek combinations in its physical-time equation that can be absorbed by \(\nu\partial_s\) or Stokes smoothing; retain the tensor-only unsigned envelope, test whether equation (8.8) can be paired with the positive carré-du-champ term in equation (1.2), and place the \(s^{-1/2}\) loss inside an integrable time structure.

zh: 剪切结构可算，但解族始终光滑
en: The shear structure is computable, but the solution family remains smooth

zh: 检查
en: checking

zh: 检查方法
en: checking method

zh: 检查是否存在临界耗散小因子
en: check for the existence of critical dissipative small parameter

zh: 检查相对热流条件、频率包络和临界 Besov 拓扑能否形成严格大于 \(H^{1/2}\) 球、同时仍可全时段拼接的稳定域，并先完成 Kato、Koch--Tataru、Iftimie、Gallagher 与 Mucha 路线的碰撞审计。
en: Examine whether relative heat-flow conditions, frequency envelopes, and critical Besov topologies can form a stability domain strictly larger than the \(H^{1/2}\) ball while remaining compatible with patching across the full time interval, and first complete a collision audit of the Kato, Koch--Tataru, Iftimie, Gallagher, and Mucha routes.

zh: 检验负阶 Sobolev 与 Hardy–BMO 近场对偶，要求在适当弱解能量空间中有意义、保留 \(2^{-5m}\) 远场增益，并避开已有正则性混合范数。
en: Test negative Sobolev and Hardy–BMO near-field duality, requiring it to be meaningful in the suitable-weak-solution energy space, retain the \(2^{-5m}\) far-field gain, and avoid mixed norms already covered by regularity theory.

zh: 检验局部能量不等式、反向热核截断与时间频率分解，能否把时间积分后的 \(\mu_v\sigma_v^3\) 降到二次 CKN 量加可吸收耗散。
en: Test whether the local energy inequality, a backward-heat-kernel cutoff, and a time-frequency decomposition can reduce the time-integrated \(\mu_v\sigma_v^3\) to quadratic CKN quantities plus absorbable dissipation.

zh: 简单有理乘积仿射权严格越过 R0.52 的完整单仿射上界。零荷列有唯一正阈值根，固定点重启通过，281 个竞争记录全部保留严格间隙；阈值半径的严格下增益超过 \(10.7949\) ppm。
en: A simple rational product-affine weight strictly exceeds the complete R0.52 single-affine upper bound. The zero-charge column has a unique positive root, the fixed-point restart passes, all 281 competitor records retain strict gaps, and the strict lower gain in threshold radius exceeds \(10.7949\) ppm.

zh: 见证目前是标量压力源，并非由无散速度生成。结果只关闭朴素调和 Taylor 减法，不排除速度生成约束或跨壳相消。
en: The current witness is a scalar pressure source, not one generated by a divergence-free velocity. The result closes only naive harmonic Taylor subtraction and does not exclude velocity-generated constraints or cross-shell cancellation.

zh: 建立二维非线性离轨 bootstrap；若二次余项不能被吸收，就停在线性定理。
en: Establish a two-dimensional nonlinear departure bootstrap; if the quadratic remainder cannot be absorbed, stop at the linear theorem.

zh: 建立近场、过渡环带与应力局部化远场尾的三区域压力预算，统一缩放后优化分离比。
en: Build a three-zone pressure budget for the near field, transition annulus, and stress-localized far tail, then optimize the separation ratio after a common scaling normalization.

zh: 建立现代弱解框架，并明确留下规则性与可能奇异性问题。
en: Establish a modern framework for weak solutions and explicitly leave the issues of regularity and possible singularities.

zh: 建立选定增益 \(G_\Lambda\) 的匹配作用量。
en: Establish matching actions for the selected gain \(G_\Lambda\).

zh: 渐近极限使用六个自由载频坐标。八次中心矩每态有 \({14\choose6}=3003\) 个通道，总计 5,381,376 个矩坐标。 64 个带符号子集传输矩阵完成全部 1792 态仿射提升； 完整 35 次序的 binary64 主热配对稳定在 \[ B_{8,\mathrm{pilot}} =-1.4923824320396173\times10^{-8}. \] 七次到八次的修正约 \(4.27\times10^{-17}\)，但这个负号 仍是数值侦察，不是严格渐近定理。
en: The asymptotic limit uses six free carrier coordinates. Centered moments through degree eight have \({14\choose6}=3003\) channels per state, for a total of 5,381,376 moment coordinates. Sixty-four signed subset-transfer matrices complete the affine lift for all 1,792 states; the binary64 dominant heat pairing over all 35 orderings stabilizes at \[ B_{8,\mathrm{pilot}} =-1.4923824320396173\times10^{-8}. \] The correction from degree seven to degree eight is about \(4.27\times10^{-17}\), but this negative sign remains a numerical pilot rather than a rigorous asymptotic theorem.

zh: 将适当弱解可能的奇异集合压缩到极小，但未能证明其为空。
en: Collapse the set of possible singularities for appropriate weak solutions to be minimal, but failed to prove its emptiness.

zh: 将载频偏移写成 \(rL+n\) 后，关系 \(A+B-C=Q\) 只允许 \(k=-1,0,1\) 三个进位。未加权相关因此精确分解为 \[ \sum_{Q\in J_m}\sum_{A+B-C=Q}c_Qc_Ac_Bc_C =\sum_{k=-1}^{1}I_{L,k}O_{M,m-1,k}. \] 合流热核依赖完整载频和时间顺序，所以真正的加权和不能直接张量分离。
en: Writing carrier offsets as \(rL+n\), the relation \(A+B-C=Q\) permits only the three carries \(k=-1,0,1\). The unweighted correlation therefore separates exactly as \[ \sum_{Q\in J_m}\sum_{A+B-C=Q}c_Qc_Ac_Bc_C =\sum_{k=-1}^{1}I_{L,k}O_{M,m-1,k}. \] The confluent heat kernel depends on the full carriers and time order, so the weighted sum does not separate directly.

en: Deliver

en: larger complete coefficients are not equal to closed cascades. In the fifth-order coefficient of \(\varepsilon=0.2\), the next shell target only accounts for about 1.99% of the energy in \(\dot H^{1/2}\); Taylor remainder, dense packet limit, and shell-by-shell repetition did not control it.
