zh: 在 \(M=16,\ q=2,\ T=\log2/2\) 上，五载频约束留下 34,690 个有效元组。包含全部十种 \((3,2)\)-shuffle 后， 共得到 346,900 条有序带符号路径；每条路径都直接验证 终点频率 \(k_5=0\)。
en: At \(M=16,\ q=2,\ T=\log2/2\), the five-carrier constraint leaves 34,690 valid tuples. Including all ten \((3,2)\)-shuffles gives 346,900 signed ordered paths, and every path directly verifies the terminal frequency \(k_5=0\).

zh: 在 \(M=16\) 的第一周期，7,823,536 个有效载频组与 35 种时间次序产生 273,823,760 条有序路径。精确后缀 动态规划把它们压缩为最多 105,499 个状态，并在 44 次 有理 Taylor 审计中得到 \[ 0.0074150893675487776 <S_{8,q}^{(M=16)} <0.0074150893936092571. \] 绝对尾小于 \(1.304\times10^{-11}\)，所以这个有限热块严格为正。
en: In the first cycle at \(M=16\), 7,823,536 valid carrier tuples and 35 time orderings produce 273,823,760 ordered paths. Exact suffix dynamic programming compresses them to at most 105,499 states, and an order-44 rational Taylor audit gives \[ 0.0074150893675487776 <S_{8,q}^{(M=16)} <0.0074150893936092571. \] The absolute tail is below \(1.304\times10^{-11}\), so this finite heat block is rigorously positive.

At \(N=80\) and \(r_*=59/500\), the new tail bound is \(0.99249599847994349<1\), while the old full-space bound is \(1.95368290392552397>1\). The complete exact residual is about \(7.4633\times10^{-70}\), only about \(2.12\times10^{-64}\) of the contraction allowance; the ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and transport bounds are all strictly below one.

zh: 在 \(N=80\)、\(r_*=9/32\) 上，全阶主动尾界为 \(0.7785423316<1\)，完整两端点输运界为 \(0.9962112032<1\)，6345 项完整残差与无穷尾球均由精确有理数闭合。 相邻探针 \(141/500=0.282\) 的主动固定点仍通过，但输运界为 \(1.0003750452>1\)，所以下一瓶颈已经明确落在 \(x=2\) 输运端点。
en: At \(N=80\) and \(r_*=9/32\), the all-order active-tail bound is \(0.7785423316<1\), the complete two-endpoint transport bound is \(0.9962112032<1\), and the 6,345-term complete residual and infinite tail ball close in exact rational arithmetic. At the adjacent probe \(141/500=0.282\), the active fixed point still passes but transport is \(1.0003750452>1\), so the next bottleneck is now precisely the \(x=2\) transport endpoint.

zh: 在 \(Q_2\le1/2\) 下，所有静态 relative phases 都允许；临界点恰有两个。对声明的热衰减路径，实际 Coble shear 在 \(0\le y\le1\) 可取 \((r,C_0,C_1)=(\pi/12,81,36)\)。
en: Under \(Q_2\le1/2\), every static relative phase is allowed and there are exactly two critical points. Along the stated heat-decay path and on \(0\le y\le1\), the physical Coble shear admits \((r,C_0,C_1)=(\pi/12,81,36)\).

At \(r=0.370\), the two endpoints are \(0.5602559667\) and \(0.9662130058\), and the complete active-tail bound is \(0.9970118412<1\). The ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and regular-stretch gates all close strictly, so the common radius reaches \(37/100\).

At \(r=0.371\), the negative derivative of all 27 \(q=1\) terms is at most \(0.1686475501\), while the seed lower bound is \(1.113\), leaving the complete derivative margin \(0.9443524499>0\). Thus every admissible \(j>80\) is covered, and the exact maximum is attained at \(j=82\).

At \(r=0.376932\), the large-charge bound falls to \(0.9971370846<1\), and the true bottleneck becomes \(s=162,j=81\): \[ 0.9999973490826196656<1. \] The ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and regular-stretch gates all pass, so the common radius reaches \(94233/250000\).

zh: 在 exact triangular 2.5D class 中取 \[ \mathscr A_q=q^\alpha,\qquad 1<\alpha<2,\qquad \delta_q=\mathscr A_q/q^2\to0. \] uniform rescaled IFT 保持固定 target、固定宏观时间窗与指定的 \(m=2\) simple root。filtered \(C_{*,t}\) 的 target coefficient 与 \(a_t\) 只相差固定非零 factors。
en: In the exact triangular 2.5D class, take \[ \mathscr A_q=q^\alpha,\qquad 1<\alpha<2,\qquad \delta_q=\mathscr A_q/q^2\to0. \] The uniform rescaled IFT retains the fixed target, fixed macroscopic time window, and prescribed \(m=2\) simple root. The target coefficient of filtered \(C_{*,t}\) differs from \(a_t\) only by fixed nonzero factors.

zh: 在变量 \(r=z^2w,\xi=z^{-1}\) 下，漂移端点变成固定 Laurent 电荷：\(b_N=[r^N\xi^1](A,S)\)。 160 位与 224 位 MPFR 计算扩展到 \(N=75\)，两套结果的最大相对差为 \(3.21\times10^{-43}\)。
en: In the variables \(r=z^2w,\xi=z^{-1}\), the drifting endpoint becomes a fixed Laurent charge: \(b_N=[r^N\xi^1](A,S)\). The 160-bit and 224-bit MPFR calculations extend through \(N=75\), with a maximum relative discrepancy of \(3.21\times10^{-43}\).

zh: 在电荷坐标中，负电荷叶 \(a_{0,-1}=1\) 使 \(q\) 扇区的方程必含 \(k f_{k,q+1}\)。 因而任何固定上界的有限电荷带都不能闭合；R0.28 提出的有限扇区锥路线被严格排除，下一步必须使用带权无限阶梯或指数奇点分析。
en: In charge coordinates, the negative-charge leaf \(a_{0,-1}=1\) forces the equation in sector \(q\) to contain \(k f_{k,q+1}\). Thus no finite charge band with a fixed upper bound can close; the finite-sector cone proposed in R0.28 is rigorously ruled out, and the next step must use a weighted infinite ladder or exponential-singularity analysis.

zh: 在根盒上端半径消去 \(\alpha\) 后，可行性要求单变量函数 \(E(r_U,c)\ge0\)。其对数导数多项式只有三次 Descartes 变号， 三个严格变号根盒恰好穷尽全部正根；在唯一内部极值盒上， \(c^2E\) 的 317 个 Bernstein 系数全部为负。结合两端解析排除， 得到 \[ \begin{aligned} 0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330925 &<R_{\mathrm{aff}},\\ R_{\mathrm{aff}} &<0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330926. \end{aligned} \]
en: After eliminating \(\alpha\) at the upper root-box radius, feasibility requires the one-variable function \(E(r_U,c)\ge0\). Its logarithmic-derivative polynomial has only three Descartes sign variations, and three strict sign-changing root boxes exhaust all positive roots. In the unique interior extremum box, all 317 Bernstein coefficients of \(c^2E\) are negative. Combined with analytic exclusion at both ends, this gives \[ \begin{aligned} 0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330925 &<R_{\mathrm{aff}},\\ R_{\mathrm{aff}} &<0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330926. \end{aligned} \]

zh: 在旧半径 \(4/81\) 上，R0.31 主控直接给出 \(\|D\Phi(a)\|<80/81\)，所以 Jacobian 具有真正的无穷维 Neumann 逆。 把前 40 层精确系数与其后的解析尾界结合，边界上的逆范数上界进一步改善为约 \(3.306365\)。
en: At the old radius \(4/81\), the R0.31 majorant directly gives \(\|D\Phi(a)\|<80/81\), so the Jacobian has a genuine infinite-dimensional Neumann inverse. Combining the first 40 exact layers with the analytic tail bound improves the boundary inverse-norm upper bound to about \(3.306365\).

zh: 在邻近整洁点 \(m=6/35\)、\(n=3/7\)、\(x=37/14\)， 15 组二阶 Laurent 负幂全部抵消。 成对交换对称把五维 Hessian 分成 \(2+3\) 两块； 五个 Sylvester 顺序主子式都由有理运算证明严格为正。
en: At the neighboring clean point \(m=6/35\), \(n=3/7\), and \(x=37/14\), 15 pairs of second-order Laurent negative powers are completely cancelled. The paired commutation splits the five-dimensional Hessian into two parts: \(2+3\); all five Sylvester leading principal minors are proved to be strictly positive by rational operations.

zh: 在每个 \(d_Q>0\) 分支上， \[ \sigma_{Q,\varepsilon}=\frac{d_Q}{d_Q+\varepsilon},\qquad z_{Q,\varepsilon}=\sqrt{\sigma_{Q,\varepsilon}}z_Q,\qquad a_{Q,\varepsilon}=\sigma_{Q,\varepsilon}a_Q. \] 因而 soft source 精确分成 hard interior source 与 \((\sigma_{Q,\varepsilon})_ta_Q\) face layer。
en: On every branch with \(d_Q>0\), \[ \sigma_{Q,\varepsilon}=\frac{d_Q}{d_Q+\varepsilon},\qquad z_{Q,\varepsilon}=\sqrt{\sigma_{Q,\varepsilon}}z_Q,\qquad a_{Q,\varepsilon}=\sigma_{Q,\varepsilon}a_Q. \] The soft source therefore splits exactly into a hard interior source and the face layer \((\sigma_{Q,\varepsilon})_ta_Q\).

zh:
在每个 \(d=\|C\|_2^2>0\) 的时间分支上，若 \(C_t=-
u A_0C+G\)、\(E=C/\|C\|_2\)、 \(r=\langle A_0E,Eangle\)，则 \[ \|E_t\|_2^2+
u^2\|P_{E^\perp}A_0E\|_2^2 =-
u r_t+ rac{\|P_{E^\perp}G\|_2^2}{d}. \] 纯热流的 Rayleigh 下降支付平方角速度。软方向 \(Z=C/\sqrt{d+\varepsilon}\) 不是单位向量；相应恒等式含 \(+
u r_\varepsilon m_t\)，直线 crossing 的孤立软源积分精确等于 \(3\pi/(8\sqrt\varepsilon)\)。
en:
On every time branch where \(d=\|C\|_2^2>0\), if \(C_t=-
u A_0C+G\), \(E=C/\|C\|_2\), and \(r=\langle A_0E,Eangle\), then \[ \|E_t\|_2^2+
u^2\|P_{E^\perp}A_0E\|_2^2 =-
u r_t+ rac{\|P_{E^\perp}G\|_2^2}{d}. \] Rayleigh descent pays for the squared angular velocity in pure heat flow. The soft direction \(Z=C/\sqrt{d+\varepsilon}\) is not a unit vector; the corresponding identity contains \(+
u r_\varepsilon m_t\), and the isolated soft-source integral at a linear crossing equals exactly \(3\pi/(8\sqrt\varepsilon)\).

zh: 在每个正分母时间分支上，令 \(x=F/\sqrt Y\)、\(E=C/\|C\|_2\)、 \(z=\langle x,E\rangle\)、\(a=(z^+)^2\)。把 Lamb 加速度、方向转动和 enstrophy 归一化合成同一个源 \(\mathcal J\)，得到 \[ z_t+\nu K^2z=\mathcal J,\qquad a_t+2\nu K^2a=2z^+\mathcal J. \] 因而终端迹已包含在 coarea 账本内，绝对变差只剩各分支入口、单边正生成、 软分母时间面与 refresh atoms。振幅向量 \(\Xi=z^+E\) 还给出径向生成与切向转动的精确正交分解。
en: On each positive-denominator time branch, set \(x=F/\sqrt Y\), \(E=C/\|C\|_2\), \(z=\langle x,E\rangle\), and \(a=(z^+)^2\). Combine Lamb acceleration, directional rotation, and enstrophy normalization into the single source \(\mathcal J\), obtaining \[ z_t+\nu K^2z=\mathcal J,\qquad a_t+2\nu K^2a=2z^+\mathcal J. \] The terminal trace is therefore already included in the coarea ledger, leaving total variation to account only for each branch entry, one-sided positive creation, soft-denominator time faces, and refresh atoms. The amplitude vector \(\Xi=z^+E\) also gives an exact orthogonal decomposition of radial creation and tangential rotation.

zh: 在球上分离压力的近场 Newton 部分与调和远场部分，逐阶减去远场多极矩，检验领先四极项是否仍保持临界大小。
en: Separate pressure on a ball into its near-field Newtonian and harmonic far-field parts, subtract far-field multipoles order by order, and test whether the leading quadrupole remains at critical size.

zh: 在取绝对值以前按环带保留有符号几何核，研究相邻尺度部分和是否产生可求和的临界通量亏损。
en: Retain the signed geometric kernel by annuli before taking absolute values, and test whether partial sums over neighboring scales produce a summable critical flux deficit.

zh: 在实边界 \(h=0\) 上，子结式消元与 Sturm 根隔离覆盖了全部边界和内部驻点： 等幅同相点是全局最优，外部/目标比为 \(45.73934896472748\ldots\)。 对一般复振幅，94 个精确 Bernstein 叶盒证明全局下界 \(45.739348\)，与该实可行点只差不到 \(10^{-6}\)。
en: On the real boundary \(h=0\), the subdeterminant elimination and Sturm root isolation cover all boundaries and internal stationary points: equal amplitude in-phase points are globally optimal; the external/target ratio is \(45.73934896472748\ldots\). For general complex amplitudes, 94 exact Bernstein box estimates prove a global lower bound \(45.739348\), differing from this real feasible point by less than \(10^{-6}\).

zh: 在四阶临界振幅上，零时间八阶形式比率的块速率严格小于 \(256/625<41/100\)。
en: At quartic-critical amplitude, the block rate of the formal zero-time eighth-order ratio is strictly less than \(256/625<41/100\).

zh: 在四维载频立方体中心保留全部六次中心矩。每态共有 \({10\choose4}=210\) 个通道，320 态系统因此提升为 67,200 维三角 jet。质量主向量由精确 Chinese-remainder 投影隔离，六阶有限主项落在 \[ -9.70\times10^{-7} <B_6 <-9.48\times10^{-7}. \]
en: Retain all centred moments through degree six at the centre of the four-dimensional carrier-frequency cube. Each state has \({10\choose4}=210\) channels, so the 320-state system lifts to a 67,200-dimensional triangular jet. An exact Chinese-remainder projection isolates the dominant mass eigenvector, and the finite sixth-order dominant term lies in \[ -9.70\times10^{-7} <B_6 <-9.48\times10^{-7}. \]

zh: 在同一滤波与截断体系中让真实低频应变源开始演化，并显式保留偏差压力 Hessian、黏性和次网格项。
en: Within the same filtering and cutoff framework, let the actual low-frequency strain source begin to evolve, explicitly retaining the deviatoric pressure Hessian, viscosity, and subgrid terms.

zh: 在显式 uniform Morse margin 下证明 full-superposition gate。
en: Prove the full-superposition gate under an explicit uniform Morse margin.

zh: 在新半径 \[r_*=\frac{16}{243}=\frac43\frac4{81}\] 上，四十阶中心多项式的完整精确残差为 \(2.999049187948959763\times10^{-46}\)，线性化上界为 \(0.95194169562439524\)。 显式尾球的映射上界为 \(0.00386050865925092\)，Lipschitz 常数为 \(0.97597084781219762<1\)。 因而 Banach 定理构造出同一典范形式解，固定荷解析下界同步提高 \(64/27\) 倍。
en: At the new radius \[r_*=\frac{16}{243}=\frac43\frac4{81}\], the complete exact residual of the degree-40 center polynomial is \(2.999049187948959763\times10^{-46}\), and the linearization upper bound is \(0.95194169562439524\). The explicit tail ball has mapping upper bound \(0.00386050865925092\) and Lipschitz constant \(0.97597084781219762<1\). Banach's theorem therefore constructs the same canonical formal solution, while the fixed-charge analytic lower bound increases by a factor of \(64/27\).

zh: 在有符号 Biot–Savart 核中保留 \(\omega(x)\times(\omega(x+z)-\omega(x))\) 的非局部差分，精确优化近场/远场分裂，检验是否出现真正的尺度增益。
en: Retain the nonlocal difference \(\omega(x)\times(\omega(x+z)-\omega(x))\) inside the signed Biot–Savart kernel, optimize the near/far-field split exactly, and test for a genuine scale gain.

zh: 在有限分离 \(\varepsilon=1/4\) 上，按解析总量作分子的 P18 扫描以 167,772,160 个点对得到最佳 \(a=0.1595\)、探索性比值 \(0.9635537\)。 独立 P19 区对估计随后确认 \(\mathcal A_0=-6.2919\times10^{-4}\pm1.0343\times10^{-5}\)， 负号约离零 61 个报告标准误。第三套共同样本三次审计显示：4001 点网格上每个振幅至少有 \(j=-2,0\) 之一为负，最佳最小值仍为 \(-2.95\times10^{-4}\)。
en: At finite separation \(\varepsilon=1/4\), the P18 screen used the analytic total as numerator and 167,772,160 point pairs to obtain the best \(a=0.1595\) and an exploratory ratio of \(0.9635537\). An independent P19 zone-pair estimate then confirmed \(\mathcal A_0=-6.2919\times10^{-4}\pm1.0343\times10^{-5}\), with the negative sign about 61 reported standard errors from zero. A third common-sample cubic audit showed that at every amplitude on a 4001-point grid at least one of \(j=-2,0\) is negative, and the best minimum remains \(-2.95\times10^{-4}\).

zh: 在与 R0.5 相同的 Galerkin 设置中，候选到 \(\tau=0.05\) 的临界能量平方增加约 14.1%， 但到 \(\tau=0.1\) 前后仍然换号并转为衰减。
en: In the same Galerkin setting as R0.5, the critical energy square increases by about 14.1% to \(\tau=0.05\); but it changes sign and decays before reaching \(\tau=0.1\).

zh: 在真实全局光滑小数据 NSE 轨道上，signed work 与同核绝对活动可以相差一个振幅阶。热演化并不把这种抵消自动变成可逆比较。
en: Along a genuine globally smooth small-data NSE trajectory, signed work and the absolute activity of the same kernel can differ by one amplitude order. Heat evolution does not automatically turn this cancellation into a reversible comparison.

zh: 这保留了 R0.69K 的真实远场增益，同时排除了仅靠放大分离比实现统一压力吸收。附加局部能量、Morrey、压力或几何条件仍可能控制剩余量。
en: This preserves the genuine far-field gain from R0.69K while ruling out uniform pressure absorption by enlarging the separation ratio alone. Additional local-energy, Morrey, pressure, or geometric conditions may still control the remainder.

zh: 这定位了相邻源差分的精确缺口，没有证明所有尺度补偿都失败，也没有建立新的继续性条件。
en: This locates the exact gap in adjacent-source differencing. It neither proves that all scale compensation fails nor establishes a new continuation condition.

zh: 这份笔记包含以下五项：
en: This note contains the following five items:

zh: 这个点只是严格改进候选，不是四角全局最优； 热项、Taylor 余项、稠密包与逐壳 PDE 迭代仍未包含。
en: This point is only a strict improvement candidate, not a four-corner global optimum; heat terms, Taylor remainder, dense packets, and shell-by-shell PDE iteration are still missing.

zh: 这个定理严格排除完整零时间状态空间上 每层因子不超过 \(2\) 的公共范数，但没有否定先保留高斯权与时间 单形积分的 \(|S_{4,m}|\le CL^2M\) 估计。
en: This theorem rigorously rules out a common norm with per-level factor at most \(2\) on the complete zero-time state space, but it does not refute the \(|S_{4,m}|\le CL^2M\) estimate that retains Gaussian weights and the time-simplex integral first.

zh: 这个例子说明能量恒等式与通用调和分析估计还不够，论证需要用到原始非线性核的更细结构。
en: This example illustrates that energy conservation and general harmonic analysis estimates are insufficient for the argument: more detailed structure of the original nonlinear kernel is needed.

zh: 这个问题要求证明什么
en: this problem requires proving what

zh: 这关闭了当前深数据包的 线性非正规失稳路线，却没有控制阶一扰动的自相互作用 \(\mathcal B(w,w)\)。它不是大数据全局正则性定理，也没有 构造范数膨胀或有限时奇性。
en: This closes the linear non-normal instability route for the present deep packet, but it does not control the self-interaction \(\mathcal B(w,w)\) of an order-one perturbation. It is not a large-data global-regularity theorem and constructs neither norm inflation nor a finite-time singularity.

zh: 这里比较的是 \(u\) 和 \(-u\) 作为同一时刻初值时的 Navier--Stokes 切向量，不是轨道对称性。
en: The comparison concerns Navier--Stokes tangents at the same initial time for \(u\) and \(-u\); it is not a trajectory symmetry.

zh: 这里得到四条正结果。
en: Four positive results follow.

zh: 这里记录我对三维不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 全局正则性问题的梳理与计算， 包括正式表述、已知结果、工作计划和研究笔记。我会随进展继续修订。
en: Here I record my reading and calculations on the global regularity problem for the three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes equations. This includes the formal statement, known results, work plan, and research notes. I will revise it as the work develops.

zh: 这里没有全局优化完整 \((c,\lambda,\mu)\) 参数域，也没有建立约化生成系统到任意三维 无散速度场尺度临界范数的控制桥梁。
en: This page does not globally optimize the complete \((c,\lambda,\mu)\) parameter domain or establish a controlling bridge from the reduced generating system to scale-critical norms for arbitrary three-dimensional divergence-free velocity fields.

zh: 这里没有证明 \(c=4/5\) 最优， 也没有建立到任意三维散度为零初值、尺度临界 PDE 范数或完整 Fourier 相互作用几何的控制桥梁。
en: I have not proved that \(c=4/5\) is optimal, nor established a control bridge to arbitrary three-dimensional divergence-free initial data, a scale-critical PDE norm, or the full Fourier interaction geometry.

zh: 这里没有证明所选参数是完整 \((c,\lambda)\) 族的全局最优点，也没有建立到任意三维 速度场尺度临界范数或完整 Fourier 几何的控制桥梁。
en: This does not prove that the selected parameters are the global optimum over the full \((c,\lambda)\) family, and it does not establish a control bridge to a scale-critical norm for arbitrary three-dimensional velocity fields or to the complete Fourier geometry.

zh: 这两个 fan 是静态周期场。共享高频族只否定明确写出的三场极化估计，不否定已有 BMO/Besov 延拓定理。当前也没有从 Leray 能量或 Navier–Stokes 动力学推出 \(a_+\in L_t^1\)，所以本节不是新的继续性判据或正则性结果。
en: These two fans are static periodic fields. The shared-high-frequency family rules out only the explicitly stated polarized three-field estimate; it does not invalidate any existing BMO/Besov continuation theorem. Nor has \(a_+\in L_t^1\) been derived from the Leray energy inequality or the Navier–Stokes dynamics, so this section is not a new continuation criterion or a regularity result.

zh: 这排除了“真实生成子空间始终避开尖锐方向”这一简单解释。 它只覆盖一个根中心和 \(N=2\)，不能推出所有 \(N\) 的增长阶，也不能恢复或否定一阶解析闭合。
en: This excludes the simple explanation that "the genuine generating subspace always avoids sharp directions." It only covers one root center and \(N=2\), and cannot deduce the growth order of all \(N\) or restore or negate first-order analytic closure.

zh: 这排除了把模长视为任意非负权重、只依赖方向振荡取得一致增益的证明架构；它没有断言任意权重都能实现为 Navier–Stokes 涡量，也没有给出正则性结论。
en: This rules out a proof architecture that treats magnitude as an arbitrary nonnegative weight and seeks a uniform gain from directional oscillation alone; it neither claims that every weight is realizable as Navier-Stokes vorticity nor gives a regularity conclusion.

zh: 这排除了当前全空间范数的一阶半径证明，不排除所选八个输入生成的更小系数子空间、完整树聚合抵消或其他范数。 它不是三维 Navier–Stokes 的正则性或奇性结论。
en: This excludes a first-order radius proof in the full space norm, but not smaller coefficient subspaces generated by the selected eight inputs, complete tree aggregation cancellations, or other norms. It is not a regularity or singularity conclusion for three-dimensional Navier–Stokes.

zh: 这仍是固定八阶的零时间代数定理； 完整 35 种时间次序的七单形热权尚未配对，不能把它写成八阶热系数定理。
en: This remains a fixed eighth-order zero-time algebraic theorem. The seven-simplex heat weights for all 35 time orderings have not yet been paired, so this is not an eighth-order heat-coefficient theorem.

zh: 这是 data-uniform route-pruning theorem，不是 bounded-data no-go、继续性、finite-time singularity 或 global regularity 结论；finite truncated-coset calculation 只作 corroboration。
en: This is a data-uniform route-pruning theorem, not a bounded-data no-go, continuation, finite-time singularity, or global-regularity conclusion; the finite truncated-coset calculation is corroboration only.

zh: 这是 declared exact triangular 2.5D class 内的 complete all-root、mixed-window floor-free upper bound。它没有给出 raw zero-count theorem，也不是一般三维 Navier–Stokes 的 endpoint、继续性判据、有限时奇性或 global regularity 结论；strong coupling、shrinking observation layer、non-unit phases 与不同 geometry 仍开放。
en: This is a complete all-root, mixed-window floor-free upper bound inside the declared exact triangular 2.5D class. It gives no raw zero-count theorem and is not a general three-dimensional Navier–Stokes endpoint, continuation criterion, finite-time singularity, or global-regularity result; strong coupling, a shrinking observation layer, non-unit phases, and different geometry remain open.

zh: 这是 exact triangular 2.5D 光滑子类中的 candidate-payment no-go theorem。它没有构造奇性，没有给出 continuation criterion，也不解决一般三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性。
en: This is a candidate-payment no-go theorem in an exact smooth triangular 2.5D subclass. It constructs no singularity, gives no continuation criterion, and does not solve general three-dimensional Navier–Stokes regularity.

zh: 这是 exact triangular 2.5D class 内的 dynamical sharpness theorem。它没有反驳 \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) payment，没有构造有限时奇性，也没有给出一般三维 continuation 或 global regularity。
en: This is a dynamical sharpness theorem inside the exact triangular 2.5D class. It does not refute the \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) payment, construct a finite-time singularity, or give general three-dimensional continuation or global regularity.

zh: 这是 exact-launch coherent triangular class 的 uniform exclusion。固定正 \(A_0\) 可让 effective carrier count 坍缩；incoherent phases、changing-profile enhanced dissipation 与 normalized many-carrier lower family 仍开放。
en: This is a uniform exclusion for the exact-launch coherent triangular class. A fixed positive \(A_0\) can collapse the effective carrier count; incoherent phases, changing-profile enhanced dissipation, and a normalized many-carrier lower family remain open.

zh: 这是 fixed-dimensional declared triangular family internal saturation，不是 universal endpoint、bounded-data continuation、有限时奇性或 global regularity 结论。多块 energy proxy 不等于 exact operator IFT parameter；growing \(N\) 与 strong coupling 仍开放。
en: This is fixed-dimensional declared triangular family internal saturation, not a universal endpoint, bounded-data continuation, finite-time singularity, or global-regularity conclusion. The multiblock energy proxy is not the exact operator IFT parameter; growing \(N\) and strong coupling remain open.

zh: 这是边缘约化系统的第一个显式共同解析域，不是三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性结论。 常数 96 很保守，最近奇点、真实收敛半径和端点系数渐近仍未解决。
en: This is the first explicit common analytic domain for the reduced edge system, not a three-dimensional Navier–Stokes regularity result. The constant 96 is highly conservative; the nearest singularity, the actual radius of convergence, and the endpoint coefficient asymptotics remain unresolved.

zh: 这是边缘约化系统的严格解析域改进，不是实际奇点定位，也不是三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性结论。 \(4/81\) 仍只是保证下界。
en: This is a rigorous improvement of the analytic domain for the edge-reduced system, not a location of the actual singularity and not a three-dimensional Navier–Stokes regularity result. \(4/81\) remains only a guaranteed lower bound.

zh: 这是参考线性化预解有界条件下的 局部非线性稳定性定理。有限临界路径范数并未被直接等同于 预解有界性；结论也不延拓任意大解穿过潜在奇性时刻。
en: This is a local nonlinear-stability theorem under bounded invertibility of the reference linearization. A finite critical path norm is not identified directly with a bounded resolvent, and the result does not continue an arbitrary large solution through a possible singular time.

zh: 这是次数 80 约化代数模型中的 全参数定理。它没有建立完整三维 Fourier 三元相互作用、 Leray 投影和尺度临界 PDE 范数到该生成系统的控制桥梁， 因而不是三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性结论。
en: This is a full-parameter theorem in a degree-80 reduced algebraic model. It does not establish a control bridge from complete three-dimensional Fourier triadic interactions, the Leray projection, and a scale-critical PDE norm to this generating system, and therefore is not a regularity conclusion for three-dimensional Navier–Stokes.

zh: 这是第一 Picard 必要性检查。 第二代以后模态、稠密包的相位一致性和完整非线性余项都没有控制。
en: This is the first Picard necessity check; modal control, phase consistency of dense packets, and full nonlinear remainder are not controlled in subsequent generations.

zh: 这是对当前频率包的结构定理，不是任意 三维初值的估计。它关闭了错误的三次共振路线，却同时说明该构造 不是 Clay 奇点候选；对千禧年问题的直接价值仍低。
en: This is a structural theorem for the current packet, not an estimate for arbitrary three-dimensional data. It closes the mistaken cubic-resonance route while also showing that the construction is not a Clay singularity candidate; its direct value for the Millennium problem remains low.

zh: 这是固定短时间的有限截断现象。候选没有全参数最优性证明，也没有 Galerkin 截断趋于无穷时的统一 PDE 误差。
en: This is a finite truncation phenomenon at fixed short time. The candidate does not have a proof of global optimality over all parameters, nor a unified PDE error as the Galerkin truncation tends to infinity.

zh: 这是计算机辅助有限模型定理，不是三维 Navier–Stokes 的 PDE 定理； 第六阶及以上余项、粘性热衰减、横向无限维扰动和逐壳迭代仍未控制。
en: This is a computer-assisted theorem for a finite model, not a PDE theorem for the three-dimensional Navier–Stokes equations. Remainders of order six and above, viscous heat decay, transverse infinite-dimensional perturbations, and shell-by-shell iteration remain uncontrolled.

zh: 这是临界双线性饱和，不是范数膨胀或 Koch--Tataru 映射无界。把输入归一化为 \(\varepsilon\) 后，第一非线性 输出仍只是 \(O(\varepsilon^2)\)。高阶 Picard 余项、\(\mathbb R^3\) 紧支光滑数据和任意大初值先验控制都没有进入本定理。
en: This is critical bilinear saturation, not norm inflation or unboundedness of the Koch--Tataru map. After normalizing the input to \(\varepsilon\), the first nonlinear output is still only \(O(\varepsilon^2)\). Higher Picard remainders, compactly supported smooth data on \(\mathbb R^3\), and a priori control for arbitrary large data do not enter this theorem.

zh: 这是全局光滑不变剪切类中， 一个周期族、一个目标 Fourier 系数的完整级数定理。它不控制 任意三维扰动的临界范数，不构造有限时奇性，也不是一般三维 正则性结论。
en: This is a complete-series theorem for one periodic family and one target Fourier coefficient in a globally smooth invariant-shear class. It does not control a critical norm of arbitrary three-dimensional perturbations, construct a finite-time singularity, or prove general three-dimensional regularity.

zh: 这是瞬时尺度下界。它没有证明该相位排列会在 Navier–Stokes 动力学中持续，也没有构造奇性。
en: This is an instantaneous scale lower bound. It does not prove that this phase arrangement will persist in the Navier–Stokes dynamics nor construct a singularity.

zh: 这是条件性结构结果；框架完整性本身没有从 Leray 能量推出临界横向控制。
en: This is a conditional structural result; completeness of the frame alone does not derive critical transverse control from the Leray energy bound.

zh: 这是完整热核在第一周期上的严格 正号，关闭了路径、热率、符号和五单形归一化的实现风险； 它不能决定 \(\mu\)-主特征分布与热核的渐近配对符号。
en: This is the rigorous positive sign of the complete heat kernel at the first cycle. It closes implementation risk in the paths, heat rates, signs, and five-simplex normalization, but it cannot determine the asymptotic pairing sign between the \(\mu\)-dominant eigen-distribution and the heat kernel.

zh: 这是未加权零时间相关的固定六阶定理。 R0.67B 已完成质量与四个一次矩的提升和严格 resolvent； R0.67C-1 已严格证明第一周期的完整热系数为正；R0.67C-2 进一步证明渐近主热投影严格为负；R0.68A 已把十阶及以上目标尾联合闭合；R0.68B-1 已求出八阶零时间精确谱，完整八阶热投影仍未决。
en: This is a fixed sixth-order theorem for the unweighted zero-time correlation. R0.67B completed the mass-plus-four-first-moments lift and strict resolvent; R0.67C-1 rigorously proved that the complete first-cycle heat coefficient is positive; R0.67C-2 further proved that the asymptotic dominant heat projection is strictly negative; R0.68A jointly closed the target tail at every order at least ten; and R0.68B-1 obtained the exact eighth-order zero-time spectrum, while the complete eighth-order heat projection remains open.

zh: 这是一个固定六阶、固定周期目标族的 渐近投影定理。R0.68A 已严格控制全部十阶及以上目标尾， R0.68B-1 已闭合八阶零时间谱，但完整八阶热投影和真正三维 扰动仍未控制；当前平行剪切类本身全局光滑。
en: This is an asymptotic projection theorem for a fixed sixth-order, fixed-period target family. R0.68A has strictly controlled all target tails of order ten and higher, R0.68B-1 has closed the eighth-order zero-time spectrum, but the complete eighth-order heat projection and genuinely three-dimensional perturbations remain uncontrolled; the current parallel shear class itself is globally smooth.

zh: 这是一个明确固定八阶系数的 源锁定符号证书。当前平行剪切类本身全局光滑；这个负号不控制 全部 Picard 阶，不构造奇性，也不是一般三维正则性结论。
en: This is a source-locked sign certificate for one explicitly fixed eighth-order coefficient. The present parallel-shear class is itself globally smooth; this negative sign does not control all Picard orders, construct a singularity, or imply general three-dimensional regularity.

zh: 这是一个四次 Picard 系数的渐近定理。 它没有控制六次及更高阶项或完整温和解，没有证明范数膨胀、 有限时爆破或一般三维全局正则性。
en: This is an asymptotic theorem for one quartic Picard coefficient. It does not control sixth and higher orders or the full mild solution, and it proves neither norm inflation, finite-time blowup, nor global regularity for general three-dimensional data.

zh: 这是一个严格的 geometry-only no-go，不是一般 material tent 发散定理。它不排除真正三维的拉伸、传输–滤波或压力相关性产生新的耗竭，也没有得到无条件正则性。
en: This is a rigorous geometry-only no-go, not a general divergence theorem for material tents. It does not rule out new depletion arising from genuinely three-dimensional stretching, transport–filter, or pressure correlations, and it does not yield unconditional regularity.

zh: 这是一条关于声明静态场族的严格机制排除定理。它没有传播 Navier–Stokes 解、控制临界范数或解决千禧年问题；它关闭的是一条具体的一参数有限分离路线。
en: This is a rigorous mechanism-exclusion theorem for the declared static family. It does not propagate a Navier–Stokes solution, control a critical norm, or solve the Millennium problem; it closes one specific one-parameter finite-separation route.

zh: 这是一条无条件 heat-bulk 定理和一条初始热迹障碍，不是新的无条件正则性判据。它没有证明 \(A_{\rm sb,+}\in L_t^1\)，没有排除带额外 NSE 结构的局部 Carleson 机制，也没有解决千禧年问题。
en: This is an unconditional heat-bulk theorem and an initial heat-trace obstruction, not a new unconditional regularity criterion. It does not prove \(A_{\rm sb,+}\in L_t^1\), rule out a local Carleson mechanism with additional NSE structure, or solve the Millennium problem.

zh: 这是已知小数据定理在一个明确 周期数据包上的严格应用，不是新的大数据正则性定理。证书没有 给 \(\eta_{\rm KT}^{\rm per}\) 指定数值，也不控制常数量级横向 扰动的非正规增长、失稳或奇性。
en: This is a rigorous application of a known small-data theorem to one explicit periodic packet, not a new large-data regularity theorem. The certificate assigns no numerical value to \(\eta_{\rm KT}^{\rm per}\) and does not control non-normal growth, instability, or singularity for order-one transverse perturbations.

zh: 这是有限维几何计算。孤立三元组没有编码壳重数，也没有检查许多三元组之间的相位兼容性。
en: This is a finite-dimensional geometric calculation. Isolated triads do not encode shell multiplicities or check phase compatibility among many triads.

zh: 这是远近分离增益，不是全局次临界估计。近场壳与截断过渡环带仍需放回同一局部应变预算。
en: This is a near/far separation gain, not a globally subcritical estimate. The near shells and cutoff transition annulus must still be returned to the same localized strain budget.

zh: 这是约化边缘生成系统第一次真正扩大已证明解析域，不是有限系数外推。 它没有认证 R0.32 候选，也没有给出三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性或奇性结论。
en: This is the first genuine enlargement of the proved analytic domain for the reduced edge-generating system, not a finite-coefficient extrapolation. It does not certify the R0.32 candidate and gives no conclusion about three-dimensional Navier-Stokes regularity or singularity.

zh: 这是约化典范边生成系统的全阶格点端点定理。 30 个有限精确列只验证实现；当前没有建立到完整三维 PDE 临界范数的 控制桥梁，也没有证明正则性或奇性。
en: This is an all-order lattice endpoint theorem for the reduced canonical edge generating system. The 30 finite exact columns only validate the implementation; no control bridge to a critical norm of the full three-dimensional PDE has been established, and neither regularity nor singularity is proved.

zh: 这是约化典范边生成系统的全阶相关列定理。 24 个有限精确列只验证实现；0.377 的充分界失败不证明精确算子失败， 也没有建立到完整三维 PDE 临界范数的控制桥梁。
en: This is an all-order correlated-column theorem for the reduced canonical edge generating system. The 24 finite exact columns validate only the implementation; failure of the sufficient bound at 0.377 does not prove failure of the exact operator, and no control bridge to a critical norm of the full three-dimensional PDE has been established.

zh: 这是约化典范边生成系统中的精确全阶列定理。 五个有限次数只验证实现；0.372 的精确列失败不是奇性证据，结论也没有 建立到完整三维 PDE 临界范数的控制桥梁。
en: This is an exact all-order column theorem for the reduced canonical edge generating system. The five finite degrees validate only the implementation; the exact-column failure at 0.372 is not evidence of a singularity, and the result does not establish a control bridge to a critical norm of the full three-dimensional PDE.

zh: 这是约化典范边生成系统中的全阶正算子定理。 1,313 个折点和 21 个精确列只验证实现；结论没有建立到完整三维 PDE 临界范数的控制桥梁，也没有证明正则性或奇性。
en: This is an all-order positive-operator theorem for the reduced canonical edge generating system. The 1,313 breakpoints and 21 exact columns validate only the implementation; the result establishes no control bridge to a critical norm of the full three-dimensional PDE and proves neither regularity nor singularity.

zh: 这是约化典范边生成系统中覆盖全部 \(s\ge241\) 与允许输入次数的全阶支持定理。21 个有限大荷列只验证实现； 结论没有建立到完整三维 PDE 临界范数的控制桥梁，也没有证明正则性或奇性。
en: This is an all-order support theorem for the reduced canonical edge generating system, covering every \(s\ge241\) and every allowed input degree. The 21 finite large-charge columns validate only the implementation; the result does not establish a control bridge to a critical norm of the full three-dimensional PDE and proves neither regularity nor singularity.

zh: 这是约化典范边生成系统中覆盖全部输入次数与荷的全阶定理。 它没有建立该系统与完整三维 PDE 临界解之间的控制桥梁，也没有证明正则性或奇性。
en: This is an all-order theorem for the reduced canonical edge generating system that covers every input degree and charge. It does not establish a control bridge to critical solutions of the full three-dimensional PDE and proves neither regularity nor singularity.

zh: 这是约化典范边生成系统中一个完整 Banach 权重族的全局优化定理。当前仍没有建立到任意三维速度场、 尺度临界 PDE 范数或完整 Fourier 相互作用几何的控制桥梁。
en: This is a global optimization theorem for a complete family of Banach weights in the reduced canonical edge-generation system. No control bridge has yet been established to arbitrary three-dimensional velocity fields, scale-critical PDE norms, or the complete Fourier interaction geometry.

zh: 这是约化典范生成系统中的全阶定理，覆盖全部次数与全部输入荷。 它没有建立该系统与完整三维 PDE 临界解之间的控制桥梁，也没有证明正则性或奇性。
en: This is an all-order theorem for the reduced canonical generating system, covering every degree and every input charge. It does not establish a control bridge to critical solutions of the full three-dimensional PDE, nor does it prove regularity or singularity.

zh: 这是约化典范生成系统中的新全阶解析下界。 它没有认证 R0.32 候选，也没有给出三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性或有限时奇性结论。
en: This is a new all-order analytic lower bound for the reduced canonical generating system. It does not certify the R0.32 candidate and gives no conclusion about three-dimensional Navier-Stokes regularity or a finite-time singularity.

zh: 这是约化典范生成系统中覆盖全部输入荷与次数的全阶定理。 它没有建立该系统与完整三维 PDE 临界解之间的控制桥梁，也没有证明正则性或奇性。
en: This is an all-order theorem covering every input charge and degree in the reduced canonical generating system. It does not establish a control bridge to critical solutions of the full three-dimensional PDE and proves neither regularity nor singularity.

zh: 这是约化典范生成系统中覆盖全部输入斜率与次数的全阶定理。 它没有建立该系统与完整三维 PDE 临界解之间的控制桥梁，也没有证明正则性或奇性。
en: This is an all-order theorem for the reduced canonical generating system, covering every input slope and degree. It does not establish a control bridge from that system to critical solutions of the full three-dimensional PDE, and it proves neither regularity nor singularity.

zh: 这是增长输出集上的第一 Picard 临界饱和， 不是范数膨胀或完整解的结论。线性项与第一非线性项在 \(L^2\) 中精确 正交；四次能量补偿必须进入三阶及更高 Picard 项，后者尚未控制。
en: This is first-Picard critical saturation on a growing output set, not norm inflation or a conclusion about the full solution. The linear and first nonlinear terms are exactly orthogonal in \(L^2\); quartic energy compensation must enter the cubic and higher Picard terms, which remain uncontrolled.

zh: 这是中心代数结果。 完整二维极化返回映射、预置催化包产生的外部输出、热时间顺序和第二 Picard 余项尚未控制。
en: This is a central algebraic result. The complete two-dimensional polarization return map, pre-set catalytic packets producing external outputs, thermal time order, and second Picard remainder are still uncontrolled.

zh: 这条路线的真正门槛不是再写一个高阶恒等式，而是从能量类获得新的、非循环的符号控制。这个门槛目前仍未跨过。
en: The real threshold on this route is not another higher-order identity, but new, non-circular signed control from the energy class. That threshold has not yet been crossed.

zh: 这条时间线只列我目前认为与整体问题直接相关的节点。它不是完整的文献史。
en: This timeline only lists nodes I currently believe to be directly relevant to the overall problem. It is not a complete bibliographic history.

zh: 这些低阶反例分别排除 \(B_U,B_V,H_U,H_V\) 的直接非负测度表示。这个结论属于无限形式级数： 更高阶系数不能修改已经为负的主子式。机器证书另列出 96 个 Turán 条件和到 12 阶的 96 个 Hankel 行列式，后者仍只作有限诊断。
en: These low-order counterexamples respectively exclude direct nonnegative-measure representations for \(B_U,B_V,H_U,H_V\). The conclusion applies to the infinite formal series: higher coefficients cannot change an already negative principal minor. The machine certificate also lists 96 Turan conditions and 96 Hankel determinants through order 12; those remain finite diagnostics.

zh: 这些结果没有给出 \(s=0\) 的一致绝对控制、局部 coercivity 或 continuation criterion。任意三维初值的全局正则性与 Clay 千禧年问题仍然开放。
en: These results do not provide uniform absolute control at \(s=0\), local coercivity, or a continuation criterion. Global regularity for arbitrary three-dimensional initial data and the Clay Millennium problem remain open.

zh: 这些区间认证的是有限有理逼近的极点，不是原固定荷级数的奇点。 目前没有覆盖候选位置的解析延拓、Taylor 余项界或适用的 Padé 收敛定理，更没有三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性或奇性结论。
en: These intervals certify poles of finite rational approximants, not singularities of the original fixed-charge series. There is currently no analytic continuation reaching the candidate, no Taylor remainder bound, and no applicable Pade convergence theorem, much less a regularity or singularity result for the three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations.

zh: 这些是经典局部性估计的重算，不是新的正则性定理。近对角临界项仍未闭合。
en: These are recalculations of classical local estimates; they are not new regularity theorems. Near-diagonal critical terms are still unclosed.

zh: 这些是精确低阶系数、频率几何和模式级算子结论。 解析序列空间中的无限卷积估计、八阶以上余项、正时间目标下界与逐壳迭代仍未证明。
en: These results concern exact low-order coefficients, frequency geometry, and mode-level operators. Infinite convolution estimates in analytic sequence spaces, remainders above order eight, positive-time lower bounds for the target, and shell-by-shell iteration have not been proved.

zh: 这些是指定二十四个巨大整数尺度上的 严格区间。它们排除“每块增长都不超过 \(16\)”的命题，但有限点列 不能证明 \(|S_r|/M_r\) 无界，也不能否定含未指定常数的统一估计。
en: These are rigorous intervals at twenty-four specified enormous integer scales. They exclude the claim that every block grows by at most \(16\), but a finite sequence cannot prove that \(|S_r|/M_r\) is unbounded or refute a uniform estimate with an unspecified constant.

zh: 这一步把“稳定”分成弱 \(L^2\) 相对能量、临界 \(H^{1/2}\) 强正则和延迟 \(H^3\) 同步三层。带限初始差可用 \(R_{1/2}N^{-1/2}\) 进入全局强解；没有频率或高阶包络时，初时刻强正则仍然开放。
en: This step separates “stability” into three layers: weak \(L^2\) relative energy, critical \(H^{1/2}\) strong regularity, and delayed \(H^3\) synchronization. A band-limited initial difference satisfying the \(R_{1/2}N^{-1/2}\) bound enters the global strong-solution class; without a frequency or higher-order envelope, strong regularity at the initial time remains open.

zh: 这一步的目标：
en: The goal of this step is:

zh: 这一步关闭“方向扩散自动补足 enstrophy 预算”的路线，但不排除经典条件方向相干、截断通量或非局部幅值—方向耦合。它是严格的路线排错，不构成正则性结论。
en: This step closes the route claiming that directional diffusion automatically completes the enstrophy budget, but it does not rule out classical conditional directional coherence, truncated fluxes, or nonlocal amplitude–direction coupling. It is a rigorous route correction, not a regularity conclusion.

zh: 这一步关闭的是逐尺度取绝对值、远场只用 enstrophy 的范数路线。差分改善是真实的，但不足以改变最终指数；有符号跨尺度抵消与第三个临界量仍然开放。这是严格的无增益定理，不构成正则性结论。
en: This step closes the norm-based route that takes absolute values scale by scale and uses only enstrophy in the far field. The improvement from differencing is real but insufficient to change the final exponent; signed cross-scale cancellation and a third critical quantity remain open. This is a rigorous no-gain theorem, not a regularity conclusion.

zh: 这一步修复领先压力交换子的时间指数，没有推导完整局部 \(H^1\) 不等式。真正剩余的非线性满足 \(\sigma^{3/2}\mathcal D^{3/4}\le\varepsilon\mathcal D+C_\varepsilon\sigma^6\)， 即三维应变或涡量拉伸仍是主障碍。
en: This step repairs the time exponent of the leading pressure commutator but does not derive the complete localized \(H^1\) inequality. The true remaining nonlinearity satisfies \(\sigma^{3/2}\mathcal D^{3/4}\le\varepsilon\mathcal D+C_\varepsilon\sigma^6\), so three-dimensional strain or vortex stretching remains the main obstruction.

zh: 这一步严格关闭“不可压性自动产生有利点态对齐”路线，并把真正的有符号靶点定位为正的中间应变特征值。它没有推出无条件时空耗散或正则性；这是路线筛选结果，不是千禧年问题的解答。
en: This step rigorously closes the route claiming that incompressibility automatically produces favorable pointwise alignment, and it identifies the positive middle strain eigenvalue as the true signed target. It proves no unconditional spacetime depletion or regularity; this is a route-screening result, not a solution of the Millennium Problem.

zh: 这一步严格排除“只靠尖锐输出壳标签就得到统一有符号亏损”。它不排除壳内角向抵消、平滑 Littlewood–Paley 交换子、物理空间环带或沿真实解演化的时间退相干；这是候选机制的压力测试，不是正则性定理。
en: This step rigorously rules out a uniform signed deficit derived only from sharp output-shell labels. It does not exclude angular cancellation within a shell, smooth Littlewood-Paley commutators, physical-space annuli, or temporal decorrelation along an evolving solution; it is a stress test of a candidate mechanism, not a regularity theorem.

zh: 这一节用周期 Stokes--HLS 双线性估计和有限 Volterra 递推，构造了一个全起点统一的临界热流稳定管。精确 Fourier 族证明它加入了旧 \(H^{1/2}\) 管之外的光滑安全数据；裸 Kato 上确界则被一个时间端点反例阻断。whole-space Besov 开放性属于已知文献，Clay 结论仍开放。
en: This section uses a periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and finite Volterra recursion to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform over all starting times. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open.

zh: 这意味着：方向核即使呈现精确的正负角向相消，涡量模长仍能偏向一个符号瓣，恢复核的完整上确界。四瓣模型给出显式例子：均匀平均为零，而权重 \(1+\eta\operatorname{sgn}D\) 立即产生与 \(\eta\) 成正比的有符号拉伸。 14 项形式检查、10 个周期 Fourier 模态和 4 组模长偏置节点全部通过。
en: Thus even exact positive-negative angular cancellation does not suffice: vorticity magnitude may favor one sign lobe and recover the full essential supremum of the kernel. The four-lobe model is explicit: its uniform mean is zero, while the weight \(1+\eta\operatorname{sgn}D\) immediately produces signed stretching proportional to \(\eta\). All 14 formal checks, 10 periodic Fourier modes, and 4 magnitude-bias node sets passed.

zh: 这证明的是固定正则区间内 的预解有限性。显式条件数可以很大，并没有在参考解逼近 潜在奇性端点时给出一致控制。
en: This proves resolvent finiteness on a fixed regular interval. The explicit condition number can be large and gives no uniform control as the reference solution approaches a possible singular endpoint.

zh: 这只关闭裸空间截断作为自动符号或尺度增益来源的路线。它不排除加入调和压力尾、多尺度、Morrey 或几何信息后的控制，也不给出正则性结论。
en: This closes only bare spatial cutoff as an automatic source of sign or scaling gain. It does not exclude control obtained by adding harmonic pressure tails, multiscale, Morrey, or geometric information, and it gives no regularity conclusion.

zh: 这只是 viable-candidate theorem。critical-log action 尚未支付 complete-root ledger，也没有给出 continuation criterion。
en: This is only a viable-candidate theorem. The critical-log action has not yet paid for the complete-root ledger and gives no continuation criterion.

zh: 这只是有限回归检查，不是无穷维逆；整条短步仍在 R0.31 已证明的多圆盘内， 没有到达 R0.32 候选，也没有三维 Navier–Stokes 正则性或奇性结论。
en: This is only a finite regression check, not an infinite-dimensional inverse; the entire short step remains inside the polydisc proved in R0.31, does not reach the R0.32 candidate, and gives no conclusion about three-dimensional Navier-Stokes regularity or singularity.

zh: 真实 remainder work 可精确抵消，同核绝对活动仍严格为正
en: The actual remainder work can cancel exactly, while the absolute activity of the same kernel remains strictly positive

zh: 真实全局光滑小数据轨道中，有符号积分仍可比绝对活动低一阶
en: For a genuine globally smooth small-data trajectory, the signed integral can remain one order below the absolute activity

zh: 真实生成系数的首次尖锐标签检查
en: The first sharp label check for true generating coefficients

zh: 真实生成系数在 \(N=2\) 已含非零尖锐方向投影，简单的子空间排除机制不存在；但首个归一化增益只有专门尖锐极化的约 \(0.43\%\)。
en: True generating coefficients in \(N=2\) already contain non-zero sharp direction projections; a simple subspace exclusion mechanism does not exist. However, the first normalization gain is only approximately \(0.43\%\) for specialized sharp polarizations.

zh: 真实正时间内部 entry 排除裸 Leray 时间支付
en: A genuine positive-time internal entry rules out bare Leray time payment

zh: 整个无限电荷阶梯已被统一层范数控制；\(a,U,V\) 获得显式共同解析域，R0.29 的形式指数分解在更小圆盘中成为解析恒等式。
en: A uniform layer norm now controls the entire infinite charge ladder; \(a,U,V\) gain an explicit common analytic domain, and the R0.29 formal exponential factorization becomes an analytic identity on a smaller polydisc.

zh: 整理非线性相互作用
en: Organizing nonlinear interactions

zh: 正参数域的全局驻点分类
en: classification of global stationary points in the positive parameter domain

A positive-measure Markov generating function requires every ordinary matrix \((m_{i+j})\) and shifted matrix \((m_{i+j+1})\) to be positive semidefinite. Exact rational computation gives four negative principal minors: \(-437/24192\), \(-43522897/685843200\), \(-32/63\), and \(-29699111/12700800\).

zh: 正测度 Padé 路线的精确障碍
en: Exact obstruction to the positive-measure Pade route

zh: 正号可以持续任意多个黏性时间；归一化高阈值仍按临界尺度退出
en: Positivity can persist for arbitrarily many viscous times; normalized high levels still exit on the critical scale

zh: 正结果只覆盖 frozen-low sector。把它写成完整移动低频控制会遗漏仍未估计的时间与偏差项。
en: The positive result covers only the frozen-low sector. Stating it as complete moving-low control would omit the still-unestimated temporal and deviation terms.

zh: 正进位权 \((4,277,169)\) 与每条空间分支的 \(1/16\) 收缩给出 零质量 Kantorovich 界 \(\|\mathcal P\zeta\|_{KR,w}\le16 \|\zeta\|_{KR,w}\)。把完整单形热泛函与主特征分布配对后， 严格认证 \[ S_r=C_*\lambda^r+O(r16^r),\qquad -2.30446\times10^{-5}<C_*<-2.28652\times10^{-5}. \] 因而 \(|S_r|/16^r\to\infty\)，该显式包上的统一 \(O(M)\) 四次估计失败。
en: The positive carry weights \((4,277,169)\) and the \(1/16\) contraction of every spatial branch give the zero-mass Kantorovich bound \(\|\mathcal P\zeta\|_{KR,w}\le16 \|\zeta\|_{KR,w}\). Pairing the complete simplex heat functional with the dominant eigendistribution rigorously certifies \[ S_r=C_*\lambda^r+O(r16^r),\qquad -2.30446\times10^{-5}<C_*<-2.28652\times10^{-5}. \] Hence \(|S_r|/16^r\to\infty\), so the uniform \(O(M)\) quartic estimate fails for this explicit packet.

zh: 正面：全局光滑
en: positive: global smoothness

zh: 正内部恰有两个驻点；精确边界分类与零未决盒的全局 Bernstein 排除证明，第一个根是所选第五阶模型正参数闭包上的唯一全局目标比例最大点。
en: There are exactly two stationary points in the positive interior. Exact boundary classification and a global Bernstein exclusion with no undecided boxes show that the first root is the unique global maximizer of the target share on the positive-parameter closure of the selected fifth-order model.

zh: 正时间线性化的精确标量增益是 \[ G(x)=E_{1/2}(x) =e^{x^2}\operatorname{erfc}(-x),\qquad x=2C_S\sqrt{\pi h}\,V. \] 因此 \(4\pi C_S^2V^2h\) 指数不是 Bielecki 权重造成的。 把 \(A=4\pi C_S^2V^2h\) 和 \(\theta=b_\lambda\) 代入 R0.69E，唯一最优权重满足 \[ \theta_A^3=2A(1-\theta_A), \] 且最优证书仍为 \(2eA\,e^A(1+O(A^{-1}))\)；精确增益则为 \(2e^A(1+o(1))\)。
en: The exact scalar gain of the positive-time linearization is \[ G(x)=E_{1/2}(x) =e^{x^2}\operatorname{erfc}(-x),\qquad x=2C_S\sqrt{\pi h}\,V. \] Hence the \(4\pi C_S^2V^2h\) exponent is not caused by the Bielecki weight. Substituting \(A=4\pi C_S^2V^2h\) and \(\theta=b_\lambda\) into R0.69E gives the unique optimal weight \[ \theta_A^3=2A(1-\theta_A), \] while the optimized certificate remains \(2eA\,e^A(1+O(A^{-1}))\) and the exact gain is \(2e^A(1+o(1))\).

zh: 正式 119 阶 GMP 回归处理 5,484,501 次精确相互作用，峰值 CPU 为 100%，峰值常驻内存为 32.188 MiB。 它只检查实现；全阶性来自 2–296 阶精确覆盖与 297 阶以后解析尾界的拼接。
en: The formal degree-119 GMP regression processes 5,484,501 exact interactions, with peak CPU use of 100% and peak resident memory of 32.188 MiB. It checks only the implementation; the all-order statement comes from joining exact coverage over degrees 2–296 to the analytic tail from degree 297 onward.

zh: 正式问题、已知结果、计算记录和仍未解决的步骤。
en: Formal statement, known results, calculations, and the steps that remain unresolved.

zh: 正文复核还发现并修正了一个记录层问题：继承辅助函数曾保存未乘总次数的 中心与残差诊断。修正版 Newton 残差范数为 \(1.6910402110013306773\times10^{-30}\)，32 项精确检查全部通过； 阈值、支配与几何结论不依赖那条旧诊断。
en: A prose review also found and corrected a record-level issue: an inherited helper had stored center and residual diagnostics without the total-degree factor. The corrected Newton residual norm is \(1.6910402110013306773\times10^{-30}\), and all 32 exact checks pass; the threshold, dominance, and geometry conclusions do not depend on the old diagnostic.

zh: 正则伸缩分解绕过旧直接输运的精确范数障碍，全部输入次数与荷由一个无次数前因子的凸两端点公式覆盖，共同解析半径提高到 \(329/1000\)。
en: The canonical-stretch factorization bypasses the exact norm barrier of the old direct transport. One convex two-endpoint formula without an input-degree prefactor covers all input degrees and charges, increasing the common analytic radius to \(329/1000\).

zh: 正则伸缩输运、精确次数消去与共同解析半径扩张
en: Canonical-stretch transport, exact degree cancellation, and common analytic-radius expansion

zh: 正则性
en: Regularity

zh: 证明 vortex stretching 具有可被方向相干性削弱的精细几何结构。
en: prove that vortex stretching has a fine geometric structure that can be weakened by direction coherence.

zh: 证明 weighted remainder-stable whole-line theorem。
en: Prove a weighted remainder-stable whole-line theorem.

zh: 证明或否定非自伴绝热跟踪及其有界前因子。
en: Prove or disprove nonnormal adiabatic tracking and its bounded prefactor.

zh: 证明或否证固定小物理窗口上的 moving-profile top bundle 统一谱隙与演化二分。
en: Prove or disprove a uniform spectral gap and evolution dichotomy for the moving-profile top bundle on a fixed small physical window.

zh: 证明任意光滑无散初值产生全局光滑解，或严格构造有限时破裂。
en: prove that any smooth divergence-free initial data produces a global smooth solution or strictly construct a finite-time blow-up.

zh: 证明最小临界元不存在；或找到一个与全部刚性条件相容的候选。
en: prove the non-existence of minimal critical elements; or find a candidate compatible with all rigid conditions.

zh: 证书先以精确球面矩把共同旋转约化为五类距离原函数，再以经验证梯形原函数与逐盒 Taylor 余项覆盖二维径向积分。四至六阶截断导数中的端点 \(\delta,\delta',\delta''\) 项全部显式保留；独立检查器把结果端点解析为精确有理数重算判别式。 20 个 DGX 分片的进度、资源采样、日志和部分证书均已归档并由 SHA-256 锁定。
en: The certificate first reduces the common rotation to five distance primitives using exact sphere moments, then covers the two-dimensional radial integral with validated trapezoidal primitives and boxwise Taylor remainders. All \(\delta,\delta',\delta''\) endpoint terms in cutoff derivatives four through six are retained explicitly; an independent checker parses the result endpoints as exact rationals and recomputes the discriminant. Progress, resource samples, logs, and partial certificates from all 20 DGX workers are archived and locked by SHA-256.

zh: 直接 Young 估计比 R0.71F 的 heat-bulk 权多要求两阶频率。本节没有构造 integrated BV 反例，也没有得到无条件继续性、有限时奇性或全局正则性。
en: Direct Young's inequality requires two more frequency powers than the heat-bulk weight from R0.71F. This section does not construct an integrated-BV counterexample and does not obtain unconditional continuation, a finite-time singularity, or global regularity.

en: Compact Fourier shells have absolutely continuous representatives at the Leray–Hopf level. For every right-rooted positive excursion \(E\), \[ H_E^2=\frac{\kappa_j^{-6}h_E^2}{\ell Y_E}, \qquad \sum_{j,E}H_E^2\le\frac{B_1(K)}{\ell}. \] Therefore the amplitude-thresholded excursion count has a scale-zero bound and extends from finite families by Tonelli and monotone convergence; a component already positive at the left endpoint of the window requires a separate initial trace.

en: Duhamel heat denominator and critical saturation

zh: ED semigroup 结论覆盖 \(R,2R\)、\(B=2\) 与 \(|\lambda|\le1/8\)，包括 \(\lambda=0\)；只有 inherited amplitude-balanced physical comparison 另要求固定 \(0<\lambda_-\le|\lambda|\)，且相关常数可依赖 \(\lambda_-\)。完整 propagator 保留所有 cross terms。
en: The enhanced-dissipation semigroup conclusion covers \(R,2R\), \(B=2\), and \(|\lambda|\le1/8\), including \(\lambda=0\). Only the inherited amplitude-balanced physical comparison additionally requires a fixed \(0<\lambda_-\le|\lambda|\), and the relevant constants may depend on \(\lambda_-\). The full propagator retains every cross term.

zh: even test function 产生两个 scalar moments。bounded centers 用 compactness，escaping centers 用 \(B'\overline A\) identity 与 scalar endpoint traces；证明不假设 \(L^2_X\)-valued endpoint trace。
en: An even test function produces two scalar moments. Bounded centers are handled by compactness, while escaping centers are handled by the \(B'\overline A\) identity and scalar endpoint traces; the proof does not assume an \(L^2_X\)-valued endpoint trace.

zh: exact cubic scalar model 的 whole-line graph theorem 与 fixed-block contraction 已闭合
en: The exact cubic scalar model's whole-line graph theorem and fixed-block contraction are closed

zh: exact forced heat equation 与 finite conditional incidence theorem 成立；certificate (3.3) 的一参数 endpoint-square、termwise source-square 方案无法同时满足 rho=0 scale covariance 与 rho=2 minimal Leray payment，其他 Duhamel designs 保持开放。
en: The exact forced heat equation and finite conditional incidence theorem hold; the one-parameter endpoint-square, termwise source-square scheme in certificate (3.3) cannot simultaneously satisfy rho=0 scale covariance and rho=2 minimal Leray payment, while other Duhamel designs remain open.

zh: exact launch、同相且幅度可比时，\(\chi_0=O(M^{-1})\)、\(\Omega^2/K_v=O(M^{-1})\)、\(M/K_s=O(M^{-2})\)，总 prefactor 为 \(M^{-10/3}\)。若 \(\eta=M^\alpha\)、\(L=M^{-\beta}\)，充分消失区为 \(\alpha<\min\{5/2,(10+3\beta)/7\}\)。这个区域没有 converse。
en: At exact launch with aligned phases and comparable amplitudes, \(\chi_0=O(M^{-1})\), \(\Omega^2/K_v=O(M^{-1})\), and \(M/K_s=O(M^{-2})\), so the total prefactor is \(M^{-10/3}\). If \(\eta=M^\alpha\) and \(L=M^{-\beta}\), the sufficient vanishing region is \(\alpha<\min\{5/2,(10+3\beta)/7\}\). There is no converse for this region.

zh: exact real one-carrier ray 上的全部根由 Rolle–BV 与完整 action 支付；critical-log payment 对 complete roots 尖锐。
en: Every root on the exact real one-carrier ray is paid by Rolle–BV and the complete action; the critical-log payment is sharp for the complete roots.

zh: exact shear NSE 给出一条解析障碍：对每个实振幅，zero production at every positive scale；仅当 A != 0 时，strictly positive heat covariance 才成立，A = 0 时它为零。这只否定 production-only coercivity；Vreman（2004）已直接覆盖 basic shear 碰撞，因此我不申报该机制的新颖性或优先权。analytic exact witness / not DNS；NOT CLAY。
en: The exact shear NSE provides an analytic obstruction: for every real amplitude, zero production at every positive scale; strictly positive heat covariance holds only when A != 0, and it is zero when A = 0. This only rules out production-only coercivity; Vreman (2004) already directly covers the basic shear overlap, so I do not claim novelty or priority for this mechanism. analytic exact witness / not DNS; NOT CLAY.

zh: exact unforced globally smooth 2.5D NSE family 可在任意指定 finite time set 返回同一 compact annulus。每个 finite set 与每个 \(N\) 选择一条新轨迹；unit energy–enstrophy ball 上 raw global-shell entry count 没有统一上界。entry atom 可以随 \(N\) 缩小，所以这不是 weighted-atom counterexample。
en: An exact unforced globally smooth 2.5D NSE family can return to the same compact annulus at any prescribed finite time set. A new trajectory is selected for each finite set and each \(N\); the raw global-shell entry count has no uniform bound on the unit energy-enstrophy ball. The entry atoms may shrink with \(N\), so this is not a weighted-atom counterexample.

zh: exactPeriodicGraphCoercivity=CLOSED，exactPeriodicBlockContraction=CLOSED，globalTermwiseRemainderAbsorption=FALSE，timeLengthUniformity=FALSE；outerTimeConcatenation、nonlinear/Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: exactPeriodicGraphCoercivity=CLOSED; exactPeriodicBlockContraction=CLOSED; globalTermwiseRemainderAbsorption=FALSE; timeLengthUniformity=FALSE; outerTimeConcatenation and nonlinear or Clay claims remain OPEN.

zh: excursion height 可由 Leray 支付，固定零层斜率仍需额外信息
en: Excursion height can be paid by Leray; the fixed zero-level slope still needs additional information

zh: extreme strong coupling、multiscale physical absorption 与一般三维正则性仍开放。
en: Extreme strong coupling, multiscale physical absorption, and general three-dimensional regularity remain open.

zh: family-uniform ED 仍属于固定 commensurate 1:2:3 triangular affine-row class，并只在 \(0\le y\le1\) 的 cell window 使用；wall crossing、任意时变相位与一般三维问题未证明。
en: Family-uniform enhanced dissipation remains confined to the fixed commensurate 1:2:3 triangular affine-row class and is used only on the cell window \(0\le y\le1\); wall crossing, arbitrary time-dependent phases, and the general three-dimensional problem are not proved.

zh: Feynman–Kac、固定相位驻相和定量 Hörmander density 给 \[ Q_{\delta,q_0}(X)\le C_{X,q_0}\frac{1+\log(2+\delta)}{\delta}. \] 取 \(\delta_R=R^4\)、\(P_R=q_0^2\delta_R\)、 \(S_R^2=\delta_R/\log(2+\delta_R)\)，完整数据与 enstrophy contrast 得到支付， full-frequency rotational charge 保持有界，而 \(\mathcal J_{\rm all}\gtrsim\delta_R\)。
en: Feynman–Kac, fixed-phase stationary phase, and a quantitative Hörmander density bound give \[ Q_{\delta,q_0}(X)\le C_{X,q_0}\frac{1+\log(2+\delta)}{\delta}. \] With \(\delta_R=R^4\), \(P_R=q_0^2\delta_R\), and \(S_R^2=\delta_R/\log(2+\delta_R)\), the complete data and enstrophy contrast are paid, the full-frequency rotational charge stays bounded, and \(\mathcal J_{\rm all}\gtrsim\delta_R\).

zh: finite conjugate-paired multi-carrier mixed row 具有载波数无关的 moment-resolved payment；action-only 版本被全奇数 Rudin–Shapiro 族排除。
en: The finite conjugate-paired multi-carrier mixed row has a carrier-count-independent moment-resolved payment; an all-odd Rudin–Shapiro family excludes the action-only version.

zh: finite outgoing-coarea identity 对 odd crossings 与 even touches 都精确保留 \(A_+\)，但其 zero-level mollifier concentration 尚无 Leray payment。finite trace-variation theorem 也成立，却保留 strong Lamb、\(F_t\)、\(Y_t\) 与 repeated-direction Bessel ledgers。
en: The finite outgoing-coarea identity exactly retains \(A_+\) for both odd crossings and even touches, but its zero-level mollifier concentration still has no Leray payment. The finite trace-variation theorem also holds, but retains the strong Lamb term, \(F_t\), \(Y_t\), and the repeated-direction Bessel ledgers.

zh: finite-dimensional IFT 构造 genuine smooth positive-time internal entry；double scaling 排除 bare normalized Leray-Lamb time payment；outgoing coarea 保留为未闭合的 scale-matched charge。
en: A finite-dimensional IFT constructs a genuine smooth positive-time internal entry; double scaling rules out bare normalized Leray-Lamb time payment; outgoing coarea remains as an unclosed scale-matched charge.

zh: fixed-\(c\) low-gap uniformity 与 prefactor-one contraction 为 FALSE；sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law、complete A2 direct sum、nonlinearNavierStokes 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: Fixed-\(c\) low-gap uniformity and prefactor-one contraction are FALSE; the sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law, complete A2 direct sum, nonlinearNavierStokes, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: fixed-margin Coble--He propagation 与 exact A2 cocycle 的 fast-history 拼接只声明 periodic representative \(\beta=0\)。三项不安全外推保持 FALSE。
en: The fast-history concatenation of fixed-margin Coble--He propagation with the exact A2 cocycle is stated only for the periodic representative \(\beta=0\). Three unsafe extrapolations remain FALSE.

zh: frame defect 可写成非负 response-distance 核；真正的拉伸只消费其 strain-compatible 投影，而不是整个非负距离。
en: The frame defect can be written as a nonnegative response-distance kernel; actual stretching uses only its strain-compatible projection, not the entire nonnegative distance.

zh: Fujita–Kato、Kato、Koch–Tataru 等理论在 \(\dot H^{1/2}\)、\(L^3\)、\(BMO^{-1}\) 等临界框架中建立小数据全局适定性。 缺失的是任意大小临界数据的先验控制。
en: Fujita–Kato, Kato, Koch–Tataru and other theories establish small-data global well-posedness in critical frameworks such as \(\dot H^{1/2}\), \(L^3\), and \(BMO^{-1}\). The missing part is the a priori control for arbitrary-size critical data.

zh: full data/root-time enstrophy floors、Fourier multiplier upper bound、amplitude optimization 与 unavoidable lattice cost \(K_s\gtrsim N^3\) 给出 \[ \frac{\mathcal J_N^{\rm sel}}{D_N^{1/3}\Lambda_1} \le C\nu^{-2}\frac{\delta_{\rm obs,N}^{4/3}}N. \] bounded \(\delta_{\rm obs,N}\) 下 selected ratio 消失；非消失至少要求 \(\delta_{\rm obs,N}\gtrsim N^{3/4}\)。一般 \(M\) carriers、\(R\) sampled roots 的 bound 为 \(CR\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}/M^2\)，所以 bounded-coupling escape 至少需要 quadratic root proliferation。
en: The full data/root-time enstrophy floors, Fourier multiplier upper bound, amplitude optimization, and unavoidable lattice cost \(K_s\gtrsim N^3\) give \[ \frac{\mathcal J_N^{\rm sel}}{D_N^{1/3}\Lambda_1} \le C\nu^{-2}\frac{\delta_{\rm obs,N}^{4/3}}N. \] Under bounded \(\delta_{\rm obs,N}\) the selected ratio vanishes; nonvanishing requires at least \(\delta_{\rm obs,N}\gtrsim N^{3/4}\). For general \(M\) carriers and \(R\) sampled roots, the bound is \(CR\delta_{\rm obs}^{4/3}/M^2\), so bounded-coupling escape requires at least quadratic root proliferation.

zh: full nonlinear estimates 给 \[ J_{*,2,q}\asymp\mathscr A_q^2/q^2\to\infty,\qquad \mathcal R_{Y_q}=O(1),\qquad \ell^{-1}\!\int_I\frac{\|\mathbb P(u_q\times\omega_q)\|_{\dot H^{-1}}^2}{Y_q}\,dt =O(\mathscr A_q^2/q^4)\to0. \] 所以带固定 \(\nu^2\) baseline 的 complete first-row ledger 也没有 data-independent bound。
en: Full nonlinear estimates give \[ J_{*,2,q}\asymp\mathscr A_q^2/q^2\to\infty,\qquad \mathcal R_{Y_q}=O(1),\qquad \ell^{-1}\!\int_I\frac{\|\mathbb P(u_q\times\omega_q)\|_{\dot H^{-1}}^2}{Y_q}\,dt =O(\mathscr A_q^2/q^4)\to0. \] Hence the complete first-row ledger with the fixed \(\nu^2\) baseline also has no data-independent bound.

zh: gcd 约化 Cayley 图的二分性已精确分类；non-bipartite 不自动产生 cubic，common-band coherent family 的 true cubic contribution 归一化比仍衰减。
en: Bipartiteness of the gcd-reduced Cayley graph is classified exactly; non-bipartiteness does not automatically produce a cubic, and the normalized ratio of the true cubic contribution in the common-band coherent family still decays.

zh: GMP 精确递推达到总次数 149。对偶数截断 30 至 50，我构造 U、V 和 D 中心组合的对角 D-log Padé 逼近， 用 Sturm 计数隔离实根，并精确认证根的唯一性、简单性、分子无消去与留数区间。 160 位与 256 位独立复核一致。
en: The exact GMP recurrence reaches total degree 149. For even cuts 30 through 50, I construct diagonal D-log Pade approximants of U, V, and the D-center combination, isolate real roots with Sturm counts, and exactly certify uniqueness, simplicity, numerator noncancellation, and residue intervals. Independent 160-bit and 256-bit checks agree.

zh: GMP 精确计算达到 \(N=40\)，即最高 119 叶。 对整个半径 \(10^{-6}\) 的 R0.20 认证根盒，\(a_N>0\) 在 \(1\le N\le40\) 成立， \((-1)^{N+1}d_N>0\) 在 \(8\le N\le40\) 成立；最小符号裕量仍超过根盒不确定度的 \(62214\) 倍。
en: GMP precise calculation reaches \(N=40\), i. e., the highest 119 leaves. For the entire radius \(10^{-6}\) R0.20 certification root box, \(a_N>0\) holds in \(1\le N\le40\), and \((-1)^{N+1}d_N>0\) holds in \(8\le N\le40\); the minimum symbol margin still exceeds the root box uncertainty by more than \(62214\) times.

zh: harmonic Taylor 展开逐阶增益，固定阶数仍不能阻止线性累计
en: The harmonic Taylor expansion gains order by order, but any fixed order still permits linear accumulation

zh: heat identity 要求先把临界点导数芽积分回速度芽；四项联立唯一给出 \(X=\kappa^{1/5}x\)、\(S=\kappa^{2/5}d\)，主模型由 \(H_3=X^3+6SX\) 控制。
en: Heat identity requires that the critical point derivative bud be integrated back to the velocity bud first; the four terms jointly uniquely give \(X=\kappa^{1/5}x\) and \(S=\kappa^{2/5}d\), and the main model is controlled by \(H_3=X^3+6SX\).

zh: hidden physical mean 与 \(X_\mu\) finite-transient bound
en: Hidden physical mean and \(X_\mu\) finite-transient bound

zh: incidence preimage 由 higher jets 精确分为 \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\)；四个系数方向的一至四阶 derivative-jet determinant 为 \(5400\)，支持 modulo constants 的 restricted miniversal 与单个 marked branch 的局部余维 \(1,2,3,4\)。
en: Higher jets partition the incidence preimages exactly into \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\); the derivative-jet determinant of orders one through four for the four coefficient directions is \(5400\), supporting restricted miniversality modulo constants and local codimensions \(1,2,3,4\) for a single marked branch.

zh: integer-compatible torus initial data、covariant radial multiplier 与 cutoff 给出 exact Fourier first jet。它只定义 \(\Gamma_{2,\mathrm{jet}}:=A_+/(K^{-2}\|hC_t(0)\|_2^2/Y(0))=K^2/(4\theta^2)\)；这是 leading surrogate，不是 positive-time certificate (3.3) 的 upper comparison constant \(\Gamma_2\) 下界。even-touch、sequential 与 component-union families 只是 forced scalar method tests，不是 NSE trajectories。
en: Integer-compatible torus initial data, a covariant radial multiplier, and the cutoff give an exact Fourier first jet. It defines only \(\Gamma_{2,\mathrm{jet}}:=A_+/(K^{-2}\|hC_t(0)\|_2^2/Y(0))=K^2/(4\theta^2)\); this is a leading surrogate and, in the positive-time certificate (3.3), not a lower bound for the upper comparison constant \(\Gamma_2\). The even-touch, sequential, and component-union families are only forced-scalar method tests, not NSE trajectories.

zh: Jensen 给出有限条件计数，解析性本身仍不支付时间进入打包
en: Jensen gives a finite conditional count, but analyticity itself still does not pay for temporal entry packing

zh: Koch–Tataru 扩张小数据临界理论；Escauriaza–Seregin–Šverák 完成关键端点正则性。
en: Koch–Tataru expands small-data critical theory; Escauriaza–Seregin–Šverák completes key endpoint regularity.

zh: Leray 极化通道与法向障碍
en: Leray polarization channels and the normal obstruction

zh: Leray–Hopf 理论对有限能量初值给出全局弱解，并满足能量不等式。 未解决的是一般无外力情形下的光滑性，以及弱解层面的适当唯一性。
en: Leray–Hopf theory provides global weak solutions for finite energy initial data, satisfying the energy inequality. The unresolved issues are general smoothness in the absence of external forces and proper uniqueness at the level of weak solutions.

zh: Leray–Hopf right-rooted excursion-height packing 成立；fixed zero-level atom 不能只由所选 singleton target-shell 的同一 first-time row 统一支付，左端已正 component 另付 initial trace。
en: Leray–Hopf right-rooted excursion-height packing holds; a fixed zero-level atom cannot be uniformly paid by the same first-time row of the selected singleton target shell alone, and a component already positive at the left endpoint requires a separate initial trace.

zh: Leray：全局有限能量弱解
en: Leray: global finite energy weak solution

zh: local exposure 关闭一片 strong-coupling / shrinking-layer 区域；exact Bessel 模型排除 \(\eta\)-independent rescaled target-row slope-mass 常数。
en: Local exposure closes one strong-coupling / shrinking-layer region; the exact Bessel model rules out an \(\eta\)-independent rescaled target-row slope-mass constant.

zh: localized filtered-vorticity observable 满足 \[ C_{j,Q,t}-\nu\Delta C_{j,Q}=G_{j,Q}. \] 对显式 forward height、post-entry upper comparison constant \(\Gamma_\rho\) 与 same-observable overlap，Duhamel 给出 finite conditional event-to-window packing theorem；\(1/\Gamma_\rho\) 编码 lower-charge strength。窗口假设包括 \(0<\theta_-\le\theta_\beta\le\theta_*\) 的统一正下界；\(M\) 取 essential supremum。统一 \(\theta_-\) 与 forward-window availability 是 theorem gates，不是右端因子；缺少正下界时可以任意缩短窗口而平凡化 overlap。
en: The localized filtered-vorticity observable satisfies \[ C_{j,Q,t}-\nu\Delta C_{j,Q}=G_{j,Q}. \] For an explicit forward height, a post-entry upper comparison constant \(\Gamma_\rho\), and same-observable overlap, Duhamel gives a finite conditional event-to-window packing theorem; \(1/\Gamma_\rho\) encodes lower-charge strength. The window hypothesis includes the uniform positive lower bound \(0<\theta_-\le\theta_\beta\le\theta_*\); \(M\) is an essential supremum. Uniform \(\theta_-\) and forward-window availability are theorem gates, not right-hand-side factors; without the positive lower bound, windows can be shortened arbitrarily and the overlap condition trivialized.

zh: localSolutionObservability=CLOSED；wholeLineBlockContraction、periodicTransfer 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: localSolutionObservability=CLOSED; wholeLineBlockContraction, periodicTransfer, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: low-gap physical row、BlochUniformPhysicalVelocityDirectSum、nonlinearNavierStokes 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: The low-gap physical row, BlochUniformPhysicalVelocityDirectSum, nonlinearNavierStokes, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: MAP · 研究路线
en: MAP · Research route

zh: marked \(A_2\)–\(A_5\) strata 与两条 heat collision 已精确闭合
en: The marked \(A_2\)–\(A_5\) strata and two heat collisions are closed exactly

zh: matched bounded-overlap partition 给出更强的局部条件继续性 consumer，并保留 \[ \sum_{j,Q}q_{j,Q}(s)\le N\|e^{s\Delta}L\|_2^2. \] 任意 \(\alpha>0\) 都有精确 Gamma 谱矩；标准 Leray 能量无条件关闭的是 \(\alpha=1\)。对六模态初值生成的全局光滑 2D3C 解，每个非零光滑 \(\phi\ge0\) 又精确满足 \[ q_\phi(0)=\frac{2K^2}{1-e^{-2K^2h}}\int_0^h q_\phi(s)\,ds. \]
en: A matched bounded-overlap partition gives a stronger local conditional continuation consumer and preserves \[ \sum_{j,Q}q_{j,Q}(s)\le N\|e^{s\Delta}L\|_2^2. \] Every \(\alpha>0\) has an exact Gamma spectral moment; standard Leray energy closes \(\alpha=1\) unconditionally. For the globally smooth 2D3C solution generated by six-mode initial data, every nonzero smooth \(\phi\ge0\) also satisfies exactly \[ q_\phi(0)=\frac{2K^2}{1-e^{-2K^2h}}\int_0^h q_\phi(s)\,ds. \]

zh: matched localization 保留无条件 heat packing，但任意局部 cutoff 的精确光滑迹仍支付临界 \(K^2\) 代价。
en: Matched localization preserves unconditional heat packing, but the exact smooth trace for every local cutoff still pays the critical \(K^2\) cost.

zh: mixed-parity 目标一般是复值，实 Rolle complete-root 账本没有在本节闭合。一般三维正则性仍然开放。
en: A mixed-parity target is generally complex-valued, and this section does not close the real-Rolle complete-root ledger. General three-dimensional regularity remains open.

zh: Morrey 控制保住远场估计，却没有修复近场正则性缺口
en: Morrey control preserves the far-field estimate but does not repair the near-field regularity gap

zh: nonzero-mean directional packet、frozen-denominator backward heat 与限定 normalized bilinear kernels 都保留 κ² Bessel 税；genuine NSE initial-face scaling 排除原目标由 bare Leray time integral 统一支付的 observation-boundary 终局。
en: The nonzero-mean directional packet, frozen-denominator backward heat, and the specified normalized bilinear kernels all retain the κ² Bessel tax; genuine NSE initial-face scaling rules out the observation-boundary endpoint in which the original target is paid uniformly by the bare Leray time integral.

zh: normalization 与 projective row 也精确重组为 \[ \mathcal J_Q=z_{Q,t}+\nu\kappa^2z_Q. \] aligned witness 还满足 cutoff–curl numerator 逐格为零，以及 \(N^{-1}D_j\le D_{\rm loc}\le C_{\rm part}D_j\)。Leray 能量支付 weighted denominator mass；当前 direct tangent Cauchy 还引入 angular condition number 与 normalized projected-Lamb quotient，尚未从标准能量不等式推出。
en: The normalization and projective row also recombine exactly as \[ \mathcal J_Q=z_{Q,t}+\nu\kappa^2z_Q. \] The aligned witness also has a cutoff–curl numerator that vanishes cellwise and satisfies \(N^{-1}D_j\le D_{\rm loc}\le C_{\rm part}D_j\). Leray energy pays the weighted denominator mass, whereas the current direct tangent Cauchy estimate additionally introduces an angular condition number and a normalized projected-Lamb quotient, which have not been derived from the standard energy inequality.

zh: odd-generation Rudin–Shapiro signs 精确实现 \(\chi_0=1/4\) 与 \(\Phi_{0,M}\asymp M^{-8/3}\)，所以 coherent \(M^{-10/3}\) 不能对 phases 一致成立；固定正 \(A_*\) 的同号 family 则实现 \(M^{-3}\)。这里的 sharpness 只属于显示的 algebraic prefactor，不是 actual root mass、normalized ledger 或 NSE 奇性下界。
en: Odd-generation Rudin–Shapiro signs exactly realize \(\chi_0=1/4\) and \(\Phi_{0,M}\asymp M^{-8/3}\), so coherent \(M^{-10/3}\) cannot hold uniformly across phases; at fixed positive \(A_*\), a same-sign family realizes \(M^{-3}\). This sharpness belongs only to the displayed algebraic prefactor, not to actual root mass, the normalized ledger, or a lower bound for an NSE singularity.

zh: participation 与 multiplier norm 需要联合估计： \[ \chi_A\left(\frac{\Omega_A^2}{K_v}\right)^{1/3} \le\left(\frac{\rho_A^2}{K_v}\right)^{1/3}. \] 对互异正整数 carriers 与可比模长，若 \(H_M(A)=\sum_{j=1}^Me^{-2\kappa Aj^2}\)，则 \[ \Phi_{A,M}\le C M^{-3}H_M(A)^{1/3}. \] exact launch 给 phase-uniform \(O(M^{-8/3})\)，固定正 \(A_*\) 的 restarted tail 给 \(O(M^{-3})\)。
en: Participation and the multiplier norm must be estimated jointly: \[ \chi_A\left(\frac{\Omega_A^2}{K_v}\right)^{1/3} \le\left(\frac{\rho_A^2}{K_v}\right)^{1/3}. \] For distinct positive integer carriers with comparable moduli, let \(H_M(A)=\sum_{j=1}^Me^{-2\kappa Aj^2}\). Then \[ \Phi_{A,M}\le C M^{-3}H_M(A)^{1/3}. \] Exact launch gives the phase-uniform bound \(O(M^{-8/3})\), while the restarted tail at fixed positive \(A_*\) gives \(O(M^{-3})\).

zh: physical kinetic、Squire、general Bloch、direct sum、nonlinearNavierStokes 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: Physical kinetic control, Squire, general Bloch, the direct sum, nonlinearNavierStokes, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: physical phases 必须以共轭配对进入两侧移位；phase-uniform exact-launch algebraic prefactor 的 sharp 尺度是 \(M^{-8/3}\)，固定正观察时刻的 tail 尺度是 \(M^{-3}\)。
en: Physical phases must enter the two shifts as conjugate pairs; the sharp scale of the phase-uniform exact-launch algebraic prefactor is \(M^{-8/3}\), and the fixed-positive-observation-time tail scale is \(M^{-3}\).

zh: Projected-Lamb 热体积由能量闭合，临界底边迹仍未闭合
en: Energy closes the projected-Lamb heat bulk, while the critical bottom trace remains open

zh: projected-Lamb 压缩给出无条件 \(L_t^1\) 热体积估计；固定光滑框架和全局光滑 NSE 解同时显示底边迹仍损失 \(2K^2\)。
en: Projected-Lamb compression gives an unconditional \(L_t^1\) heat-bulk estimate; a fixed smooth frame and a globally smooth NSE solution also show that the bottom trace still loses \(2K^2\).

zh: pure-second path 的 distinct count 为 \(4/3/2\)，且全 \(y\ge0\) 只有 \(y=\log2\) 一个 \(A_2\) 事件；real-even path 为 \(4/2/2\)，其 \(A_3\) 只在 real-even slice 内横截。两条路径在碰撞时按重数都为四。
en: The pure-second path has distinct count \(4/3/2\); over all \(y\ge0\), its only event occurs at \(y=\log2\) and is an \(A_2\) event. The real-even path has \(4/2/2\), and its \(A_3\) event is transverse only inside the real-even slice. Both paths have total multiplicity four at the collision.
