The physical shape constants \((\pi/48,144,240)\) and fixed-pattern commensurate 1:2:3 triangular affine-row family-uniform enhanced dissipation are used only on the cell window \(0\le y\le1\). Every path remains uniformly nondegenerate when crossing \(Q_2=1/2\), so the old boundary is not the caustic. Only a caustic-free compact core is proved here, not a complete four-dimensional chamber classification.

zh: R0.72S 把 R0.72R 的 incidence 继续分成 marked \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\) strata；determinant \(5400\) 给 modulo constants 的 restricted miniversal。pure-second path 具有全局 \(4/3/2\) distinct count，real-even path 具有 \(4/2/2\)，crossing multiplicity 均为四。A3 只在 real-even slice 内横截；global caustic image 与 ED through collision 没有闭合。
en: R0.72S further partitions the R0.72R incidence into marked \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\) strata; determinant \(5400\) gives restricted miniversality modulo constants. The pure-second path has global distinct count \(4/3/2\), while the real-even path has \(4/2/2\), and both have multiplicity four at the crossing. The A3 path is transverse only in the real-even slice; the global caustic image and enhanced dissipation through a collision are not closed.

zh: R0.72T 先纠正 derivative-to-primitive 混用，再用 heat-polynomial basis 与四项平衡得到唯一 \(1/5,2/5\) scaling。Viola 的 quadratic half-scale 只校准错误模型；drift-only \(1/720\)、physical \(3/5\) 回填、combined fixed-\(f\) identity 与 inviscid mixing 已闭合，但它们都不是 evolving-solution observability。CDZE 只到 \(6/7\)，block contraction 与 periodic transfer 仍开放。
en: R0.72T first corrects the derivative-to-primitive mixture, and then uses heat-polynomial basis and four-term balance to obtain the unique \(1/5,2/5\) scaling. Viola's quadratic half-scale only calibrates the error model; drift-only \(1/720\), physical \(3/5\) backfill, combined fixed-\(f\) identity, and inviscid mixing are closed, but none of them are evolving-solution observability. CDZE only reaches \(6/7\), block contraction and periodic transfer are still open.

zh: R0.72U 排除 literal spatial-cutoff 的 Poincare 平凡化，改证无 temporal cutoff、无 spatial zero trace 的 fixed-chart graph estimate。bounded centers 用 compactness，escaping centers 用 two-moment endpoint identity；local actual-solution observability 已闭合。whole-line tails、boundary flux 与 periodic transfer 仍开放。
en: R0.72U excludes the Poincaré trivialization caused by a literal spatial cutoff and instead proves a fixed-chart graph estimate with neither a temporal cutoff nor a zero spatial trace. Bounded centers are handled by compactness and escaping centers by a two-moment endpoint identity; local observability for actual solutions is closed. Whole-line tails, boundary flux, and periodic transfer remain open.

zh: R0.72V 以 coefficient-uniform unit charts、spatial translation 与 nonhomogeneous H^-1 direct sum 闭合 exact cubic scalar whole-line graph theorem；另行构造的 all-L2 energy evolution 给 fixed-block contraction。T-uniformity 为 false，H5/H7/R9、periodic 与 nonlinear/Clay 仍开放。
en: R0.72V closes the exact cubic scalar whole-line graph theorem through coefficient-uniform unit charts, spatial translation, and a nonhomogeneous H^-1 direct sum; a separately constructed all-L2 energy evolution yields fixed-block contraction. T-uniformity is false, while H5/H7/R9, periodic, and nonlinear or Clay claims remain open.

zh: R0.72W 排除 finite H5/H7/R9 global termwise absorption，转而保留 full trigonometric heat path；compact--escaping cell dichotomy 与 whole-line/torus H^-1 direct sums 给 exact periodic graph theorem，all-L2 energy evolution 给 scalar collision-block contraction。T-uniformity 为 false，outer-time concatenation 与 nonlinear/Clay 仍开放。
en: R0.72W excludes finite H5/H7/R9 global termwise absorption and instead retains the full trigonometric heat path; the compact--escaping cell dichotomy and whole-line/torus H^-1 direct sums yield the exact periodic graph theorem, while the all-L2 energy evolution yields scalar collision-block contraction. T-uniformity is false, and outer-time concatenation and nonlinear or Clay claims remain open.

zh: R0.72X 把 R0.72W 的 exact periodic scalar block 推到 fixed physical compact 内的 every center；all-start、integrated scale 与 Bloch twists 只属于 A2 exact path。fixed-margin Coble--He 与 central A2 的 fast-history cocycle 只声明 periodic representative beta=0。三项外推为 FALSE；forced transfer、完整线性化系统与 nonlinear/Clay 仍为 OPEN。
en: R0.72X advances R0.72W's exact periodic scalar block to every center in a fixed physical compact set; all-start propagation, the integrated scale, and Bloch twists belong only to the exact A2 path. The fast-history cocycle joining fixed-margin Coble--He propagation to central A2 is stated only for the periodic representative beta=0. Three extrapolations are FALSE; forced transfer, the complete linearized system, and nonlinear/Clay conclusions remain OPEN.

zh: R0.72Y 从 Navier--Stokes 恢复 complete Fourier--Leray row，闭合 pressure factor two、OS--Squire signs、velocity recovery、scalar invariant embedding 与按 norm 分层的 forced-transfer powers。exact zero-coupling lift-up 排除 epsilon-only strict contraction；strong complete-row A2 estimate 与 nonlinear/Clay 仍为 OPEN。
en: R0.72Y rederives the complete Fourier--Leray row from Navier--Stokes and closes the pressure factor two, OS--Squire signs, velocity recovery, scalar invariant embedding, and norm-resolved forced-transfer powers. Exact zero-coupling lift-up rules out epsilon-only strict contraction; the strong complete-row A2 estimate and nonlinear/Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.72Z 把 active OS pressure 写成 exact signed relative form，在 high-gap \(q\)-graph 上闭合 prefactor-one decay 与 forcing；Squire transfer 按 orientation、\(\Lambda\) payment 与 causal history 闭合。all-row prefactor-one contraction 为 FALSE；low-gap physical row 与 nonlinear/Clay 仍为 OPEN。
en: R0.72Z writes active OS pressure as an exact signed relative form and closes prefactor-one decay and forcing on the high-gap \(q\)-graph; Squire transfer closes with orientation, the \(\Lambda\) payment, and causal history retained. All-row prefactor-one contraction is FALSE; the low-gap physical row and nonlinear/Clay questions remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73A 用 \(h=\Pi_0q/\mu\) 记录 hidden physical mean，在 \(X_\mu\) 中闭合 all-start finite-transient viscous-rate bound。lifted tangent line 对每个 \(c_\mu\ne0\) 的正 gap 不 invariant；nonzero limit 只沿 \(c_\mu\to c_0\ne0\)，fixed \(\Lambda\) raw-\(q\) limit 与 kinetic/Squire/Bloch/nonlinear/Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73A records the hidden physical mean with \(h=\Pi_0q/\mu\) and closes an all-start finite-transient viscous-rate bound in \(X_\mu\). The lifted tangent line is not invariant at any positive gap with \(c_\mu\ne0\); a nonzero limit occurs only along \(c_\mu\to c_0\ne0\), while the fixed \(\Lambda\) raw-\(q\) limit and kinetic/Squire/Bloch/nonlinear/Clay questions remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73B 由 exact Bloch carrier cancellation 得到 bounded physical orientation，并用 primitive kinetic identity 闭合 complete linear velocity/Squire rows 的 finite transient direct sum。fixed-\(c\) uniformity 与 prefactor-one contraction 为 FALSE；A2、sharp \(|\Lambda|\)、nonlinear 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73B obtains a bounded physical orientation from the exact Bloch carrier cancellation and uses the primitive kinetic identity to close the finite-transient direct sum for the complete linear velocity/Squire rows. Fixed-\(c\) uniformity and prefactor-one contraction are FALSE; A2, the sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law, nonlinear closure, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73C 的 \(\sigma_*\in(0.17035,0.17050)\) 现在对所有充分小正黏性持续为非空谱簇。固定围道 resolvent 一致有界，Riesz 投影在物理 kinetic norm 中按算子范数收敛，总代数重数保持。
en: R0.73C's \(\sigma_*\in(0.17035,0.17050)\) now persists as a nonempty spectral cluster for every sufficiently small positive viscosity. The fixed-contour resolvent is uniformly bounded, the Riesz projections converge in operator norm in the physical kinetic norm, and total algebraic multiplicity is preserved.

zh: R0.73C 用周期 Sobolev 模态与 Pöschl--Teller 谱闭合 exact cubic neutral spectrum，再由周期单值矩阵实迹和双区间严格异号闭合一条 infinite-dimensional frozen Rayleigh instability。viscous fast-time transfer 为 OPEN；super-polynomial complete-row no-go 为 CONDITIONAL；A2、nonlinear 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73C uses periodic Sobolev modes and the Pöschl--Teller spectrum to close the exact cubic neutral spectrum, then closes one infinite-dimensional frozen Rayleigh instability from the real trace of the periodic monodromy matrix and two rigorous interval signs. Viscous fast-time transfer is OPEN; the super-polynomial complete-row no-go is CONDITIONAL; A2, nonlinear closure, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73D 在 exact kinetic space 中保留定义域跳变，用紧 Fourier commutator、耗散基础 resolvent 和 Fredholm 因子证明固定黏性谱簇持续；Riesz 投影按算子范数收敛，总代数重数保持。一般先例属于 Shvydkoy--Friedlander；simplicity、rate、complement、fast time、nonlinear 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73D retains the domain jump in the exact kinetic space and proves persistence of the fixed viscous spectral cluster using a compact Fourier commutator, dissipative base resolvent, and Fredholm factor; the Riesz projections converge in operator norm and total algebraic multiplicity is preserved. The general precedent is due to Shvydkoy--Friedlander; simplicity, rate, complement, fast time, nonlinear, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73E 把 compact--Fredholm 核心与完整竖线 resolvent 尾部拼接，闭合固定正半平面谱完备性、完整 top cluster 相对二分和对数快时间 Volterra 传递。固定窗口指数律、moving-profile top bundle、完整 OS--Squire、nonlinear 与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73E joins the compact--Fredholm core to the full vertical-line resolvent tail and closes fixed-positive-half-plane spectral completeness, a relative dichotomy for the complete top cluster, and logarithmic fast-time Volterra transfer. The fixed-window exponential law, moving-profile top bundle, complete OS--Squire, nonlinearity, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73F 用带保守半径的 Lyapunov--Perron 图构造把 R0.73E 冻结二分传递到精确移动剖面，闭合一条精确线性行的固定窗口指数增益。finite diagnostic、完整全行、nonlinear 与 Clay 边界保持分离。
en: Using a Lyapunov--Perron graph construction with a conservative radius, R0.73F transfers the frozen dichotomy of R0.73E to the exact moving profile and closes fixed-window exponential gain on one exact linear row. The finite diagnostic, complete all-row problem, nonlinearity, and Clay remain separate.

zh: R0.73H 用实际选定增益归一化初态，并以精确谐波选择律、倍频行连续数值横坐标界、Stieltjes 局部化和四阶余项闭合平面固定距离偏离。预设指数种子、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: R0.73H normalizes the initial data by the actual selected gain and closes planar fixed-distance departure through exact harmonic selection rules, a continuum numerical-abscissa bound for the doubled row, Stieltjes localization, and a fourth-order remainder. The prescribed exponential seed, fixed background, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity, and Clay remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73I 证明继承端点严格小于 \(1/450\)，给完整移动传播子一个连续体上作用量，并证明完整顶谱块最小、最大增益共享零窗口切向速率。两个精确反例只否定由现有输入推出固定窗口作用量和有界前因子；有限 action/WKB 数据不承担连续体定理。
en: R0.73I proves that the inherited endpoint is strictly below \(1/450\), gives the full moving evolution a continuum upper action, and proves that the minimum and maximum gains on the complete top block share a zero-window tangent rate. Two exact counterexamples reject only the inference of a fixed-window action and bounded prefactor from the present inputs; the finite action/WKB data carry no continuum theorem.

zh: R0.73J 认证周期 Rayleigh 连续算子上的唯一简单最右谱支 \(\lambda_0(d)\in(0.167,0.173)\)、严格谱隙 \(>0.057\)、左右重叠和固定相位锚。自然盒首轮 76/83、depth-two 1/7 的 wrapping 历史保留；自适应 depth five 最终覆盖 83/83 个选定盒。
en: R0.73J certifies the unique simple rightmost spectral branch \(\lambda_0(d)\in(0.167,0.173)\), a strict spectral gap \(>0.057\), left-right overlap, and a fixed phase anchor for the periodic Rayleigh continuum operator. The natural-box wrapping history of 76/83 in the first pass and 1/7 at depth-two is retained; adaptive depth five ultimately covers 83/83 selected boxes.

zh: R0.73K 证明：在共同但未显式量化的黏度阈值内，无黏特征值在整个 \(d\in[0,1/450]\) 上延拓为共同圆内唯一的实代数简单黏性谱支；Riesz 投影在算子范数下一致收敛，特征值偏移满足 \(O(\varepsilon)\) 上界。固定半平面 \(\operatorname{Re}z\ge0.12\) 内无其他谱点；选定 rank-one 谱块的逆向指数 \(0.16\) 与保守安全间隔 \(1/25\) 同时受控。
en: R0.73K theorem: within a common but not explicitly quantified viscosity threshold, the inviscid eigenvalue extends over the full interval \(d\in[0,1/450]\) to the unique real algebraically simple viscous spectral branch in the common circle; the Riesz projections converge uniformly in operator norm, and the eigenvalue shift obeys an \(O(\varepsilon)\) upper bound. The fixed half-plane \(\operatorname{Re}z\ge0.12\) contains no other spectral points; the backward exponent \(0.16\) for the selected rank-one spectral block and the conservative safety margin \(1/25\) are both controlled.

zh: R0.73L 的 bounded two-sided prefactor 把未知实际增益换成完整 inviscid action；\(1/1500\)、\(1/1000\)、\(21/125\) 三个严格裕度闭合非线性谐波层级。
en: The bounded two-sided prefactor from R0.73L replaces the unknown actual gain with the full inviscid action; the three strict margins \(1/1500\), \(1/1000\), and \(21/125\) close the nonlinear harmonic hierarchy.

zh: R0.73L 再用 Kato intertwining、固定快时间块和前向 Volterra 吸收，证明真实 selected orbit 在完整慢窗上以 \(O(\varepsilon)\) 相对误差跟踪移动 rank-one 谱线；精确增益与黏性及无黏谱作用量只差统一两侧乘法常数，后向定位由同一条前向轨道相除得到。
en: Using Kato intertwining, fixed fast-time blocks, and forward Volterra absorption, R0.73L further proves that the exact selected orbit tracks the moving rank-one spectral line across the full slow window with \(O(\varepsilon)\) relative error; the exact gain differs from the viscous and inviscid spectral actions only by uniform two-sided multiplicative constants, and backward localization follows by dividing along the same forward orbit.

zh: R0.73M 用完整无黏 action 指定指数小种子，并以 \(\mu_*=0.167>1/6\) 的 forward localization 闭合二次、三次与四阶谐波能量账本；终点固定在物理时刻 \(T_*=1/1800\)，selected-pair 距离至少为 \(c_*\rho\)。
en: R0.73M uses the full inviscid action to prescribe an exponentially small seed and closes the quadratic, cubic, and fourth-order harmonic energy ledgers with forward localization at \(\mu_*=0.167>1/6\); the endpoint is fixed at physical time \(T_*=1/1800\), and the selected-pair distance is at least \(c_*\rho\).

zh: R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。
en: R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) while the background varies accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain an order-one output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: any pair of coexisting strong solutions satisfies a finite accumulated-strain bound; planar perturbations obey a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Consequently, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on a single fixed background.

zh: R0.73N｜固定成员有限应变稳定性与族转移障碍
en: R0.73N | Fixed-member finite-strain stability and the family-transfer obstruction

zh: R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。
en: R0.73O rules out the \(H^3\)-small instability route around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, its accumulated \(H^4\) action is finite, and it has a positive stability radius valid for every starting time. The forced contrast retains infinite accumulated strain and supplies, through planar directions, globally smooth witnesses whose initial perturbations tend to zero in \(H^3\), while their \(L^2\) distance from the forced equilibrium is bounded below by a fixed positive constant at suitable times.

en: R0.73O | A priori global-orbit stability and a forced Kolmogorov contrast

en: R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations with \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes with the reference orbit; what remains uncrossed is the preceding early weak interval.

zh: R0.73P｜临界稳定、N^{-1/2} 频率门槛与早期正则缺口
en: R0.73P｜Critical Stability, the N^{-1/2} Frequency Threshold, and the Early Regularity Gap

zh: R0.73Q 增加了一个周期 \(\dot B^{-1/2}_{6,4}\) 热流入口。显式剪切模可以同时满足 \(L^2\to0\)、热流迹 \(\to0\)，却有 \(H^{1/2}\to\infty\)；因此新旧稳定管的并集严格扩大。任意 \(L^2\)-小数据仍未覆盖。
en: R0.73Q adds a periodic \(\dot B^{-1/2}_{6,4}\) heat-flow entrance. Explicit shear modes can satisfy \(L^2\to0\) and heat-flow trace \(\to0\), yet \(H^{1/2}\to\infty\); the union of the new and old stability tubes is therefore strictly larger. Arbitrary \(L^2\)-small data remain uncovered.

zh: R0.73Q｜越过 \(H^{1/2}\) 入口的临界热流稳定管
en: R0.73Q | A critical heat-flow tube beyond the \(H^{1/2}\) entrance

en: R0.73R will upgrade a single-frequency upper bound to a heat-diffusion concentration certificate: it will track modal counts, phase coherence, and \(L^6/L^2\) concentration shell by shell, seek a computable \(\mathfrak X\) entrance, and state precisely what still separates it from the general \(L^2\)-only problem.

en: R0.73S | Reducing triple convolution to autocorrelation: one computable certificate and two boundaries that cannot be crossed

en: R0.73T will no longer search for a more elegant static proxy. The next step is to insert the quadratic certificate into Navier--Stokes dynamics and study shellwise

en: R0.73T | Autocorrelation enters the dynamics: a critical one-sided estimate and the pressure-tensor barrier

en: R0.73U | Full tensors in the heat hierarchy: pressure is recoverable, but the even quadratic state is not dynamically closed

zh: R0.73V｜压力感知的有符号三阶热提升：精确尺度生成律与 3→4 物理时间边界
en: R0.73V | A pressure-aware signed third-order heat lift: exact scale generation and the 3→4 physical-time boundary

zh: R0.73W 把带符号 production 的精确支付、能量类尺度损失、中心增量分解、临界半尺度平均与精确反例分开；局部化、零尺度一致控制和任意三维正则性仍开放。
en: R0.73W separates the exact payment for signed production, energy-class scale loss, centered-increment decomposition, critical half-scale averaging, and exact counterexamples; localization, uniform zero-scale control, and arbitrary three-dimensional regularity remain open.

en: R0.73W | Signed subfilter production: heat-plane characteristics, the energy-class boundary, and exact counterexamples

en: R0.73X advances the localization problem left by the preceding section to an auditable boundary: exterior influence is no longer written as a vague "error" but is split into the Gaussian tail of direct heat propagation and the algebraic tail of harmonic pressure. zh: R0.73X 的价值在于把一个含混的 local remainder 问题拆成可独立攻击的三层：direct Gaussian velocity/pressure-source transport、algebraic harmonic pressure tail，以及 signed payment 到 positive size 的 coercivity bridge。 第一层与第二层现在有 exact definitions、scale audit、positive-scale size proof 与 independent readback。这样，后续若提出更强 theorem，就不能再把 pressure nonlocality 或 zero-scale endpoint 隐藏在“lower-order error”里。 同样重要的是，本节关闭了两个精确定义的错误方向：fixed probe class 的 amplitude-independent quadratic absorption，以及没有 exterior input 的 velocity-only functional tail estimate。 仍未闭合的不是另一个 algebraic identity，而是式 (1.7)：怎样从 signed information 得到能进入 CKN/Koch--Tataru interface 的 positive smallness， 同时保留 compact cutoff、harmonic pressure 与 suitable-weak defect。 因此这一节是 rigorous boundary result，而不是 regularity theorem，更不是 Clay problem 的完成比例。 任意三维初值全局正则性与 Clay 保持 OPEN。
en: The value of R0.73X lies in splitting a vague local-remainder problem into three layers that can be attacked independently: direct Gaussian velocity/pressure-source transport, the algebraic harmonic-pressure tail, and the coercivity bridge from signed payment to positive size. The first and second layers now have exact definitions, a scale audit, a positive-scale size proof, and an independent readback. Consequently, any later stronger theorem can no longer hide pressure nonlocality or the zero-scale endpoint inside a "lower-order error." Equally important, this section closes two precisely defined false directions: amplitude-independent quadratic absorption for a fixed probe class, and a velocity-only functional tail estimate with no exterior input. The remaining gap is not another algebraic identity but (1.7): how to derive positive smallness suitable for the CKN/Koch--Tataru interface from signed information while retaining the compact cutoff, harmonic pressure, and suitable-weak defect. This section is therefore a rigorous boundary result, not a regularity theorem and still less a completion percentage for the Clay problem. Global regularity for arbitrary three-dimensional initial data and Clay remain OPEN.

In the fifth shell at payment radius \(2R_j\), the background shear on a fixed box stays at least \(1/2\) throughout the payment window, so the nonnegative cubic velocity term gives the lower bound \(8e^{-8}B_j^3R_j^3\). Combined with the upper bound proved in R0.74G, the common complete payment of Versions M and F satisfies \(P_j\asymp B_j^3R_j^3\), and \(\log P_j/L_j^2\to3/320\). zh: 这一节仍然没有解决三维 Navier--Stokes 千禧年问题。R0.74K 把真实被动包的领圈上界拆成主目标领圈的时间重数和最近内领圈的正剪切排出；我在本节只处理第一项。结果是：主目标领圈所需的归一化周期桥上界已经证明，并通过独立数学审计；最近内领圈仍然 OPEN。核心不是把真实包近似成自由热包，而是先把随终端时刻变化的后向桥族精确反演成同一个前向布朗概率律，再利用真实中心只穿过一个很短的“剪切时钟”区间。
en: This section still does not solve the three-dimensional Navier--Stokes Millennium Problem. R0.74K split the true passive packet's collar upper bound into the temporal multiplicity of the main target collar and positive-shear expulsion at the nearest inward collar; this section treats only the first. The normalized periodic-bridge upper bound required for the main target collar is now proved and independently audited, while the nearest inward collar remains OPEN. The key is not to approximate the true packet by a free-heat packet, but first to invert the terminal-time-dependent backward bridge family exactly into one forward Brownian probability law, and then use the fact that the true center crosses only a very short shear-clock interval.

zh: 本步得到五项结论。第一，对每个固定的周期 suitable weak solution 和固定尺度，physical shell-flux density 具有可求和的 \(\ell^1(L_t^{4/3})\) 包络；这来自 energy-class interpolation \(u\in L_t^4L_x^3\)、周期 Calderon--Zygmund pressure estimate 与固定尺度的 mollified drift bound。第二，维数化长度为 \(\delta\) 的共同终端窗因此获得 \(\delta^{1/4}\) 增益；一般的 \(L_t^p\) shell-tail estimate 获得 \(\delta^{1-1/p}\)，但整个窗口只能删除同一个 shell set。第三，这个时间增益不能修复 payment exponent：即使额外假设相关的 \(\ell^1(L_t^p)\) tail 线性依赖 \(P_R^M\)，与 positive-depth term 平衡后仍只有 \(P^{2(2p-1)/(5p-3)}\)；energy-class 值为 \(P^{10/11}\)，\(p=\infty\) 也只有 \(P^{4/5}\)，都达不到 \(P^{2/3}\)。第四，smooth \((N+1)\)-coordinate witness 证明：任意阶 scalar temporal regularity 连同 payment-linear amplitude 仍不能单独推出 fixed-window best-\(N\) gate；这是抽象向量见证，不是 Navier--Stokes solution。第五，Step 12 的 separate uniform Morrey/path assumptions 可以弱化为 combined cover coefficient 至多按 \(1+(P_R^M)^{2/3}\) 增长；\(2/3\) 对只使用 two scalar caps 的论证是精确阈值，但不声称它对其他 PDE 证明是必要条件。
en: This step has five conclusions. First, for each fixed periodic suitable weak solution and fixed scale, the physical shell-flux density has a summable \(\ell^1(L_t^{4/3})\) envelope; this follows from the energy-class interpolation \(u\in L_t^4L_x^3\), the periodic Calderon--Zygmund pressure estimate, and the fixed-scale mollified-drift bound. Second, a common terminal window of dimensionless length \(\delta\) consequently gains \(\delta^{1/4}\); a general \(L_t^p\) shell-tail estimate gains \(\delta^{1-1/p}\), but the entire window may delete only one common shell set. Third, that time gain does not repair the payment exponent: even if one additionally assumes that the relevant \(\ell^1(L_t^p)\) tail depends linearly on \(P_R^M\), balancing it with the positive-depth term gives only \(P^{2(2p-1)/(5p-3)}\); the energy-class value is \(P^{10/11}\), and even \(p=\infty\) gives only \(P^{4/5}\), all short of \(P^{2/3}\). Fourth, a smooth \((N+1)\)-coordinate witness shows that arbitrarily high scalar temporal regularity together with payment-linear amplitude cannot by itself imply the fixed-window best-\(N\) gate; this is an abstract vector witness, not a Navier--Stokes solution. Fifth, Step 12's separate uniform Morrey/path assumptions can be weakened to a combined cover coefficient growing at most like \(1+(P_R^M)^{2/3}\); \(2/3\) is the exact threshold for an argument using only the two scalar caps, but is not claimed necessary for other PDE proofs.
